a_clown_in_town.name: A Clown in Town
a_clown_in_town.description: Rue the day you crossed a fey. You were cruel to Dolly Thrice; now you'll have to pay the price. This condition can only be obtained by smashing the Moonlantern held by Kar'niss. Applies clown makeup to the victim.

a_mist_most_scarlet.name: A Mist Most Scarlet
a_mist_most_scarlet.description: Orin has gained 25 temporary hit points, a +2 bonus to Strength, and advantage on Wisdom  Saving throws.

a_most_bloody_inheritance.name: A Most Bloody Inheritance
a_most_bloody_inheritance.description: The Dread Lord Bhaal looks favourably on his chosen. You can cast  Stunning Gaze and your Critical Hit Attack Roll requirement is reduced by 2. This effect can stack.

aberrant_shape.name: Aberrant Shape
aberrant_shape.description: Your Intellect Devourer form has 21 Hit Points. You gain the  Claws,  Devour Intellect, and  Synaptic Discharge abilities.

abjure_enemy_frightened.name: Abjure Enemy: Frightened
abjure_enemy_frightened.description: The affected creature cannot move. Frightened creatures also have  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and Attack rolls.

abjure_enemy_slow.name: Abjure Enemy: Slow
abjure_enemy_slow.description: The affected creature's Movement speed is halved. Taking damage ends this condition.

absolute_consumption.name: Absolute Consumption
absolute_consumption.description: All of the creature's abilities are reduced by 5. When this effect ends, it drops  Prone

absolute_s_enemy.name: Absolute's Enemy
absolute_s_enemy.description: Enemies have  Advantage on attacks against you.

absorb_elements_acid_damage.name: Absorb Elements: Acid Damage
absorb_elements_acid_damage.description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d6Acid damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

absorb_elements_cold_damage.name: Absorb Elements: Cold Damage
absorb_elements_cold_damage.description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d6Cold damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

absorb_elements_fire_damage.name: Absorb Elements: Fire Damage
absorb_elements_fire_damage.description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d6Fire damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

absorb_elements_lightning_damage.name: Absorb Elements: Lightning Damage
absorb_elements_lightning_damage.description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d6Lightning damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

absorb_elements_thunder_damage.name: Absorb Elements: Thunder Damage
absorb_elements_thunder_damage.description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d6Thunder damage the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

absorbed_essence_amelyssan.name: Absorbed Essence: Amelyssan
absorbed_essence_amelyssan.description: Sarevok's attacks now heal him by 2d12hit points each time.

absorbed_essence_illasera.name: Absorbed Essence: Illasera
absorbed_essence_illasera.description: Sarevok is permanently  Hastened and can't be  Paralysed,  Restrained, or have his movement speed reduced in any way.

absorbed_essence_sendai.name: Absorbed Essence: Sendai
absorbed_essence_sendai.description: Sarevok's Armour Class Armour Class is increased by 6.

acid_infusion.name: Acid Infusion
acid_infusion.description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d4Acid the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

acid_reflux.name: Acid Reflux
acid_reflux.description: Acid damage has spoiled Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Acidic Regurgitation.

acid_resistance_aura.name: Acid Resistance Aura
acid_resistance_aura.description: The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to Acid damage.

action_surge.name: Action Surge
action_surge.description: Can take an extra Action this turn.

adamantine_reverberation.name: Adamantine Reverberation
adamantine_reverberation.description: While it has temporary hit points, this creature's movement speed is doubled. Immediately after losing these temporary hit points, the creature knocks back foes  4 m / 13 ft with a shockwave that deals 4d8Thunder.

adrip_with_kereska_s_acid.name: Adrip with Kereska's Acid
adrip_with_kereska_s_acid.description: Affected entity has resistance to Acid damage. Its acid spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus. When it deals spell damage, it possibly inflict 3 turns of  Noxious Fumes upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's acid it can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Hunger of Hadar at 5th level once per short rest.

adroit_caster.name: Adroit Caster
adroit_caster.description: Cantrips targeting foes and allies can target an additional creature. The same target can be chosen twice.

aegis_of_the_absolute.name: Aegis of the Absolute
aegis_of_the_absolute.description: The Netherbrain is Immune to all types of damage it took in the previous round until the start of its next turn.

against_all_odds.name: Against All Odds
against_all_odds.description: The unlikely actions of the party in the Morphic Pool were a surprise to even the Netherbrain. The successful roll has left the Netherbrain wounded, reducing its starting HP for the encounter.

agitated.name: Agitated
agitated.description: The rothé is nervous and afraid - ready to attack at the slightest scare. Has  Advantage on Attack rolls.

aid_5.name: Aid (5)
aid_5.description: Hit point maximum increased by 5 hit points. Hit point maximum increases by a further 5hit points for every Spell Slot Level above 2 used.

aid_10.name: Aid (10)
aid_10.description: Hit point maximum increased by 10 hit points.

aid_15.name: Aid (15)
aid_15.description: Hit point maximum increased by 15 hit points.

aid_20.name: Aid (20)
aid_20.description: Hit point maximum increased by 20 hit points.

aid_25.name: Aid (25)
aid_25.description: Hit point maximum increased by 25 hit points.

alarmed_debtor.name: Alarmed Debtor
alarmed_debtor.description: This creature has spotted you as an intruder.

alcohol.name: Alcohol
alcohol.skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Arcana, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
alcohol.description: Has  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.

alternate_form_dire_wolf.name: Alternate Form: Dire Wolf
alternate_form_dire_wolf.description: Transformed into a Dire Wolf in all the ways that matter.

alternate_form_minotaur.name: Alternate Form: Minotaur
alternate_form_minotaur.description: Transformed into a Minotaur in all the ways that matter.

alternate_form_phase_spider.name: Alternate Form: Phase Spider
alternate_form_phase_spider.description: Transformed into a Phase Spider in all the ways that matter.

alternate_form_shadow_mastiff.name: Alternate Form: Shadow Mastiff
alternate_form_shadow_mastiff.description: Transformed into a Shadow Mastiff in all the ways that matter.

ambushed.name: Ambushed
ambushed.skills: Athletics, Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Arcana
ambushed.description: Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage and it has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Checks. Taking damage or being Helped ends this condition.

ambushing.name: Ambushing
ambushing.description: Affected entity will attack as soon as its enemies are within reach. It can only be spotted with a successful Perception Check.

ambushing_bite.name: Ambushing Bite
ambushing_bite.description: The creature's next bite may  Ambush its target.

ancient_grudges.name: Ancient Grudges
ancient_grudges.description: Filled with a touch of arcane gith knowledge. Has  Advantage on Attack Rolls against aberrations.

animalistic_vitality.name: Animalistic Vitality
animalistic_vitality.description: Affected entity regains 2d8hit points of health every round when below 60 HP. It also receives an additional  3.5 m / 12 ft of movement speed.

anointed_in_splendour.name: Anointed in Splendour
anointed_in_splendour.description: Has a +2 bonus to all Saving throw Saving throws.

ansur_s_ire.name: Ansur's Ire
ansur_s_ire.description: A storm of vicious lightning is soon to erupt - striking all standing in the open.

aquatic_siphon.name: Aquatic Siphon
aquatic_siphon.description: A nearby water myrmidon grants the affected entity Immunity to Cold damage and an additional 3d8Cold damage to  Elemental Retort. The affected entity also gains temporary access to  Cone of Cold and an additional  Reaction per turn.

arcane_acuity.name: Arcane Acuity
arcane_acuity.description: Affected entity has a +1 bonus to its spell Attack rolls and spell save DC for each remaining turn. Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity takes damage. Arcane Acuity has a maximum  Duration: 10 turns.

arcane_ammunition.name: Arcane Ammunition
arcane_ammunition.description: Ranged weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4Force.

arcane_battery.name: Arcane Battery
arcane_battery.description: Affected entity's next spell doesn't cost a spell slot in order to cast.

arcane_charge.name: Arcane Charge
arcane_charge.description: While damaging  Threatened entities, deal +2 bonus to damage with spells.

arcane_critical.name: Arcane Critical
arcane_critical.description: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 2. This effect can stack.

arcane_hunger.name: Arcane Hunger
arcane_hunger.description: Gale's spirit is being drained. He has  Disadvantage to Constitution  Saving throws.

arcane_lock.name: Arcane Lock
arcane_lock.description: Locked through magical means. Can't be opened by lockpicking or the use of  Knock.

arcane_synergy.name: Arcane Synergy
arcane_synergy.description: Weapon attacks deal additional damage equal to affected entity's Spell Casting Ability Modifier.

arcane_ward.name: Arcane Ward
arcane_ward.description: Your Arcane Ward blocks damage equal to its charges and then loses 1 charge. Casting Abjuration spells will add charges equal to the level of the spell.

ardent_apostle.name: Ardent Apostle
ardent_apostle.description: Offering their cries of pain without protection. Has a +4 bonus to Performance and Intimidation checks.

armour_of_agathys.name: Armour of Agathys
armour_of_agathys.description: Gained  5 × spell level temporary hit points. If hit with a melee attack, the attacker takes 5 × spell levelCold damage. This effect ends when the temporary hit points are lost.

armour_of_the_swarm.name: Armour of the Swarm
armour_of_the_swarm.description: Your swarm grants you a +2 bonus to your  Armour Class until the start of your next turn.

arsonist_s_oil.name: Arsonist's Oil
arsonist_s_oil.description: Affected entity has been stripped of its Fire Resistance.

ascended_fiend.name: Ascended Fiend
ascended_fiend.description: Raphael has gorged on souls and enhanced his fiendish powers, granting him an even deadlier array of spells and abilities. In this form,  Soul Overcharge will not prevent him from using Souls to cast spells.

aspect_of_the_elk.name: Aspect of the Elk
aspect_of_the_elk.description: Movement Speed increased by  +1.5 m / 5 ft, as long as the affected entity stays near the barbarian.

aspect_of_the_elk_aura.name: Aspect of the Elk Aura
aspect_of_the_elk_aura.description: Affected entity and nearby allies have a  +1.5 m / 5 ft bonus to Movement Speed.

aspect_of_the_stallion.name: Aspect of the Stallion
aspect_of_the_stallion.description: Gained Barbarian Level * 2  temporary hit points.

aspect_of_the_wolf.name: Aspect of the Wolf
aspect_of_the_wolf.description: Affected entity has a +Dexterity Modifier bonus to Stealth Checks, as long as it stays near the barbarian.

aspect_of_the_wolf_aura.name: Aspect of the Wolf Aura
aspect_of_the_wolf_aura.description: Affected entity and nearby allies have a +Dexterity Modifier bonus to Stealth Checks.

assassin_s_blood.name: Assassin's Blood
assassin_s_blood.description: Creature must succeed a Constitution  Saving throw or take 1d12Poison and get Poisoned until the next Long Rest. On a successful save, it still takes half damage.

astral_conduit.name: Astral Conduit
astral_conduit.description: The affected entity can't move, take actions, bonus actions, or reactions while holding open the Astral Rift, but can Summon an ally every other turn.

astral_gravity.name: Astral Gravity
astral_gravity.description: Gravity on the Astral Plane is different than on Faerûn. The affected entity is Immune to Falling damage and its Jump distance is tripled. Carrying capacity is tripled.

astral_knowledge.name: Astral Knowledge
astral_knowledge.description: Has Proficiency in all Skills of a chosen Ability.

astral_knowledge_charisma.name: Astral Knowledge: Charisma
astral_knowledge_charisma.description: Has Proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, Performance, and Persuasion.

astral_knowledge_dexterity.name: Astral Knowledge: Dexterity
astral_knowledge_dexterity.description: Has Proficiency in Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth.

astral_knowledge_intelligence.name: Astral Knowledge: Intelligence
astral_knowledge_intelligence.description: Has Proficiency in Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, and Religion.

astral_knowledge_wisdom.name: Astral Knowledge: Wisdom
astral_knowledge_wisdom.description: Has Proficiency in Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, and Survival.

at_death_s_door_emergent.name: At Death's Door (Emergent)
at_death_s_door_emergent.description: Emergent Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 2. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.

at_death_s_door.name: At Death's Door
at_death_s_door.description: The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.

at_death_s_door_moderate.name: At Death's Door (Moderate)
at_death_s_door_moderate.description: Moderate Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 4. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.

at_death_s_door_advanced.name: At Death's Door (Advanced)
at_death_s_door_advanced.description: Advanced Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 6. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.

atrophied.name: Atrophied
atrophied.description: One of the affected entity's Abilities has been reduced to 0, causing it to die instantly.

auntie_ethel_s_special_brew.name: Auntie Ethel's Special Brew
auntie_ethel_s_special_brew.description: The affected creature takes 2d6Poison at the start of every turn until passing a DC 13  Constitution saving throw.

aura_of_bloodthirst.name: Aura of Bloodthirst
aura_of_bloodthirst.description: Any nearby creatures with the Rampage trait can make a bite attack as a bonus action.

aura_of_brutality.name: Aura of Brutality
aura_of_brutality.description: All servants of  Bane around this character gain an additional +1 Strength. This effect can stack.

aura_of_conquest.name: Aura of Conquest
aura_of_conquest.description: Frightened enemies within  3 m / 10 ft take 5Psychic damage per turn.

aura_of_courage_aura.name: Aura of Courage (Aura)
aura_of_courage_aura.description: The paladin and any nearby allies can't be  Frightened.

aura_of_courage.name: Aura of Courage
aura_of_courage.description: Can't be  Frightened within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

aura_of_devotion_aura.name: Aura of Devotion (Aura)
aura_of_devotion_aura.description: The paladin and any nearby allies can't be  Charmed.

aura_of_devotion.name: Aura of Devotion
aura_of_devotion.description: Can't be  Charmed within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

aura_of_hate_aura.name: Aura of Hate (Aura)
aura_of_hate_aura.description: The Paladin and all nearby fiends and undead deal additional damage with melee weapons, equal to the Charisma modifier of the Paladin.

aura_of_hate.name: Aura of Hate
aura_of_hate.description: Deals an additional +Charisma modifier to damage dealt with melee weapons within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

aura_of_murder_aura.name: Aura of Murder (Aura)
aura_of_murder_aura.description: Enemies within 3 m / 10 ft are Vulnerable to Piercing damage, unless they are Immune to it.

aura_of_murder.name: Aura of Murder
aura_of_murder.description: Affected entity is Vulnerable to Piercing damage.

aura_of_possibility.name: Aura of Possibility
aura_of_possibility.description: While near the God of Ambition, this creature has a +10 bonus to all Ability Checks.

aura_of_possibility_aura.name: Aura of Possibility (Aura)
aura_of_possibility_aura.description: Any allies near Gale Dekarios, the God of Ambition, receive a +10 bonus to all Ability Checks.

aura_of_protection_aura.name: Aura of Protection (Aura)
aura_of_protection_aura.description: The paladin and any nearby allies have a +Charisma modifier bonus on Saving Throws.

aura_of_protection.name: Aura of Protection
aura_of_protection.description: Gains a bonus to saving throws equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.

aura_of_terror_aura.name: Aura of Terror (Aura)
aura_of_terror_aura.description: Nearby enemies have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and  Saving throws. Creatures that can't be  Frightened are immune to this aura.

aura_of_terror.name: Aura of Terror
aura_of_terror.description: Bane's oppressive aura gives the affected entity  Disadvantage on attack rolls and  Saving throws while within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

aura_of_vile_oblivion.name: Aura of Vile Oblivion
aura_of_vile_oblivion.description: All nearby light sources get extinguished when the Wraith is nearby.

aura_of_warding_aura.name: Aura of Warding (Aura)
aura_of_warding_aura.description: The paladin and any nearby allies have Resistance to damage from spells.

aura_of_warding.name: Aura of Warding
aura_of_warding.description: Resistant to damage from spells within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

avatar_of_boooal.name: Avatar of BOOOAL
avatar_of_boooal.description: The sight of a kuo-toa servant dying fills BOOOAL with bloodlust. It regains 3d6hit points when it kills a creature and can attack three times.

avatar_of_tyranny.name: Avatar of Tyranny
avatar_of_tyranny.description: Bane has come to Gortash's aid! Gortash has  150 temporary hit points,  Advantage on  Strength checks and  Strength saving throws... And now has fearsome new powers! Affected entity gains an extra 1d4Physical damage to weapon attacks and Immunity to Thunder, Fire, and Force damage.

aversion_of_fire.name: Aversion of Fire
aversion_of_fire.description: Recently suffered Fire damage. Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.

baleful_knowledge.name: Baleful Knowledge
baleful_knowledge.skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
baleful_knowledge.description: Dark whispers pervade the creature's mind.  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.

bane.name: Bane
bane.description: Has a  -1d4 penalty to  Attack rolls and Saving throws.

bane_s_brutality.name: Bane's Brutality
bane_s_brutality.description: Affected entity gains +1 to its Strength ability. This effect can stack.

bane_s_command.name: Bane's Command
bane_s_command.description: This creature can channel  Bane's Wrath - it is the Black Hand's will.

baneful_strike.name: Baneful Strike
baneful_strike.description: Affected entity has a -1d4 penalty to  Saving throws against its attacker's next spell.

banished.name: Banished
banished.description: Banished from this plane of existence. Can't be targeted. Can't move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions

bardic_inspiration.name: Bardic Inspiration
bardic_inspiration.description: Can use  Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d6 bonus to the next Attack roll,  Ability check, or  Saving throw. Bonus depends on originating Bard's level Grants:  Bardic Roll (Toggleable Passive Feature): +1d6 bonus to the next  Ability check.  Bardic Defence (Reaction): +1d6 bonus to the next  Saving throw.  Bardic Attack (Reaction): +1d6 bonus to the next Attack roll.

beacon_of_hope.name: Beacon of Hope
beacon_of_hope.description: Has Advantage on Wisdom and Death  Saving throws. Regains the maximum possible Hit Points when healed.

bear_s_endurance.name: Bear's Endurance
bear_s_endurance.description: Has  Advantage on Constitution Checks. Gain 7 Temporary Hit Points.

beckoning_darkness.name: Beckoning Darkness
beckoning_darkness.description: Haunted by darkness. Affected entity takes 2d8Necrotic damage if it enters or starts its turn in a Lightly or Heavily Obscured area.

befuddled.name: Befuddled
befuddled.description: Affected entity can't control its actions and wanders around without direction.

beguiled.name: Beguiled
beguiled.description: This creature has been charmed by Raphael and cannot target him with attacks or spells.

bend_luck_ability_check_bonus.name: Bend Luck: Ability Check Bonus
bend_luck_ability_check_bonus.description: Wild magic has twisted the affected entity's fate. It gained a +1d4 bonus to  Ability Checks.

bend_luck_ability_check_penalty.name: Bend Luck: Ability Check Penalty
bend_luck_ability_check_penalty.description: Wild magic has twisted the affected entity's fate. It gained a -1d4 penalty to  Ability Checks.

benign_transposition_spent.name: Benign Transposition: Spent
benign_transposition_spent.description: Affected entity has used its  Benign Transposition feature for the day. To replenish this feature, the entity must cast a Conjuration spell of Level 1 or higher.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.description: A frenetic rage racks the affected entity's flesh. Its Multiattacks each deal an additional 1d8Bludgeoning damage and knocks targets  Prone It also gains Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage, and has  Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws. This frenzy ends if the affected entity regains all its hit points.

bhaal_s_boon.name: Bhaal's Boon
bhaal_s_boon.description: Bhaal revels in the affected entity's gift for murder, granting it a +1 bonus to  Armour Class per marked kill. 1 point of this bonus Armour Class is lost each time the Slayer avoids an attack.

bhaal_s_edict.name: Bhaal's Edict
bhaal_s_edict.description: If you don't kill another creature before the end of your next turn, you will die instantly.

bhaal_s_murderous_mark.name: Bhaal's Murderous Mark
bhaal_s_murderous_mark.description: Affected entity's death grants a +1  Armour Class bonus to the Slayer.

bhaalist_ritual_target.name: Bhaalist Ritual Target
bhaalist_ritual_target.description: As part of the challenge to enter the temple, the affected entity has become the target of a chanting cultist, the Farslayer, who can cast  Bhaal's Power Word Kill once its profane ritual ends. Exiting the Farslayer's chanting range of  55 m / 183 ft makes you invulnerable to the effect. Slaying the Farslayer stops the ritual and wins the conflict.

bhaalspawn_essence_abazigal.name: Bhaalspawn Essence: Abazigal
bhaalspawn_essence_abazigal.description: When Abazigal's ghost dies, Sarevok will absorb his essence and deal maximum damage on all his attacks.

bhaalspawn_essence_amelyssan.name: Bhaalspawn Essence: Amelyssan
bhaalspawn_essence_amelyssan.description: When Amelyssan's ghost dies, Sarevoks attacks will heal him for 2d12hit points

bhaalspawn_essence_illasera.name: Bhaalspawn Essence: Illasera
bhaalspawn_essence_illasera.description: When Illasera's ghost dies, Sarevok will be permanently  Hastened and will be unaffected by Paralysis, Restraints, or any attempts to reduce his movement speed.

bhaalspawn_essence_sendai.name: Bhaalspawn Essence: Sendai
bhaalspawn_essence_sendai.description: When Sendai's ghost dies, Sarevok will have his  Armour Class increased by 6.

big_pig.name: Big Pig
big_pig.description: Pigs are smart and pigs are fun - that's why Dolly made you one!

black_hole.name: Black Hole
black_hole.description: The black hole pulls nearby creatures and deals 7~34Force damage. The nearby area is Difficult Terrain and can  Slow creatures within it.  Intelligence saving throw

black_tentacles.name: Black Tentacles
black_tentacles.description: Restrained by dark tendrils. Affected entity can't move and takes 3d6Bludgeoning damage per turn. Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage

blacked_out.name: Blacked Out
blacked_out.description: Thisobald has overindulged in his own brew. He is Vulnerable to Slashing, Piercing, Bludgeoning and Thunder Damage.

blade_barrier.name: Blade Barrier
blade_barrier.description: Creatures that approach the barrier are slit and sliced and cut and carved like so much meat on a blood-grouted block. Affected entities take 6d10Slashing damage per turn.

blade_ward.name: Blade Ward
blade_ward.description: Has Resistance against Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

bladesinging.name: Bladesinging
bladesinging.description: Invoking the Bladesong. You gain a +2/+3/+4 bonus to  Armour Class and your movement speed is increased by 3 m / 10 ft. You also gain  Advantage in Acrobatics and a +2/+3/+4 bonus to Constitution  Saving throws. The AC and saving throws bonus is +2, +3, or +4 at Bladesinger levels 2, 5, or 9 respectively.

bladesong_damage_charge.name: Bladesong Damage Charge
bladesong_damage_charge.description: A charge that will increase how much damage you deal to enemies by 1d6Force when using  Bladesong Climax. You can accumulate these charges by casting Level 1 spells or above that are not weapon attacks.

bladesong_healing_charge.name: Bladesong Healing Charge
bladesong_healing_charge.description: A charge that increases how much you heal yourself and your allies by 1d6hit points when using  Bladesong Climax. You can accumulate these charges by attacking with weapons.

bladesong_impeded.name: Bladesong Impeded
bladesong_impeded.description: Bladesinging impeded by armour/shield/weapon. Until the armour/shield/weapon is removed, your  Bladesong won't grant any benefits or let you generate Bladesong Charges.

blazing_retaliation.name: Blazing Retaliation
blazing_retaliation.description: When a melee attack misses it, deal 1d6Fire damage to the attacker.

bleeding.name: Bleeding
bleeding.description: Creature takes 2Slashing damage at the start of each turn and has  Disadvantage on Constitution  Saving throws. Removed by healing.

bless.name: Bless
bless.description: Gains a  +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and Saving throws.

blessing_of_sel_ne.name: Blessing of Selûne
blessing_of_sel_ne.description: Selûne's radiance protects you against the lesser effects of the  Shadow Curse. But beware - even Her light cannot guard against the darkest shadows. Permits safe passage through some of the Shadow-Cursed Lands without a light source. Resistant to magical Necrotic damage.

blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.description: The affected creature has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls. The affected creature's range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m / 10 ft. Attack rolls against affected creatures have  Advantage.

blinded_blinding_smite.name: Blinded (Blinding Smite)
blinded_blinding_smite.description: The affected creature has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls. Ranged attacks and spells of the affected creature have a range of  3 m / 10 ft. Attack Rolls against affected creatures have  Advantage. At the end of each turn, the affected creature makes a  Constitution saving throw. If successful, the condition is removed.

blindness.name: Blindness
blindness.description: The affected creature has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls. Ranged attacks and spells of the affected creature have a range of  3 m / 10 ft. Attack Rolls against affected creatures have  Advantage. At the end of each turn, the affected creature makes a  Constitution saving throw. If successful, the condition is removed.

blink.name: Blink
blink.description: At the end of each turn, there is a chance the affected entity gets  Blinked to the Ethereal Plane, where it can't be harmed, seen or affected. While in the Ethereal Plane, the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can only choose to teleport up to  6 m / 20 ft. When combat ends, so does this effect.

blinked_to_the_ethereal_plane.name: Blinked to the Ethereal Plane
blinked_to_the_ethereal_plane.description: Affected entity is in the Ethereal Plane, where it can't be harmed, seen, or affected. While in the Ethereal Plane, the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can choose to teleport up to 6m / 20ft. At the end of each turn, there is a chance it reappears in the Material Plane. When combat ends, so does this effect.

bliss_spores.name: Bliss Spores
bliss_spores.description: Affected entity has a +1d6 bonus to  Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, and  Saving throws until the next Long Rest.

bloated.name: Bloated
bloated.description: Restrained due to sickness and bloat.

blocked_by_bhaalist_mischief.name: Blocked by Bhaalist Mischief
blocked_by_bhaalist_mischief.description: This door cannot be opened until the Farslayer is defeated.

blocked_warrens.name: Blocked Warrens
blocked_warrens.description: Kobolds cannot emerge from this tunnel while it is obstructed.

blood_draw_sickness.name: Blood-draw Sickness
blood_draw_sickness.description: Nothing is ever free - until the next long rest the affected entity has a -1 to all dice rolls.

blood_sapped.name: Blood-Sapped
blood_sapped.description: Hit point maximum reduced by 8 per turn remaining. Creature will die if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

blood_scent_frenzy.name: Blood-scent Frenzy
blood_scent_frenzy.description: Affected entity has  Advantage on melee attacks against any target that doesn't have all of its hit points, provided it's not a construct, an ooze, a plant, or an elemental.

bloodless.name: Bloodless
bloodless.description: Feels a bit woozy. -1 to all Attack Rolls, Saving Throws, and most Ability Checks. Disappears after Long Rest. Can be cured by Lesser Restoration, Remove Curse and Lay on Hands: Cure.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.description: Creature can attack three times. It regains 3d8hit points if it lands a killing blow.

bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
bloodthirst.description: Gains  Bite as a bonus action.

bloody_favour.name: Bloody Favour
bloody_favour.description: Bhaal's Chosen will be granted a profane boon at the start of every turn.

blooming_dead.name: Blooming Dead
blooming_dead.description: This Undead heals 4d6hit points at the start of every turn while it is within  The Dead Wastes.

bludgeon_the_weak.name: Bludgeon the Weak
bludgeon_the_weak.description: Affected entity is Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage for 3 turns, or until it takes damage.

blurred.name: Blurred
blurred.description: Attackers have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against this creature, unless they do not rely on sight or can see through illusions.

bolstering_brew.name: Bolstering Brew
bolstering_brew.description: Affected entity's Strength score is increased by 6 while it is infused with Thisobald's current brew.

bolstering_magic_boon.name: Bolstering Magic: Boon
bolstering_magic_boon.description: Bolstered by wild magic. Has a  +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Ability Checks

bone_chilled.name: Bone Chilled
bone_chilled.description: Can not regain  hit points. Cannot help  Downed characters. If Undead, has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls.

booming_blade.name: Booming Blade
booming_blade.description: Affected entity will take 1d8Thunder damage when it moves.

boooal_s_benediction.name: BOOOAL's Benediction
boooal_s_benediction.description: Advantage on Attack rolls against Bleeding creatures, as long as there are Kuo-toa to worship BOOOAL.

boooal_s_blessing.name: BOOOAL's Blessing
boooal_s_blessing.description: The wielder has  Advantage on Attack rolls against Bleeding creatures, as long as there are Kuo-toa to worship BOOOAL.

boooal_s_faithful.name: BOOOAL's Faithful
boooal_s_faithful.description: Chance to apply  Bleeding to targets.

bottled_breath.name: Bottled Breath
bottled_breath.description: Affected Entity is able to cast  Gust of Wind once per long rest.

bound.name: Bound
bound.description: This relic is bound to its current owner by a powerful aura. Bound items cannot be removed from your inventory.

bound_weapon.name: Bound Weapon
bound_weapon.description: Ritually bound to its wielder. The weapon can't be knocked out of the wielder's hand, and automatically returns to its wielder when thrown.

braced.name: Braced
braced.description: On Damage Rolls, roll twice and use the higher result.

brain_starved.name: Brain-Starved
brain_starved.description: The Creature's Ability Scores are reduced by 10 while wracked with a ravening hunger for brain matter.

brand_of_the_silverlight.name: Brand of the Silverlight
brand_of_the_silverlight.description: This creature's weapon attacks deal an additional 5d8Radiant damage.

breathless_lungs.name: Breathless Lungs
breathless_lungs.description: Mystic Carrion can't be  Silenced while his lungs are still intact.

brew_sickness.name: Brew Sickness
brew_sickness.description: While in the vicinity of Thisobald's  Spoiled Brew, this creature takes 1d6Necrotic every turn.

brewed_up_bellyglummer.name: Brewed-Up Bellyglummer
brewed_up_bellyglummer.description: Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks Affected entity takes 1d6Poison damage at the end of its next turn.

brittle.name: Brittle
brittle.description: 2d6 (2~12) Cold  damage per turn Affected entity has been rapidly cooled while aflame, making it Vulnerable to Thunder and Bludgeoning damage.

broken_promises.name: Broken Promises
broken_promises.description: Strength is increased by 2 for  Duration: Until Long rest. Strength is decreased indefinitely by 1 after Long Rest.

browbeaten.name: Browbeaten
browbeaten.description: Affected entity has a +1 bonus to spell save DC while threatened.

bufotoxin.name: Bufotoxin
bufotoxin.description: Has  Disadvantage on  Dexterity saving throws.

bull_s_strength.name: Bull's Strength
bull_s_strength.description: Has  Advantage on Strength Checks. Weight Limit doubled.

burden_of_time.name: Burden of Time
burden_of_time.description: A nearby shadar-kai is imposing  Disadvantage on this creature's  Saving throws.

burden_of_time_aura.name: Burden of Time Aura
burden_of_time_aura.description: Beasts and Humanoids have  Disadvantage on Saving Throws while within  3 m / 10 ft of this creature. Elves are unaffected by this temporal magic.

burned_out_optics.name: Burned Out Optics
burned_out_optics.description: Affected entity's optical lens has been distorted, causing its vision become impaired. Entity recieves 1d6 penalty to Attack Rolls.

burning.name: Burning
burning.description: Takes 1d4Fire damage per turn. Can be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Potion or gaining  Wet. Immune from if  Wet.  Dip action can be used on Burning characters or objects.

burning_orthonic.name: Burning (Orthonic)
burning_orthonic.description: Takes 1d4Fire damage per turn. CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet.

burning_acid.name: Burning Acid
burning_acid.description: The hatchery waters burn through all those who'd intrude upon it.

burning_reflux.name: Burning Reflux
burning_reflux.description: Fire damage has ignited Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Fiery Regurgitation.

burst_of_accuracy.name: Burst of Accuracy
burst_of_accuracy.description: You have a +1d4 bonus to attack rolls after using Action Surge.

buthir_s_wrath.name: Buthir's Wrath
buthir_s_wrath.resistance: Slashing, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
buthir_s_wrath.description: Buthir is enraged! Strength increased by 4 and Armour Class reduced by 2. Tactician Difficulty: Buthir is enraged! Strength increased by 4, and has Resistance to all physical damage.

call_lightning.name: Call Lightning
call_lightning.description: Can  Call Lightning without expending a spell slot.

call_of_the_dark_lady.name: Call of the Dark Lady
call_of_the_dark_lady.description: When it starts its turn in a Lightly or Heavily Obscured area, the affected entity takes 1d4Necrotic. Attacks made by the Justiciar in its  Umbral Form deal an additional 1d6Necrotic damage to the entity.

calling_reinforcements.name: Calling Reinforcements
calling_reinforcements.description: This creature's allies will appear next turn to defend it.

calmed.name: Calmed
calmed.description: Can't be Charmed or Frightened, and can't  Rage.

castigated_by_divinity.name: Castigated By Divinity
castigated_by_divinity.description: Affected entity is cursed by transgressed and irritable gods. When it falls unconscious, it immediately dies. Moreover, when it dies, a terrible envoy of the offended deity is conjured from the entity's corpse.

cat_s_grace.name: Cat's Grace
cat_s_grace.description: Has  Advantage on Dexterity Checks. Takes half falling damage.

catatonic.name: Catatonic
catatonic.description: Art Cullagh has shut down and seems completely unresponsive to whatever is happening around him.

cattle_prattle.name: Cattle Prattle
cattle_prattle.description: Want to converse like a cow? Dolly Thrice will show you how.

caustic_brew.name: Caustic Brew
caustic_brew.description: Affected entity deals an additional 2d6Acid damage while infused with Thisobald's current brew.

caustic_retort.name: Caustic Retort
caustic_retort.description: Whenever you take damage, reflect it back at your attacker threefold as Acid damage.

celestial_haste.name: Celestial Haste
celestial_haste.description: Gain +2 to Armour Class Armour Class and Advantage on Dexterity  Saving throws. Movement Speed is doubled. Gain an additional Action.

chain_of_tyranny.name: Chain of Tyranny
chain_of_tyranny.description: Affected entity has only half its movement speed. When the chain breaks, it takes 8d8Force damage.

chains_of_karsus.name: Chains of Karsus
chains_of_karsus.description: The Netherbrain is too powerful for even the Momentary God's magic - Karsus' Compulsion could not dominate it completely. The spell has instead bound the brain's will in place temporarily. To complete the domination, you must strike it down.

champion_challenge.name: Champion Challenge
champion_challenge.description: Affected entity is compelled to attack the paladin that challenged them. Any attacks they might make against targets other than the paladin have  Disadvantage. Condition ends if the entity moves 9 m / 30 ft away from the paladin.

channel_divinity_cloak_of_shadows.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
channel_divinity_cloak_of_shadows.description: Has  Advantage on Attack rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

channelling_karsus_compulsion.name: Channelling Karsus' Compulsion
channelling_karsus_compulsion.description: Affected entity is focussing all their magic and effort on casting  Karsus' Compulsion until their next turn. Becoming  Incapacitated,  Stunned,  Polymorphed, or  Knocked Out ends the spell.

charged_lightning_tempest_steps.name: Charged Lightning: Tempest Steps
charged_lightning_tempest_steps.description: Wherever you walk, create a crackling explosion with 2 radius that deals 1d4Lightning.

charmed.name: Charmed
charmed.description: Cannot attack the spellcaster. The spellcaster has  Advantage on Charisma Checks in dialogue.

cheater_s_folly.name: Cheater's Folly
cheater_s_folly.description: Affected entity has all Ability Scores reduced by 1 for attacking a reflection that's not their own. This effect can be applied thrice more.

chest_trauma.name: Chest Trauma
chest_trauma.description: Has  Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws and has one fewer action. Removed by healing.

chicken_chaser.name: Chicken Chaser
chicken_chaser.description: Engrossed in a game of Chicken Chase.

chilled.name: Chilled
chilled.description: Affected entity is vulnerable to Cold damage and resistant to Fire damage. Applying  Wet to a chilled entity will make it  Frozen for  Duration: 1 turn.

chilling_grace.name: Chilling Grace
chilling_grace.description: Has Resistance to Fire damage as long as you have 50% hit points or less.

cindersnap_reflexes.name: Cindersnap Reflexes
cindersnap_reflexes.description: Ranged weapon attacks targeting this entity have  Disadvantage and their damage is halved.

clear_area.name: Clear Area
clear_area.description: Hiding in an unobscured area. Will be caught on sight.

click_heels.name: Click Heels
click_heels.description: Movement Speed is doubled. Enemies have  Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against them.

clinging_shadows.name: Clinging Shadows
clinging_shadows.description: While remaining obscured, affected entity has  Advantage on  Saving throws.

cloak_of_shadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
cloak_of_shadows.description: Has  Advantage on Attack rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Attacking, casting spells, or entering a brightly lit area ends this condition.

cloud_of_daggers.name: Cloud of Daggers
cloud_of_daggers.description: Takes 4d4Slashing per turn. This damage is increased by 2d4Slashing for for each spell slot level above 2nd used to cast  Cloud of Daggers.

cloudkill.name: Cloudkill
cloudkill.description: While it remains in the cloud, affected entity takes 5d8Poison damage every turn.

clown_face_paint.name: Clown Face-Paint
clown_face_paint.description: You are unaffected by  Hideous Laughter.

coated_in_arsonist_s_oil.name: Coated in Arsonist's Oil
coated_in_arsonist_s_oil.description: Coated in an oil that strips targets that are Resistant to Fire damage of their Resistance. Targets that are Immune to Fire damage are unaffected.

coated_in_basic_poison.name: Coated in Basic Poison
coated_in_basic_poison.description: Targets must succeed a DC 11  Constitution saving throw or become  Poisoned. On a successful save, target receives  Inoculated: Basic Poison for 2 turns.

coated_in_brewed_up_bellyglummer.name: Coated in Brewed-up Bellyglummer
coated_in_brewed_up_bellyglummer.description: Weapon is coated in Brewed-Up Bellyglummer. Targets must succeed a DC 17  Constitution saving throw or become  Poisoned.

coated_in_crawler_mucus.name: Coated in Crawler Mucus
coated_in_crawler_mucus.description: Targets must succeed a DC 13  Constitution saving throw or become  Stricken with Crawler Mucus. On a successful save, targets receive  Inoculated: Crawler Mucus for 2 turns

coated_in_diluted_oil_of_sharpness.name: Coated in Diluted Oil of Sharpness
coated_in_diluted_oil_of_sharpness.description: The arcane oil coating this weapon grants it a +1 bonus to Damage and Attack rolls. The weapon has become magical, so it can damage creatures that are immune to non-magical attacks.

coated_in_drow_poison.name: Coated in Drow Poison
coated_in_drow_poison.description: Targets must succeed a DC 13  Constitution saving throw or become  Poisoned and fall  Asleep. On a successful save, targets receive  Inoculated: Drow Poison for 2 turns.

coated_in_malice.name: Coated in Malice
coated_in_malice.description: Targets must succeed a DC 15  Constitution saving throw or become  Blinded and  Poisoned. Targets that succeed the saving throw are granted the  Inoculated: Malice condition for 2 turns.

coated_in_oil_of_bane.name: Coated in Oil of Bane
coated_in_oil_of_bane.description: Targets become  Baned for 2 turns unless they succeed a DC 11  Charisma saving throw.

coated_in_oil_of_combustion.name: Coated in Oil of Combustion
coated_in_oil_of_combustion.description: Coated in flammable oil. On a hit, the target is doused in oil for 2 turns. If it takes Fire damage, the oil immolates, dealing 3d6Fire damage in an area around it.

coated_in_oil_of_diminution.name: Coated in Oil of Diminution
coated_in_oil_of_diminution.description: Targets must succeed a DC 11  Constitution saving throw or receive  Disadvantage on  Strength checks and  Strength saving throws, as well as a -1d4 penalty to damage on melee attacks for 2 turns.

coated_in_oil_of_freezing.name: Coated in Oil of Freezing
coated_in_oil_of_freezing.description: Targets receive  Encrusted with Frost for 2 turns.

coated_in_purple_worm_toxin.name: Coated in Purple Worm Toxin
coated_in_purple_worm_toxin.description: Targets take 1d10Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a DC 19  Constitution saving throw.

coated_in_serpent_venom_toxin.name: Coated in Serpent Venom Toxin
coated_in_serpent_venom_toxin.description: Targets take 1d6Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a DC 13  Constitution saving throw.

coated_in_toxin.name: Coated in Toxin
coated_in_toxin.description: Targets take 1d4Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a DC 11  Constitution saving throw.

coated_in_wizardsbane_oil.name: Coated in Wizardsbane Oil
coated_in_wizardsbane_oil.description: Severely dampens the power of any spellcaster struck with this weapon. Targets receive a -3 penalty to spell Attack rolls and Spell Save DC, and  Disadvantage on  Saving throws for maintaining Concentration for 2 turns.

coated_in_wyvern_toxin.name: Coated in Wyvern Toxin
coated_in_wyvern_toxin.description: Targets take 1d8Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a DC 15  Constitution saving throw.

cocooned.name: Cocooned
cocooned.description: Trapped in a spider's web. Can't move or take Actions. Bonus Actions, or Reactions. This condition ends upon taking damage or if the entity makes a successful  Strength saving throw

coerced.name: Coerced
coerced.description: Forced to fight for Nere and takes 1d6Psychic each turn.

coin_cuirass.name: Coin Cuirass
coin_cuirass.description: Cursed coins have gathered around the Toll Collector's chest, increasing her overall health by 100.

coin_cuisse_r.name: Coin Cuisse (R)
coin_cuisse_r.description: Cursed coins have gathered around the Toll Collector's right leg, increasing her overall health by 100.

coin_cuisse_l.name: Coin Cuisse (L)
coin_cuisse_l.description: Cursed coins have gathered around the Toll Collector's left leg, increasing her overall health by 100.

coin_helmet.name: Coin Helmet
coin_helmet.description: Cursed coins have gathered around the Toll Collector's head, increasing her overall health by 100.

coin_vambrace_l.name: Coin Vambrace (L)
coin_vambrace_l.description: Cursed coins have gathered around the Toll Collector's left arm, increasing her overall health by 100. Additionally, she can use  Left Coin Whip.

coin_vambrace_r.name: Coin Vambrace (R)
coin_vambrace_r.description: Cursed coins have gathered around the Toll Collector's right arm, increasing her overall health by 100. Additionally, she can use  Right Coin Whip.

cold_brew.name: Cold Brew
cold_brew.description: Affected entity deals an additional 2d6Cold damage while infused with Thisobald's current brew.

cold_infusion.name: Cold Infusion
cold_infusion.description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d4Cold the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

cold_reflux.name: Cold Reflux
cold_reflux.description: Cold damage has chilled Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Icy Regurgitation.

cold_resistance_aura.name: Cold Resistance Aura
cold_resistance_aura.description: The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to Cold damage.

colour_spray.name: Colour Spray
colour_spray.description: Has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to  3 m / 10 ft. Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.

combat_inspiration.name: Combat Inspiration
combat_inspiration.description: Can use their Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d6 bonus to their next Attack roll,  Ability check, or  Saving throw They can also choose a +1d6 bonus to the damage their next weapon attack deals, or to their  Armour Class for one attack Bonus depends on the originating Bard's level Grants:  Valiant Roll (Toggleable Passive Feature): +1d6 bonus to the next  Ability check  Valiant Defence (Reaction): +1d6 bonus to the next  Saving throw or bonus to  Armour Class for the next attack  Valiant Attack (Reaction): +1d6 bonus to the next Attack roll  Valiant Damage (Reaction): +1d6 bonus damage to the next Weapon Attack

command_approach.name: Command: Approach
command_approach.description: Has to move toward the spellcaster using the shortest route possible. Cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.

command_flee.name: Command: Flee
command_flee.description: Has to move as far away from the spellcaster by the fastest available means. Cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.

command_grovel.name: Command: Grovel
command_grovel.description: Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on  Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attacks against a grovelling creature have  Advantage if they're made within  3 m / 10 ft of the creature.

command_halt.name: Command: Halt
command_halt.description: Cannot move. Cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.

compelled_duel.name: Compelled Duel
compelled_duel.description: Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against anyone but the caster.

compelled_to_duel.name: Compelled to Duel
compelled_to_duel.description: Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against anyone but the caster. Might start  Bleeding if struck by the Dueller.

conduit_of_kereska_s_ice.name: Conduit of Kereska's Ice
conduit_of_kereska_s_ice.description: Affected entity has resistance to Cold damage. Its cold spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus. When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of  Encrusted with Frost upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's ice, it can cast  Cone of Cold at 5th level and  Ice Storm at 4th level once per short rest.

confused.name: Confused
confused.description: Affected entity is hostile to everyone, wanders around aimlessly, and occasionally skips turns in its stupor

confused_stupor.name: Confused Stupor
confused_stupor.description: Too confused to act - affected entity wastes its turn doing nothing.

conquered.name: Conquered
conquered.description: If  Frightened, affected entity takes 5Psychic damage when starting its turn within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

constricted.name: Constricted
constricted.description: Affected entity can't move. Attack rolls against it have  Advantage, while its attack rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage. The entity takes 2d6 + 2 (4~14) Piercing and 1d4 (1~4) Necrotic per turn. Can be removed by  Help.

constricting.name: Constricting
constricting.description: Wrapped around a target to  Constrict it and can't move.

contagion_poisoned.name: Contagion Poisoned
contagion_poisoned.description: Has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Checks. Each turn, it must succeed on a  Saving throw, or the poison will advance in stage. On 3 successes, it recovers. On 3 failures, it contracts the disease corresponding to the variant of the spell Contagion that was cast.

continual_flame.name: Continual Flame
continual_flame.description: Enveloped in flames that produce no heat and never seem to die out. Identical to the effect of  Light

controlled.name: Controlled
controlled.description: This undead is under the control of a Paladin. It will follow the Paladin and attack their enemies.

controlling_undead.name: Controlling Undead
controlling_undead.description: This paladin has control over an undead creature. The creature will follow them and attack their enemies.

corrosive_spit_dissolved.name: Corrosive Spit: Dissolved
corrosive_spit_dissolved.description: The spit can be removed with water.

corrosive_spit_dissolving.name: Corrosive Spit: Dissolving
corrosive_spit_dissolving.description: Takes 1d10Acid damage per turn. The spit will keep eating away at its defences, further reducing its Armour Class, unless it is washed away with water.

cosmic_omen_ability_check.name: Cosmic Omen: Ability Check
cosmic_omen_ability_check.description: Gains a  +1d6 bonus to  Ability checks.

countercharm.name: Countercharm
countercharm.description: You have  Advantage on Saving Throws against being  Charmed or  Frightened.

countercharm_aura.name: Countercharm Aura
countercharm_aura.description: You and allies within 9 m / 30 ft have  Advantage on  Saving throws against being Charmed and Frightened.

covert_critical.name: Covert Critical
covert_critical.description: As long as the affected entity remains obscured, the number it needs to Attack roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

crackling_with_kereska_s_lightning.name: Crackling with Kereska's Lightning
crackling_with_kereska_s_lightning.description: Affected entity has resistance to Lightning damage. Its lightning spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus. When it deals spell damage, it gains 2  Lightning Charges. While attuned to Kereska's lightning, it can cast  Chain Lightning at 6th level and  Lightning Bolt at 3rd level once per short rest.

craven_heart.name: Craven Heart
craven_heart.description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its Craven Heart by bravely ending its turn within  3 m / 10 ft of Viconia without using any actions or bonus actions.

crawling_gnaw.name: Crawling Gnaw
crawling_gnaw.description: Target is inflicted with zombie mucus. If the affected entity dies before the infection wears off, it will temporarily rise as a Newborn Zombie. Newborn Zombies are statistically the same as the Summoned Zombie, except that they only have 10 Hit Points, and they have the condition  Newborn Zombie, causing them to take 1Necrotic damage per turn. Newborn Zombies will follow the original Summoned Zombie.

critical_hit.name: Critical Hit!
critical_hit.description: You've critically hit an opponent, dealing more damage.

crown_of_madness.name: Crown of Madness
crown_of_madness.description: Instilled with magical madness. Will attack the nearest creature, other than the spellcaster.

crusader_s_mantle.name: Crusader's Mantle
crusader_s_mantle.description: Near a paladin's holy aura. Weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4Radiant.

crusader_s_mantle_aura.name: Crusader's Mantle Aura
crusader_s_mantle_aura.description: Emitting a holy aura. You and your nearby allies' weapon attacks of nearby allies deal an additional 1d4Radiant.

crystal_skin.name: Crystal Skin
crystal_skin.description: Affected entity has Resistance to all elemental damage.

curative_antidote.name: Curative Antidote
curative_antidote.description: A powerful antidote courses through your veins. You have  Advantage on  Saving throw against being  Poisoned.

curdled_liver.name: Curdled Liver
curdled_liver.description: Mystic Carrion is not vulnerable to fire damage while his liver is intact.

curse_of_regret.name: Curse of Regret
curse_of_regret.description: Takes 1d4+1Psychic every turn, and is vulnerable to Psychic damage. Deal damage to remove this condition.

curse_of_the_dire_raven.name: Curse of the Dire Raven
curse_of_the_dire_raven.description: Marked by the feather of a dire raven. Attack rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage.

curse_of_the_sired.name: Curse of the Sired
curse_of_the_sired.description: Cursed by a victim he brought to Cazador many years ago, Astarion receives  Disadvantage on all  Saving throws.

cursed_skull.name: Cursed Skull
cursed_skull.description: This skull is cursed with necromantic powers that shoots thunderwaves.

cursed_vengeance.name: Cursed Vengeance
cursed_vengeance.description: Any damage done against Oliver will be reflected twofold at the attacker.

cursed_additional_damage.name: Cursed: Additional Damage
cursed_additional_damage.description: Receives an additional 1d8Necrotic damage from the spellcaster's attacks or spells.

cursed_attack_disadvantage.name: Cursed: Attack Disadvantage
cursed_attack_disadvantage.description: Has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against the source of the curse.

cursed_charisma.name: Cursed: Charisma
cursed_charisma.description: Has  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Charisma.

cursed_constitution.name: Cursed: Constitution
cursed_constitution.description: Has  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Constitution.

cursed_dexterity.name: Cursed: Dexterity
cursed_dexterity.description: Has  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Dexterity.

cursed_dread.name: Cursed: Dread
cursed_dread.description: Each turn, the affected entity has to succeed on a Wisdom  Saving throw or skip its turn.

cursed_intelligence.name: Cursed: Intelligence
cursed_intelligence.description: Has  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Intelligence.

cursed_strength.name: Cursed: Strength
cursed_strength.description: Has  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Strength.

cursed_wisdom.name: Cursed: Wisdom
cursed_wisdom.skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
cursed_wisdom.description: Has  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Wisdom.

daredevil_proximity.name: Daredevil Proximity
daredevil_proximity.description: Your Ranged Spell Attacks are made as melee spell attacks when you are adjacent to a hostile creature.

dark_lady_s_awareness.name: Dark Lady's Awareness
dark_lady_s_awareness.description: Has earned Shar's approval through an impressive display of good sense. Has a +5 bonus to Wisdom until finishing a Long Rest

dark_lady_s_erudition.name: Dark Lady's Erudition
dark_lady_s_erudition.description: Has earned Shar's approval through an impressive display of wit. Has a +5 bonus to Intelligence until finishing a Long Rest

dark_lady_s_fool.name: Dark Lady's Fool
dark_lady_s_fool.description: Has earned Shar's condemnation while failing to impress her with their wit. Has a -5 penalty to Intelligence until finishing a Long Rest.

dark_lady_s_grace.name: Dark Lady's Grace
dark_lady_s_grace.description: Has earned Shar's approval through their charming nature. Has a +5 bonus to Charisma until finishing a Long Rest

dark_lady_s_ire.name: Dark Lady's Ire
dark_lady_s_ire.description: Has earned Shar's condemnation due to a poor display of charm. Has a -5 penalty to Charisma until finishing a Long Rest.

dark_lady_s_reckoning.name: Dark Lady's Reckoning
dark_lady_s_reckoning.description: Has earned Shar's condemnation by showing a lack of judgement. Has a -5 penalty to Wisdom until finishing a Long Rest.

dark_one_s_blessing.name: Dark One's Blessing
dark_one_s_blessing.description: Gained  temporary hit points equal to its Charisma modifier and Warlock level combined.

darkveil_precision.name: Darkveil Precision
darkveil_precision.description: As long as it remains obscured, the affected entity has a +1d4 bonus to ranged Attack rolls.

darkvision.name: Darkvision
darkvision.description: Can see in the dark out to the range of  12 m / 40 ft.

darkvision_third_eye.name: Darkvision (Third Eye)
darkvision_third_eye.description: Can see in the dark out to the range of  24 m / 80 ft.

daylight.name: Daylight
daylight.description: Shining with the light of the sun. Dispels Darkness within a radius of 15 m / 50 ft. The Enchant Item version of this spell requires the target creature have a Weapon in their main hand.

dazed.name: Dazed
dazed.description: Has  Disadvantage on Wisdom  Saving throws, can't take Reactions, and loses the Dexterity bonus to their  Armour Class. Removed if an ally Helps this creature.

dazzling_ray.name: Dazzling Ray
dazzling_ray.description: The affected creature can fire a  Dazzling Ray.

deadly_orders.name: Deadly Orders
deadly_orders.description: Affected entity was ordered to attack a specific enemy. It is more likely to target this enemy, and Attack Rolls against the enemy have  Advantage.

death_ward.name: Death Ward
death_ward.description: The next time damage would reduce the affected entity to 0 Hit Points. it remains conscious with 1 Hit Point left.

death_wish.name: Death Wish
death_wish.description: Creature carries a powder keg. It could explode at any moment.

deathbringer_s_legacy.name: Deathbringer's Legacy
deathbringer_s_legacy.description: Sarevok is able to use  Deathbringer Assault until the end of his next turn. Orin can use  Deathbringer Assault (Orin) until the end of her next turn.

defensive_protocol_bulwark.name: Defensive Protocol: Bulwark
defensive_protocol_bulwark.description: While in this defensive state, the Steel Watcher becomes  Unyielding and can use its  Repair Matrix,  Hellfire Missiles and  Repelling Protocol. Also grants  75 temporary hit points. If the Steel Watcher loses these temporary hit points, he automatically uses  Terminate Bulwark Protocol and loses this condition. If hit by a Flashblinder, the Steel Watcher loses this condition.

defensive_stance.name: Defensive Stance
defensive_stance.description: You have +1 bonus to Armour Class Armour Class and Saving throw Saving throws.

demonspirit.name: Demonspirit
demonspirit.description: Affected entity's summoned creature has Resistance to all damage except Psychic. At the start of the summoned creature's turn, it must succeed a  Wisdom saving throw or be driven Mad.

demonspirit_aura.name: Demonspirit Aura
demonspirit_aura.description: Affected entity's summoned creature has Resistance to all damage except Psychic. At the start of the summoned creature's turn, it must succeed a  Wisdom saving throw or be driven Mad.

demonspirit_madness.name: Demonspirit Madness
demonspirit_madness.description: Affected entity has been driven to a frenzy by magical madness. It will attack the nearest creature on its turn. At the end of each turn, the affected entity makes a  Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the condition is removed.

despair.name: Despair
despair.description: Despondency from deep within the Shadowfell has perforated your very being.

despair_apathy.name: Despair: Apathy
despair_apathy.description: Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Saving Throws using Dexterity.

despair_dread.name: Despair: Dread
despair_dread.description: Disadvantage on all Ability Checks and Saving Throws.

despair_madness.name: Despair: Madness
despair_madness.description: You are wracked with despondent madness that imposes  Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks and Wisdom, Intelligence, Charisma, and Dexterity Saving Throws.

detect_thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
detect_thoughts.description: The affected creature can read the thoughts of certain creatures while talking to them.

detecting_presence.name: Detecting Presence
detecting_presence.description: Searching for Invisible creatures within  Range: 3 m / 10 ft Creatures must make a  Dexterity saving throw or become  Revealed. Uses the affected entity's Spell Save DC.

detonation_impending.name: Detonation Impending!
detonation_impending.description: This Steel Watcher is preparing to  Self-Detonate.

devilishly_strong.name: Devilishly Strong
devilishly_strong.skills: Athletics, Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth
devilishly_strong.description: While within  18 m / 60 ft of Raphael, this creature's weapon attacks deal an additional 3d6Piercing damage and it has  Advantage on Strength and Dexterity Checks and attacks.

devoured_intellect.name: Devoured Intellect
devoured_intellect.description: Intelligence has been reduced by 1 per turn.

devouring_brain.name: Devouring Brain
devouring_brain.description: The starving illithid is fully focused on eating its first brain in an age. Consuming the brain provides the equivalent of one Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen.

diamond_scales.name: Diamond Scales
diamond_scales.description: This creature has  100 temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points:It is grounded. Any damage lower than 15 will not affect it. It can use  Shredding Scales immediately after being hit for the first time in a round.

digestive_juices.name: Digestive Juices
digestive_juices.description: While doused in corrosive digestive juice, this creature takes 1d6Acid per turn, is Vulnerable to Piercing and Bludgeoning damage, and can be  Devoured if it is also  Restrained. Water can wash off these juices.

dirty_advantage.name: Dirty Advantage
dirty_advantage.description: Gain  Advantage on your next attack.

disarmed.name: Disarmed
disarmed.description: Affected entity has dropped its weapon to the ground, similar to  Weapon Dropped!.

disengage.name: Disengage
disengage.description: Can move without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

disintegrating_corpse.name: Disintegrating Corpse
disintegrating_corpse.description: This corpse is not long for this world. The affected entity's corpse disintegrates into a pile of ash upon death.

dislocated_shoulder.name: Dislocated Shoulder
dislocated_shoulder.description: The affected entity has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls. Removed by taking a Long Rest.

dispel_evil_and_good.name: Dispel Evil and Good
dispel_evil_and_good.description: Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against this creature. Additionally, it can also break otherworldly Enchantments that  Charm,  Frighten, or  Possesses allies.

displace.name: Displace
displace.description: Creatures suffering Falling damage as a result of your actions take an additional 1d8Psychic damage.

displaced.name: Displaced
displaced.description: Until you take damage, foes have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against you.

displacer_beast_form.name: Displacer Beast Form
displacer_beast_form.description: Affected entity has adopted the eldritch pantherlike form of a displace beast.

distracted.name: Distracted
distracted.description: Not paying any attention to their surroundings. The distractor's allies have  Advantage on their next Attack Roll against the creature.

distressed.name: Distressed
distressed.description: The owlbear has sustained damage to its eye. It cannot make Critical Hit and has  Disadvantage on Perception Ability Checks.

divine_favour.name: Divine Favour
divine_favour.description: Your weapons deal an additional 1d4Radiant damage.

divine_sense.name: Divine Sense
divine_sense.description: Has  Advantage on Attack Rolls against celestials, fiends, and undead.

dominated.name: Dominated
dominated.description: Affected entity will follow and fight alongside the caster of this spell. Every time it takes damage, it may break the caster's control over it with a successful Wisdom  Saving throw.

dominated_dominate_beast.name: Dominated (Dominate_Beast)
dominated_dominate_beast.description: Affected entity will follow and fight alongside the caster of this spell. Every time it takes damage, it may break the caster's control over it with a successful Wisdom  Saving throw.

dominated_will.name: Dominated Will
dominated_will.description: The affected entity is under the control of a nearby True Soul.

downed.name: Downed
downed.description: If you reach 0 hit points, you fall Unconscious and must make Death Saving Throws. On 3 successes, you stop bleeding out and become Stable. On 3 failures, you  die. Any damage you receive while unconscious counts as one failure. If you regain any Hit Points, the condition is removed. If an ally helps you, you regain 1 hit point.

draconic_prowess_acid.name: Draconic Prowess: Acid
draconic_prowess_acid.description: Affected entity has  Advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion Checks, Resistance to Acid damage, and can use  Acid Arrow once until its next Long Rest.

draconic_prowess_fire.name: Draconic Prowess: Fire
draconic_prowess_fire.description: Affected entity has  Advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion Checks, Resistance to Fire damage, and can use  Fireball once until its next Long Rest.

draconic_prowess_frost.name: Draconic Prowess: Frost
draconic_prowess_frost.description: Affected entity has  Advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion Checks, Resistance to Cold damage, and can use  Ice Storm once until its next Long Rest.

draconic_prowess_lightning.name: Draconic Prowess: Lightning
draconic_prowess_lightning.description: Affected entity has  Advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion Checks, Resistance to Lightning damage, and can use  Lightning Bolt once until its next Long Rest.

draconic_prowess_poison.name: Draconic Prowess: Poison
draconic_prowess_poison.description: Affected entity has  Advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion Checks, Resistance to Poison damage, and can use  Ray of Sickness once until its next Long Rest.

drained.name: Drained
drained.description: Affected entity's lifeforce has been drained by the incubus, reducing its maximum hit points by  15 hit points.

dread_ambusher.name: Dread Ambusher
dread_ambusher.description: Movement speed increased by 10ft. Affected entity can also make an extra weapon attack that deals an additional 1d8 damage.

dream_mist_apparitions.name: Dream Mist Apparitions
dream_mist_apparitions.description: This creature is seeing myriad visions of a world beyond reckoning - or so they keep insisting. The affected entity is incapacitated.

drenched.name: Drenched
drenched.description: Your melee attacks inflict  Wet on the target.

drunk.name: Drunk
drunk.skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
drunk.description: Has  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma Checks.

drunk_drunken_master.name: Drunk (Drunken Master)
drunk_drunken_master.description: Although drunk, you are immune to the negative effects of alcohol, thanks to your training in the Way of the Drunken Master.

drunken_technique.name: Drunken Technique
drunken_technique.description: You gain an additional 3 m / 10 ft movement and can move without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

duel_murder_s_chosen.name: Duel: Murder's Chosen
duel_murder_s_chosen.description: The Dark Urge is compelled to fight Orin alone. The duellists cannot be forcefully moved, and any interference from other parties will be punished.

duergar_antidote.name: Duergar Antidote
duergar_antidote.description: Has  Advantage on  Saving throws against being Poisoned and Resistance to Poison damage.

dwarven_resilience.name: Dwarven Resilience
dwarven_resilience.description: Affected entity has Proficiency in  Saving throws until it makes three successful Saving Throws or until it takes a Long Rest.

dying.name: Dying
dying.description: This creature is dying. It will not move, take actions, or respond to damage in any way. Attacks at melee range are guaranteed to hit and be critical hits. Ranged attacks have  Advantage.

earthen_siphon.name: Earthen Siphon
earthen_siphon.description: A nearby earth myrmidon grants the affected entity Immunity to Poison damage and an additional 3d8Poison damage to  Elemental Rebuke. The affected entity also gains temporary access to  Chromatic Orb: Poison and an additional  Reaction per turn.

edict_of_the_old_lord_skull.name: Edict of the Old Lord Skull
edict_of_the_old_lord_skull.description: The Deathless One protects his fetid flock. Myrkul grants the affected entity  Necrotic Veil every turn.

eggbearer.name: Eggbearer
eggbearer.description: Carries an owlbear's egg. Its scent will attract the egg's mother.

electrified_reflux.name: Electrified Reflux
electrified_reflux.description: Lightning damage has charged Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Electrified Regurgitation.

electrocuted.name: Electrocuted
electrocuted.description: Takes 1d4Lightning damage at the start of each turn.

elemental_affinity_acid_resistance.name: Elemental Affinity: Acid Resistance
elemental_affinity_acid_resistance.description: You are Resistant to Acid damage.

elemental_affinity_cold_resistance.name: Elemental Affinity: Cold Resistance
elemental_affinity_cold_resistance.description: You are Resistant to Cold damage.

elemental_affinity_fire_resistance.name: Elemental Affinity: Fire Resistance
elemental_affinity_fire_resistance.description: You are Resistant to Fire damage.

elemental_affinity_lightning_resistance.name: Elemental Affinity: Lightning Resistance
elemental_affinity_lightning_resistance.description: You are Resistant to Lightning damage.

elemental_affinity_poison_resistance.name: Elemental Affinity: Poison Resistance
elemental_affinity_poison_resistance.description: You are Resistant to Poison damage.

elemental_cleaver_acid.name: Elemental Cleaver: Acid
elemental_cleaver_acid.description: Channelling primordial might. Until the end of your  Rage, your weapon will deal an additional 1d6Acid and gain the  Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.

elemental_cleaver_cold.name: Elemental Cleaver: Cold
elemental_cleaver_cold.description: Channelling primordial might. Until the end of your  Rage, your weapon will deal an additional 1d6Cold and gain the  Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.

elemental_cleaver_fire.name: Elemental Cleaver: Fire
elemental_cleaver_fire.description: Channelling primordial might. Until the end of your  Rage, your weapon will deal an additional 1d6Fire and gain the  Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.

elemental_cleaver_lightning.name: Elemental Cleaver: Lightning
elemental_cleaver_lightning.description: Channelling primordial might. Until the end of your  Rage, your weapon will deal an additional 1d6Lightning and gain the  Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.

elemental_cleaver_thunder.name: Elemental Cleaver: Thunder
elemental_cleaver_thunder.description: Channelling primordial might. Until the end of your  Rage, your weapon will deal an additional 1d6Thunder and gain the  Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.

elemental_weapon_acid.name: Elemental Weapon: Acid
elemental_weapon_acid.description: Has a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4Acid damage.

elemental_weapon_cold.name: Elemental Weapon: Cold
elemental_weapon_cold.description: Has a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4Cold damage.

elemental_weapon_fire.name: Elemental Weapon: Fire
elemental_weapon_fire.description: Has a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4Fire damage.

elemental_weapon_lightning.name: Elemental Weapon: Lightning
elemental_weapon_lightning.description: Has a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4Lightning damage.

elemental_weapon_thunder.name: Elemental Weapon: Thunder
elemental_weapon_thunder.description: Has a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4Thunder damage.

elixir_of_arcane_cultivation.name: Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
elixir_of_arcane_cultivation.description: Has an additional  Level 1 Spell Slot.

elixir_of_battlemage_s_power.name: Elixir of Battlemage's Power
elixir_of_battlemage_s_power.description: Affected entity has  Arcane Acuity until its next Long Rest. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.Gain Arcane Acuity for  Duration: 3 turns. Arcane Acuity cannot go below  Duration: 3 turns.

elixir_of_bloodlust.name: Elixir of Bloodlust
elixir_of_bloodlust.description: Affected entity has entered a murderous state of bloodlust. Once per turn, when it kills an enemy, it gains  5 temporary hit points and an  Action.

elixir_of_darkvision.name: Elixir of Darkvision
elixir_of_darkvision.description: Can see in the dark up to  12 m / 40 ft.

elixir_of_heroism.name: Elixir of Heroism
elixir_of_heroism.description: Affected entity is granted a  1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and  Saving throws until the next long rest.

elixir_of_peerless_focus.name: Elixir of Peerless Focus
elixir_of_peerless_focus.description: Affected entity's ability to maintain its spells has increased. It has  Advantage to  Saving throws against being charmed and for maintaining  Concentration. Magic can't put it to  Sleep.

elixir_of_the_colossus.name: Elixir of The Colossus
elixir_of_the_colossus.description: Size is increased Weapons deal an additional  1d4 damage, and the affected entity has  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Carrying capacity is also increased by 25%.

elixir_of_viciousness.name: Elixir of Viciousness
elixir_of_viciousness.description: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

elixir_of_vigilance.name: Elixir of Vigilance
elixir_of_vigilance.description: Affected entity has a +5 bonus to initiative and can't be  Surprised. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

elven_elegance.name: Elven Elegance
elven_elegance.description: Noble elven arcana grants the affected entity an additional  10 m / 33 ft movement speed,  Superior Darkvision, and can't be  Charmed until its next Long Rest.

enchanted_security.name: Enchanted Security
enchanted_security.description: Intricate arcane lockmaking prevents  Knock spells from opening this safe.

encrusted_with_frost.name: Encrusted with Frost
encrusted_with_frost.description: Affected entity has  Disadvantage on Dexterity  Saving throws. When there are 7 or more turns remaining, the entity must succeed a DC 12  Constitution saving throw or take 1d4Cold and become  Frozen. On a successful save, it only takes half damage. Afterward, the frost sloughs away. Removed by  Burning.

encumbered.name: Encumbered
encumbered.description: Carrying too much weight. Movement Speed reduced by  3 m / 10 ft, and Jump distance is halved.

endless_rage.name: Endless Rage
endless_rage.description: Confers all the normal bonuses and resistances of the Rage variant of the Barbarian's chosen subclass, plus:Deal an additional 1d4Physical damage with weapon attacks (damage type inherited from equipped weapon) Suffer 1d4Psychic damage per turn  Rage does not end until the Barbarian uses the End Rage Bonus Action or becomes incapacitated.

enemy_of_justice.name: Enemy of Justice
enemy_of_justice.description: Wanted for killing a guard. Allied guards will attack on sight, but Disguise Self will fool them.

enlarged.name: Enlarged
enlarged.description: Size is increased. Weapon attacks deal  1d4 more damage. Has  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws.

ensnared.name: Ensnared
ensnared.description: Cannot move and takes 1d6Piercing damage per turn. Attack rolls against the creature have  Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

entangled.name: Entangled
entangled.description: Cannot move. Attack rolls against the creature have  Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

enthralled.name: Enthralled
enthralled.description: Peripheral vision reduced. Will keep looking at the spellcaster.

entranced_murderer.name: Entranced Murderer
entranced_murderer.description: Affected entity has been entranced by the Farslayer. Defeating the Farslayer will break the trance and garner you victory.

entropic_ward.name: Entropic Ward
entropic_ward.description: Missed an attack on a warlock. The warlock has  Advantage on their next Attack roll against the affected entity.

enwebbed.name: Enwebbed
enwebbed.description: Cannot move. Attack rolls against the creature have  Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws are rolled with  Disadvantage.

ephemeral_whispers.name: Ephemeral Whispers
ephemeral_whispers.description: Tempted by Ethel's whispers. This creature must succeed a DC 13  Wisdom saving throw at the start of their turn or be inflicted with  Hag's Pawn.

eternally_bound.name: Eternally Bound
eternally_bound.immunity: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
eternally_bound.description: Cazador will not let this spawn die - it is Immune to all damage.

ether_essence_slumber.name: Ether-Essence Slumber
ether_essence_slumber.description: A deep, dream-ridden sleep has overcome the creature, induced by judicious ingesting of Ether. The creature cannot move or act.
