The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity  Saving throws. Attack rolls against the creature have  Advantage Removed by taking damage or being Shoved.

ethereal_escape.name: Ethereal Escape
ethereal_escape.description: As a  Reaction to receiving damage, the incubus has travelled to the Ethereal Plane and can't be damaged or targeted until it returns at the start of its next turn.

evasive_footwork.name: Evasive Footwork
evasive_footwork.description: Enemies have  Disadvantage on melee attacks against the affected entity.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: Spurred on by bloodlust. Next Attack roll will be a Critical Hit.

exhausted.name: Exhausted
exhausted.description: Lack of rest has left you exhausted. There are six levels of exhaustion, and each level is worse than the last. Completing a Long Rest reduces your exhaustion level by 1.

expeditious_retreat.name: Expeditious Retreat
expeditious_retreat.description: Dash available as a Bonus Action.

exploding_flumph.name: Exploding Flumph
exploding_flumph.description: This spirit will explode at the end of the turn. Each creature within  2 m / 7 ft must succeed a Dexterity  Saving throw or take 1d6Force.

explosion_imminent.name: Explosion Imminent!
explosion_imminent.description: The freezing sphere will explode, casting  Otiluke's Freezing Sphere.

explosive_hoard.name: Explosive Hoard
explosive_hoard.description: This mound of coins is primed to explode.

exposing_bite.name: Exposing Bite
exposing_bite.description: Creature is distracted. The next attack against the creature from within 2 m / 7 ft is guaranteed to be a critical hit.

extra_bonus_action.name: Extra Bonus Action
extra_bonus_action.description: Grants an additional  Bonus Action on this turn.

eyebite.name: Eyebite
eyebite.description: Entity can recast  Eyebite without expending a spell slot.

eyebite_sickened.name: Eyebite: Sickened
eyebite_sickened.description: Affected entity has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Checks

eyes_of_the_dark.name: Eyes of the Dark
eyes_of_the_dark.description: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of 25 m / 83 ft.

faerie_fire.name: Faerie Fire
faerie_fire.description: Shedding dim light. Incoming attacks have  Advantage. Cannot be Invisible.

false_heart.name: False Heart
false_heart.description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its False Heart by  Silencing itself.

false_life.name: False Life
false_life.description: Gain  7 temporary hit points plus 5 additional for each spell slot level above the first.

faltering_will.name: Faltering Will
faltering_will.description: Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws until Long Rest.

fangs_of_the_fire_snake.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
fangs_of_the_fire_snake.description: Affected entity's fists are flickering with flame. Its melee attacks deal an additional 1d4Fire damage.

favoured_weapon.name: Favoured Weapon
favoured_weapon.description: This weapon has +1 bonus to damage and attack rolls.

fear_aura.name: Fear Aura
fear_aura.description: The affected creature can  Frighten nearby beasts and humanoids with its fey presence.

fearful.name: Fearful
fearful.description: Has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack rolls. It must run from the source of its fear and cannot take any additional actions. Targets can make a  Saving throw to shake off this effect if they end their turn out of sight from their source of fear.

feather_fall.name: Feather Fall
feather_fall.description: Rate of falling is slowed, granting Immunity to Falling damage.

feeble.name: Feeble
feeble.description: Deal only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength. At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Constitution  Saving throw to end this condition.

feigning_death.name: Feigning Death
feigning_death.resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Radiant, Thunder
feigning_death.description: Has sunk into a magical coma deep enough to imitate death Resistant to all damage except Psychic damage, and Disease and Poison no longer have any effect Removed when Helped

festering_frenzy.name: Festering Frenzy
festering_frenzy.description: This gnoll will become  Frenzied at the start of his next turn.

festering_spores.name: Festering Spores
festering_spores.description: While  Symbiotic Entity is active you can spread  Bibberbang Spores,  Timmask Spores, and  Haste Spores.

fetcher_s_favour.name: Fetcher's Favour
fetcher_s_favour.description: Equipped with  Mol's tricks of the trade, affected creatures can cast  Rays of Fire, reduce all Fire damage by 5 and gain an additional 1d4 to Charisma Checks and Saving Throws.

fetid_aura.name: Fetid Aura
fetid_aura.description: All nearby creatures fall victim to the ooze's Fetid Fumes and 1d6Acid per turn.

fetid_fumes.name: Fetid Fumes
fetid_fumes.description: 1d6 (1~6) Acid The fumes emanating from the Fetid Ooze eat away at the affected entity, so long as it stays within  2 m / 7 ft. 1d6Acid at the start of each round.

feverish.name: Feverish
feverish.description: Increasingly feverish.  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Strength. When the duration ends, make a DC 15  Constitution saving throw. Failing will inflict the condition  Filth Fever.

feywild_sparks.name: Feywild Sparks
feywild_sparks.description: While  Tides of Chaos is active, the affected entity will always trigger its  Wild Magic Surge when casting spells.

fiendish_obeisance.name: Fiendish Obeisance
fiendish_obeisance.description: Affected entity must obey the commands of the fiend directly controlling it.

fiendish_obeisance_kneel.name: Fiendish Obeisance: Kneel
fiendish_obeisance_kneel.description: Affected entity has been compelled to kneel by a fiend. It cannot move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving throws. Attacks against it have  Advantage if they're made within  3 m / 10 ft of the entity. The entity must spend half its movement speed to stand up.

fiendish_resilience_acid.name: Fiendish Resilience: Acid
fiendish_resilience_acid.description: You have Resistance to Acid damage.

fiendish_resilience_bludgeoning.name: Fiendish Resilience: Bludgeoning
fiendish_resilience_bludgeoning.description: You have Resistance to Bludgeoning damage.

fiendish_resilience_cold.name: Fiendish Resilience: Cold
fiendish_resilience_cold.description: You have Resistance to Cold damage.

fiendish_resilience_fire.name: Fiendish Resilience: Fire
fiendish_resilience_fire.description: You have Resistance to Fire damage.

fiendish_resilience_force.name: Fiendish Resilience: Force
fiendish_resilience_force.description: You have Resistance to Force damage.

fiendish_resilience_lightning.name: Fiendish Resilience: Lightning
fiendish_resilience_lightning.description: You have Resistance to Lightning damage.

fiendish_resilience_necrotic.name: Fiendish Resilience: Necrotic
fiendish_resilience_necrotic.description: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

fiendish_resilience_piercing.name: Fiendish Resilience: Piercing
fiendish_resilience_piercing.description: You have Resistance to Piercing damage.

fiendish_resilience_poison.name: Fiendish Resilience: Poison
fiendish_resilience_poison.description: You have Resistance to Poison damage.

fiendish_resilience_psychic.name: Fiendish Resilience: Psychic
fiendish_resilience_psychic.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

fiendish_resilience_radiant.name: Fiendish Resilience: Radiant
fiendish_resilience_radiant.description: You have Resistance to Radiant damage.

fiendish_resilience_slashing.name: Fiendish Resilience: Slashing
fiendish_resilience_slashing.description: You have Resistance to Slashing damage.

fiendish_resilience_thunder.name: Fiendish Resilience: Thunder
fiendish_resilience_thunder.description: You have Resistance to Thunder damage.

fiendish_vice.name: Fiendish Vice
fiendish_vice.description: Affected entity can call on diabolic arcana to cast  Thaumaturgy,  Hellish Rebuke,  Burning Hands, and  Flame Blade once each until the next Long Rest.

fierce_perilous_stakes.name: Fierce Perilous Stakes
fierce_perilous_stakes.vulnerability: Cold, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
fierce_perilous_stakes.description: Affected entity's attacks deal an additional 15Psychic damage and heal 2d8hit points. The entity scores a Critical Hit when rolling a 15 or higher. The entity is Vulnerable to all damage.

fiery_brew.name: Fiery Brew
fiery_brew.description: Affected entity deals an additional 2d6Fire damage while infused with Thisobald's current brew.

filth_fever.name: Filth Fever
filth_fever.description: Crushed by fever.  Disadvantage on Attack rolls, and  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Strength. When the duration ends, make a DC 15  Constitution saving throw. Failing will re-inflict the Filth Fever condition.  Duration: 25 turns

fire_infusion.name: Fire Infusion
fire_infusion.description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d4Fire the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

fire_resistance.name: Fire Resistance
fire_resistance.description: You gain Resistance to Fire damage, and can no longer  Burn.

fire_resistance_aura.name: Fire Resistance Aura
fire_resistance_aura.description: The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to Fire damage.

fire_shield_chill.name: Fire Shield: Chill
fire_shield_chill.description: Wreathed in ice-cold flames. Sheds light in a 3m / 10ft radius. Has Resistance to Fire damage. Deals 2d8Cold damage to anyone who hits with a melee attack.

fire_shield_warm.name: Fire Shield: Warm
fire_shield_warm.description: Wreathed in scorching flames. Sheds light in a 3m / 10ft radius. Has Resistance to Cold damage. Deals 2d8Fire damage to anyone who hits with a melee attack.

firewine_belly.name: Firewine Belly
firewine_belly.skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
firewine_belly.description: Drunk on Firewine. Has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity Checks If the drunk entity is killed with Fire, a  Firewine Explosion occurs.

flame_feeble.name: Flame-Feeble
flame_feeble.description: Affected entity is Vulnerable to Fire damage.

flaming_aura.name: Flaming Aura
flaming_aura.description: Creature is standing within  1.5 m / 5 ft of a flaming sphere and will take 2d6Fire at the end of its turn. On a successful save, it will still take half damage.

flaming_sphere.name: Flaming Sphere
flaming_sphere.description: Enemies and objects within  1.5 m / 5 ft of the sphere at end of their turn take  2d6 (2~12) Fire  damage. On a successful save, it still takes half damage.

fleeting_protection.name: Fleeting Protection
fleeting_protection.description: If the affected entity is attacked with Radiant damage, Raphael's protection reflects twice that amount as Fire damage and this condition ends.

flesh_rot.name: Flesh Rot
flesh_rot.vulnerability: Cold, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
flesh_rot.description: Flesh is decaying.  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Charisma. Vulnerable to all damage. DC 15  Constitution saving throw to remove condition when the duration ends, otherwise it is reapplied.

flesh_to_stone_restrained_stage_1.name: Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 1
flesh_to_stone_restrained_stage_1.description: Affected entity cannot move as its body begins to petrify over the course of 3 turns. Attack rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

flesh_to_stone_restrained_stage_2.name: Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 2
flesh_to_stone_restrained_stage_2.description: Affected entity cannot move as its body progresses toward petrification. Attack rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

flesh_to_stone_restrained_stage_3.name: Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 3
flesh_to_stone_restrained_stage_3.description: Affected entity cannot move as its body enters the final bone-stiffening stages of petrification. Attack rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

flight.name: Flight
flight.description: Fly up to target position, up to  18 m / 60 ft each turn using your Movement Speed.

flying_strike.name: Flying Strike
flying_strike.description: Affected entity has flown this turn. Its next melee weapon attack deals an additional 1d4Psychic.

foolish_little_pup.name: Foolish Little Pup
foolish_little_pup.description: Shouldn't have done that, petal. Frightened.

force_conduit.name: Force Conduit
force_conduit.description: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage against the affected entity is reduced by 1 per turn remaining. If the entity takes damage while it has 5 or more turns remaining, it deals 1d4Force damage in a 6 m / 20 ft radius. Force Conduit has a maximum  Duration: 7 turns.

force_steadfast.name: Force Steadfast
force_steadfast.description: Affected entity can't be moved against its will.

forced_manoeuvre.name: Forced Manoeuvre
forced_manoeuvre.description: Movement speed increased by 4.5 m / 15 ft and doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

form_of_artifice.name: Form of Artifice
form_of_artifice.description: Your constructed form grants you  Advantage on Attack rolls and resistance to Lightning damage.

form_of_dread.name: Form of Dread
form_of_dread.description: The Ch'r'ai has 15 Temporary Hit Points and can't be  Frightened. Each time she attacks a foe, that foe can become  Frightened for 1 turn.

formless_slaughter.name: Formless Slaughter
formless_slaughter.description: This creature has a +1 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls while disguised or shapeshifted.

fractured_psyche.name: Fractured Psyche
fractured_psyche.description: Creature's  Armour Class is reduced by 1.

fractured_psyche_full_illithid.name: Fractured Psyche (Full-illithid)
fractured_psyche_full_illithid.description: Your  Armour Class is reduced by 5 and you have a -5 penalty to  Saving throws.

freedom_of_movement.name: Freedom of Movement
freedom_of_movement.description: The affected creature's Movement Speed cannot be reduced by Difficult Terrain, spells or magical effects. The affected creature cannot be  Paralysed or  Restrained.

frenzied.name: Frenzied
frenzied.description: Deal an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has Resistance to physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.

frenzied_fury.name: Frenzied Fury
frenzied_fury.description: Overwhelmed with rage, the gnoll can attack three times per turn.

frenzied_spores.name: Frenzied Spores
frenzied_spores.description: Glut has increased hit points and Strength. It has access to more spore spells.

frenzied_strain.name: Frenzied Strain
frenzied_strain.description: Using  Frenzied Strike adds a stack of Frenzied Strain. The barbarian takes a -1 penalty on Attack Rolls for every stack. All stacks are removed when  Frenzy ends.

friends.name: Friends
friends.description: Has  Advantage on  Charisma checks directed at the target creature. In higher difficulty modes, the target might accuse you of enchanting them.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.description: The affected creature cannot move. Frightened creatures also have  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and Attack rolls.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.description: Affected entity is utterly enamelled in ice and is Incapacitated. If it is dealt Bludgeoning, Thunder, or Force damage, the ice shatters, ending the condition. Gains Vulnerability to Bludgeoning, Thunder, and Force damage. Gains Resistance to Fire damage. Gains immunity to  Burning and  Encrusted with Frost.

fugitive.name: Fugitive
fugitive.description: Recently escaped from prison. Guards will arrest this prisoner on sight.

fungal_resistance.name: Fungal Resistance
fungal_resistance.description: The hag has a +5 bonus to Saving Throws for each nearby Pearlspore Bell.

fungal_resurrection.name: Fungal Resurrection
fungal_resurrection.description: The hag will be resurrected by nearby Pearlspore Bells at the start of their next turn.

galerian_revelry.name: Galerian Revelry
galerian_revelry.description: Compelled to shuffle and dance. Affected entity can't move or take actions. Attack rolls against it have  Advantage, while its Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

galvanic_currents.name: Galvanic Currents
galvanic_currents.description: Blue lightning flits across the weapon's surface. Deals an additional 1d6Lightning.

gaping_wounds.name: Gaping Wounds
gaping_wounds.description: Attacks against this creature deal an additional 2Piercing damage. Removed by healing.

garrotted.name: Garrotted
garrotted.description: Affected entity is being strangled by a garrotte. It is Silenced and takes 3d6Bludgeoning damage per turn. Both the entity and the garrotter can't move until the condition ends. If the entity and the garrotter are forcibly moved more than  5 m / 17 ft apart, this condition ends.

garrotting.name: Garrotting
garrotting.description: Strangling a creature with a garrotte. Moving more than 5 m / 17 ft away from the creature will break the garrotte.

gaseous_form.name: Gaseous Form
gaseous_form.resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
gaseous_form.description: Transformed into a cloud of mist. Resistant to all damage. Has  Advantage on Constitution, Dexterity, and Strength  Saving throws. Becomes Tiny in size. Cannot attack, cast spells, or speak. The target's Strength and Dexterity scores are set to 10 while in this form.

gaseous_reflux.name: Gaseous Reflux
gaseous_reflux.description: Physical attacks have added gas to Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Roaring Belch.

gathering_drumbeat.name: Gathering Drumbeat
gathering_drumbeat.description: A goblin has sounded these war drums, calling reinforcements to battle. Will draw nearby goblins into combat. If used in the Goblin Camp, will turn the entire camp hostile as well. All  Temporarily Hostile enemies become permanently hostile.

ghastly_fume.name: Ghastly Fume
ghastly_fume.description: The affected entity's foul stench creates a pungent cloud that  Nauseates all creatures around it.

giant_form.name: Giant Form
giant_form.description: Affected entity's size is increased. Its weapon attacks deal an additional 1d6 damage. It gains  27 temporary hit points, and has  Advantage on Strength  Ability checks and  Saving throws.

giant_s_rage.name: Giant's Rage
giant_s_rage.description: Raging and increased in size. Deals an additional 2 damage (increased to 3 at level 9) with melee and improvised weapons, unarmed strikes, and 4 damage (increased to 6 at level 9) while throwing objects . Also has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws. Size is increased by one category. Cannot cast or concentrate on Spells.

githyanki_providence.name: Githyanki Providence
githyanki_providence.description: A mote of githyanki psionics allows the affected entity to cast  Misty Step,  Enhance Leap, and  Blur once each until its next Long Rest.

githyanki_war_magic.name: Githyanki War Magic
githyanki_war_magic.description: Can make a weapon attack using a bonus action.

githzerai_mind_barrier.name: Githzerai Mind Barrier
githzerai_mind_barrier.description: Having assimilated a splinter of githzerai knowledge, mental barriers have been erected in the affected entity's mind. It has  Advantage on Intelligence Saving Throws.

glimpse_of_freedom.name: Glimpse of Freedom
glimpse_of_freedom.description: Escaping certain death, the character is motivated to move  4.5 m / 15 ft quicker.

glutted_catacombs.name: Glutted Catacombs
glutted_catacombs.description: This area is filled with the bones of the dead. The spell  Animate Dead: Skeleton does not require a skeleton to raise the dead in this area.

gnawing_horde.name: Gnawing Horde
gnawing_horde.description: Ravenous Ghouls that fight alongside you.

gnomish_ingenuity.name: Gnomish Ingenuity
gnomish_ingenuity.description: Affected entity is Proficient in Sleight of Hand Checks and can cast  Knock until it takes a Long Rest.

goaded.name: Goaded
goaded.description: Must attack the goading creature, if possible.  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against targets other than the spellcaster.

god_of_ambition.name: God of Ambition
god_of_ambition.description: Mere mortals whisper petitions to the newly divine Gale Dekarios as The Once-Wizard, High Aspirant, The Lord of Zeal - but none have yet been granted an audience with the God of Ambition. Until tonight, that is.

gossamer_tomb.name: Gossamer Tomb
gossamer_tomb.description: This creature is entombed in  Infested spider silk, and cannot move or take actions. Unless the silk is removed with Acid or Fire damage, it will explode, dealing 8d10Poison to the entombed creature.

grappled_tentacle.name: Grappled (Tentacle)
grappled_tentacle.description: At the start of each turn, the target makes a  Strength saving throw to attempt to free themselves. On a failed save, they take 2d6Psychic.

grappled.name: Grappled
grappled.description: Affected entity is incapacitated and cannot be damaged while held within the grapple.  Help it to free it!

grappling.name: Grappling
grappling.description: Affected entity has  Grappled another creature. Cannot move while Grappling. Interrupted by receiving damage.

grasp_essence.name: Grasp Essence
grasp_essence.description: When you hit a creature with an unarmed attack, you can regain 10hit points or choose to gain  Advantage on Attack Rolls or Saving Throws before the end of your next turn.

grasping_arrow_entangled.name: Grasping Arrow: Entangled
grasping_arrow_entangled.description: Affected entity will take 2d6Slashing damage when it moves, and its movement speed is reduced by 3 m / 10 ft.

gravely_wounded.name: Gravely Wounded
gravely_wounded.description: This person cannot be healed or saved.

great_weapon_master_bonus_attack.name: Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack
great_weapon_master_bonus_attack.description: Can make a melee attack as a  Bonus Action.

greater_arcane_hunger.name: Greater Arcane Hunger
greater_arcane_hunger.description: The Netherese Orb in Gale's body is weakening him. He has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and all  Saving throws.

greater_elixir_of_arcane_cultivation.name: Greater Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
greater_elixir_of_arcane_cultivation.description: Has an additional  Level 2 Spell Slot.

greater_invisibility.name: Greater Invisibility
greater_invisibility.description: Entity has  Advantage on Attack rolls. Attack Rolls against it have  Disadvantage When interacting with items, casting spells, or attacking, the entity needs to succeed on a Stealth Check to maintain Invisibility. The Check becomes harder with each successful attempt.

greater_toughness.name: Greater Toughness
greater_toughness.description: This material is extremely strong. Only a hit that deals at least 50 damage can damage it.

green_bed_regeneration.name: Green Bed Regeneration
green_bed_regeneration.description: When starting your turn on Plant Growth Surface or  Vine Surface regain 1~4hit points hit points.

grieving.name: Grieving
grieving.description: The affected creature has  Advantage on Attack rolls but  Disadvantage on  Ability checks while processing the loss of something dear to it.

gripped_by_kereska_s_flame.name: Gripped by Kereska's Flame
gripped_by_kereska_s_flame.description: Affected entity has resistance to Fire damage. Its fire spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus. When it deals spell damage, it gains 2 turns of  Heat. While attuned to Kereska's flame, it can cast  Fireball at 3rd level and  Wall of Fire at 5th level once per short rest.

grotesque_distention.name: Grotesque Distention
grotesque_distention.description: Bloated beyond hope. Will explode at the slightest touch. Touching an entity affected with this condition will cause a blast of 8d6Poison damage in an  AoE: 3 m / 3 ft (Radius), form a Poison Cloud of the same size, and utterly destroy the entity.

guardian_wraiths.name: Guardian Wraiths
guardian_wraiths.immunity: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
guardian_wraiths.description: Affected entity is Immune to all damage. When this effect ends, the entity will be healed for 6d8hit points, unless it is ended by  Greater Restoration or  Remove Curse.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.description: Gains a  +1d4 bonus to  Ability checks.

guided_strike_active.name: Guided Strike: Active
guided_strike_active.description: You have a +10 bonus to your next Attack roll.

guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding_bolt.description: The next Attack roll made against this creature has  Advantage.

haemorrhaged.name: Haemorrhaged
haemorrhaged.description: The target takes 1d6Piercing damage at end of turn.

hag_pregnancy.name: Hag Pregnancy
hag_pregnancy.description: The hag has eaten the child to transform her into a newborn hag. Killing the hag will lead to the child's death.

hag_s_pawn.name: Hag's Pawn
hag_s_pawn.description: Ethel has taken control. Condition lasts until mask is removed or spellcaster is dead.

hag_s_trickery.name: Hag's Trickery
hag_s_trickery.description: Is this Ethel - or an illusion?

half_orcish_fury.name: Half-Orcish Fury
half_orcish_fury.description: The next time the affected entity is  Downed, it instead drops to 1 hit point thanks to the relentless will roiling in its veins.

halfling_luck.name: Halfling Luck
halfling_luck.description: The luck of the smallfolk grants the affected entity  Advantage on Skill Checks until its next Long Rest.

hallucinating.name: Hallucinating
hallucinating.description: Creature is hallucinating. It has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks, wanders around uncontrollably, and can't take  Actions or reactions.

hamstrung.name: Hamstrung
hamstrung.description: Movement Speed reduced by 50%. Removed by healing.

hands_off_petal.name: Hands Off - Petal
hands_off_petal.skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
hands_off_petal.description: Ethel disapproves, dearie.  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks. Take 2d4Psychic damage when condition is received.

happy.name: Happy
happy.description: Astarion's vampiric hunger has been temporarily sated. +1 to all Attack Rolls, Saving Throws, and most Ability Checks.

harm.name: Harm
harm.description: Affected entity's maximum Hit Points have been reduced by the damage inflicted by the Harm spell This condition is a Disease

harmonised.name: Harmonised
harmonised.description: Affected entity's melee weapon attacks deal additional damage equal to its Charisma Modifier (min.1).

harrowed.name: Harrowed
harrowed.description: The affected entity is psychically oppressed by a powerful ghost. It has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Wisdom  Saving throws.

haste_spores.name: Haste Spores
haste_spores.description: Target gains Advantage on Dexterity  Saving throws. Target's Movement Speed is doubled. Target gains an additional  Action.

hastened.name: Hastened
hastened.description: The affected creature acquires the following: Advantage on Dexterity  Saving throws An increase in Movement Speed of  9 m / 30 ft An additional  Action  When the condition ends, the affected creature becomes  Lethargic and is unable to move or take Actions for 1 turn.

haunted_approach.name: Haunted Approach
haunted_approach.description: This creature's Movement speed and jump distance is halved while within  3 m / 10 ft of a Cursed Skull

haunting_aura.name: Haunting Aura
haunting_aura.description: Nearby creatures are afflicted with  Phantasmal Force.

healing_incense.name: Healing Incense
healing_incense.description: Affected entity regains 1d4hit points at the start of the spellcaster's turn, as long as they remain within  10 m / 33 ft of them.

healing_incense_aura.name: Healing Incense Aura
healing_incense_aura.description: Applies  Healing Incense to affected entity and allies within  Range: 10 m / 30 ft, regaining 1d4hit points per turn.

healing_pearl.name: Healing Pearl
healing_pearl.description: At the start of its turn, this mushroom keeping Auntie Ethel alive regains all its hit points unless some effect prevents it from restorative healing.

healing_radiance.name: Healing Radiance
healing_radiance.description: Allies within 3m / 10ft will regain Proficiency bonus + Paladin level + Charisma modifierHealing at the start of the Paladin's next turn.

heart_of_stone.name: Heart of Stone
heart_of_stone.description: Gain Resistance to Poison until next Long Rest.

heartform_mapped.name: Heartform Mapped
heartform_mapped.description: The affected entity's  Violent,  Craven,  Jealous,  Melancholy,  Prying,  False, or  Wayward Heart has been mapped and punished by Viconia.

heartform_terror_ceremorphosis.name: Heartform Terror: Ceremorphosis
heartform_terror_ceremorphosis.description: Overcome with the fear they've turned into an illithid, the affected entity cannot move or take actions.

heartform_terror_spider.name: Heartform Terror: Spider
heartform_terror_spider.description: This creature has twisted its form into one of your fears.

heartform_terror_wolf.name: Heartform Terror: Wolf
heartform_terror_wolf.description: This Sharran knows your fears and has twisted its form into one of them.

heat.name: Heat
heat.description: Engulfed by a vengeful fire. Takes 1d4Fire damage each turn, but can use  Heat Convergence. Heat Convergence consumes all remaining turns of Heat to deal extra Fire damage on their next fire spell or attack. Heat has a maximum  Duration: 7 turns.

heat_convergence.name: Heat Convergence
heat_convergence.description: The next time the affected entity deals Fire damage, it deals an additional 1 for every turn of  Heat still affecting them.

heat_metal.name: Heat Metal
heat_metal.description: Heats up a metal weapon or armour on a creature with no save (weapon is automatically prioritized). Metal weapons are dropped if the creature holding it fails their initial  Saving throw. If the creature is touching the heated metal item, they receive  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks. Each subsequent turn, if the creature is still touching the metal, the spellcaster can use  Reapply Heat Metal to deal another 2d8Fire damage, forcing the creature to pass a Saving Throw again or drop the item (if it is a metal weapon).

heat_metal_reapply_damage.name: Heat Metal: Reapply Damage
heat_metal_reapply_damage.description: Creature can reapply the damage dealt by the heated metal.

heavily_encumbered.name: Heavily Encumbered
heavily_encumbered.description: Carrying far too much weight. Movement Speed heavily reduced, and you can no longer climb or Jump. You also have  Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls, as well as Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Saving Throws.

heavily_obscured.name: Heavily Obscured
heavily_obscured.description: Hiding in a Heavily Obscured area. Will go undetected unless they get too close to another creature.

hellfire_cambion.name: Hellfire Cambion
hellfire_cambion.description: This cambion's attacks deal Hellfire damage, ignoring Resistance and Immunity to Fire damage.

hellfire_curse.name: Hellfire Curse
hellfire_curse.description: Hellfire roiling within this creature gives it  Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution  Saving throws.

hellish_sphere.name: Hellish Sphere
hellish_sphere.description: Creature is standing within  3 m / 10 ft of a flaming sphere and will take 6d6Fire damage at the end of its turn. On a second save, it will still take half damage. Dexterity save

hellish_sphere_aura.name: Hellish Sphere (Aura)
hellish_sphere_aura.description: Enemies and objects within  3 m / 10 ft of the sphere at the end of their turn take 6d6Fire. On a successful save, they still take half damage.

her_voice_commanding.name: Her Voice: Commanding
her_voice_commanding.skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
her_voice_commanding.description: Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -1 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6Psychic damage at the end of its turn.

her_voice_the_end_of_all.name: Her Voice: the End of All
her_voice_the_end_of_all.skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
her_voice_the_end_of_all.description: Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -4 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6Psychic damage at the end of its turn.

her_voice_transforming.name: Her Voice: Transforming
her_voice_transforming.skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
her_voice_transforming.description: Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -2 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6Psychic damage at the end of its turn.

heroic.name: Heroic
heroic.description: Affected entity has gained  10 temporary hit points.

heroism.name: Heroism
heroism.description: Can't be  Frightened. Receive  5 temporary hit points per turn.

hexblade_s_curse.name: Hexblade's Curse
hexblade_s_curse.description: Cursed by a Hexblade warlock. The warlock who cursed this entity adds their proficiency bonus to damage rolls against them. The number they need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking this entity is also reduced by 1.

hexed_weapon.name: Hexed Weapon
hexed_weapon.description: The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it. The weapon's damage is magical and uses the warlock's Charisma modifier. When the warlock attacks with this weapon, there is a chance that  Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target.

hexed_charisma.name: Hexed: Charisma
hexed_charisma.description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Charisma Checks.

hexed_constitution.name: Hexed: Constitution
hexed_constitution.description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Constitution Checks.

hexed_dexterity.name: Hexed: Dexterity
hexed_dexterity.description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks.

hexed_intelligence.name: Hexed: Intelligence
hexed_intelligence.description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks.

hexed_strength.name: Hexed: Strength
hexed_strength.description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks.

hexed_wisdom.name: Hexed: Wisdom
hexed_wisdom.skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
hexed_wisdom.description: Creature suffers an additional 1d6Necrotic damage from the spellcaster. It also has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.

hide_in_plain_sight.name: Hide in Plain Sight
hide_in_plain_sight.description: Affected entity is invisible. It has  Advantage on Attack Rolls. It has a +10 bonus to Stealth Checks. Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity moves, attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

hideous_laughter.name: Hideous Laughter
hideous_laughter.description: Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on  Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if they're made within  3 m / 10 ft of the creature. At the end of its turn or when it takes damage, the entity can try to shake off the effect.

hiding.name: Hiding
hiding.description: Affected entity is invisible to enemies until it crosses their cone of sight. The entity has  Advantage on all Attack rolls.

high_spirits.name: High Spirits
high_spirits.description: The amulet's spirit lingers, making everything seem just a little more vibrant. Must succeed a Wisdom  Saving throw when using the amulet's power, or become  Hysterical.

hill_giant_s_might.name: Hill Giant's Might
hill_giant_s_might.description: The mountains quake! Strength increased to 21.

hoarding_energy.name: Hoarding Energy
hoarding_energy.resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
hoarding_energy.description: Ansur is gathering energy while airborne and is Resistant to all damage.

hold_monster.name: Hold Monster
hold_monster.description: Affected entity can't Move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions. Attacks against the entity have  Advantage. Attacks against the entity are always Critical Hits if the attacker is within  Range: 3 m / 10 ft. Affected entity automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity  Saving throws. At the end of each turn, the affected entity makes a Wisdom  Saving throw. On a successful save, the condition is removed.

hold_person.name: Hold Person
hold_person.description: Affected entity can't Move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions. Attacks against the entity automatically succeed their Attack Roll. Attacks against the entity are always Critical Hits if the attacker is within  Range: 3 m / 10 ft. Affected entity automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity  Saving throws. At the end of each turn, the affected entity makes a Wisdom  Saving throw. On a successful save, the condition is removed.

holy_rebuke.name: Holy Rebuke
holy_rebuke.description: Affected entity is protected by a vengeful aura. Attackers take 1d4Radiant damage when they hit the entity with a melee attack.

hoots_hooch.name: Hoots' Hooch
hoots_hooch.description: A new invention of the Sharess' Caress bartender Hoots - like being decked in the sobriety.

hoots_hooch_bad_breath.name: Hoots' Hooch: Bad Breath
hoots_hooch_bad_breath.description: Characters attacking you in melee become  Nauseous.

hoots_hooch_beast_tongue.name: Hoots' Hooch: Beast Tongue
hoots_hooch_beast_tongue.description: You're pretty sure you could speak to animals if you tried.

hoots_hooch_gifted.name: Hoots' Hooch: Gifted
hoots_hooch_gifted.description: You can read minds, but become Vulnerable to Psychic damage.

hoots_hooch_photosensitivity.name: Hoots' Hooch: Photosensitivity
hoots_hooch_photosensitivity.description: Become  Blind in direct sunlight but gain  Superior Darkvision.

hoots_hooch_stoned.name: Hoots' Hooch: Stoned
hoots_hooch_stoned.description: Temporarily  Petrified - perhaps with lingering side-effects.

horde_breaker.name: Horde Breaker
horde_breaker.description: Creature is open to a follow-up attack.

hound_s_omen.name: Hound's Omen
hound_s_omen.description: A dark omen that can be of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. When damage of that type is dealt to the affected entity, the owner of the hound regains 1  Sorcery Point.

houndmaster_s_prey.name: Houndmaster's Prey
houndmaster_s_prey.description: When a Houndmaster's dog (Zina, Gordis, Rocky) hits the target, it gains  Prey Essence, gaining 30 Temporary Hit Points.

human_versatility.name: Human Versatility
human_versatility.description: Mundane pluckiness grants the affected entity Proficiency in all skills until the next Long Rest due to the wily resourcefulness now bubbling within it.

hunger_of_hadar.name: Hunger of Hadar
hunger_of_hadar.description: 2d6 (2~12) Cold   2d6 (2~12) Acid DC 12  Dexterity saving throwStanding near a portal to the dark between the stars, infested with unknown horrors. Takes 2d6Cold damage at the start of their turn, and possibly 2d6Acid damage at the end of their turn, as long as they are in the area They are  Blinded and the area is  Difficult Terrain.

hunger_of_hadar_aura.name: Hunger of Hadar (Aura)
hunger_of_hadar_aura.description: A sphere of cold blackness, teeming with unknown horrors. Creatures starting their turn in the area take 2d6Cold. Creatures ending their turn in the area possibly take 2d6Acid. The area is  Difficult Terrain, and creatures within are  Blinded.

hungover.name: Hungover
hungover.skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Persuasion, Performance, Intimidation, Deception
hungover.description: You have  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma Checks. You tell yourself 'I'm never drinking again'. You're a liar.

hunt_completed.name: Hunt Completed
hunt_completed.description: Can use a bonus action to reapply Hunter's Mark to another target.

hunted.name: Hunted
hunted.description: Yurgir can interrupt this creature's attacks and spells once per round with a  Blinding Ambush while it is Hunted.

hunter_s_mark_quarry.name: Hunter's Mark Quarry
hunter_s_mark_quarry.description: Affected entity suffers an additional 1d6Weapon damage if the spellcaster hits it with a weapon attack.

hypnotic_gaze.name: Hypnotic Gaze
hypnotic_gaze.description: Can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions. Spellcaster has  Advantage on Ability Checks in dialogue. Removed upon taking damage. Duration can be extended with  Maintain Hypnotic Gaze

hypnotised.name: Hypnotised
hypnotised.description: Can't Move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions. Removed by taking damage, being Shoved, or Helped.

hysterical.name: Hysterical
hysterical.description: Knocked Prone out of sheer elation. Sides splitting, lungs gasping for air - you're enjoying yourself, aren't you?

icy_cloud.name: Icy Cloud
icy_cloud.description: A sheet of frigid air dealing 10d6Cold to all that walk through it. Affected entities can make a DC 16  Constitution saving throw to take half damage instead.

idyllic_aura.name: Idyllic Aura
idyllic_aura.description: Grants Silvanus' Blessing to creatures within range.

impaled.name: Impaled
impaled.description: A ghoul's spike prevents this creature from moving.

impenetrable_slumber.name: Impenetrable slumber
impenetrable_slumber.description: This individual is under the influence of copious sleeping draughts. It is impossible to wake them.

improved_bardic_inspiration.name: Improved Bardic Inspiration
improved_bardic_inspiration.description: Can use  Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d12 bonus to the next Attack roll,  Ability check, or  Saving throw. Grants:  Improved Bardic Inspiration: Attack Roll or Ability Check (Toggleable passive feature): Add a +1d12 bonus to your next Attack roll or Ability Check.  Improved Bardic Inspiration: Saving Throw (Toggleable passive feature): Add a +1d12 bonus to your next  Saving throw.  Bardic Defence (Reaction): +1d6 bonus to the next  Saving throw.  Bardic Attack (Reaction): +1d6 bonus to the next Attack roll.

in_surgery.name: In Surgery
in_surgery.description: Unable to move while strapped onto the operating gurney.

incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
incapacitated.description: Cannot take Actions or Reactions. Lose  Concentration, if maintaining a Concentration spell.

inciting_howl.name: Inciting Howl
inciting_howl.description: Movement Speed increased by  3 m / 10 ft.

incubating.name: Incubating
incubating.description: Skeletal involucre will explode on its next turn, dealing 6~27Necrotic damage and birthing a necromite.

incubus_charmed.name: Incubus Charmed
incubus_charmed.description: You are charmed by a devil and must support it in battle. You can make another Saving Throw against this effect after taking damage.

induced_rage.name: Induced Rage
induced_rage.description: The mix of chemicals has thrown the Owlbear into a fit of rage. It is stronger, jumps further, gains a multiattack, and can rupture the earth. The Owlbear receives 4d8Healing every turn if below  105 hit points. The Owlbear has +2 Strength.

inevitable_resolve.name: Inevitable Resolve
inevitable_resolve.description: Any effect controlling or incapacitating this creature will cease at the end of its next turn.

infected.name: Infected
infected.description: Has  Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws, and Constitution is reduced by 1.

infectious_greed.name: Infectious Greed
infectious_greed.description: The affected entity's attacks deal an additional 6d6Piercing damage in the presence of Helsik. Additionally, it has  Advantage on Attack rolls against targets marked by  Promise of Wealth.

infernal_binding.name: Infernal Binding
infernal_binding.immunity: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
infernal_binding.description: Hope is Immune to all damage while imprisoned in the House of Hope.

infernal_burning.name: Infernal Burning
infernal_burning.description: Takes 1d4Fire damage per turn. CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet. The entity affected cannot regain Hit Points

infernal_fury.name: Infernal Fury
infernal_fury.description: The hatred and pain of a captured soul fuels  Karlach's infernal machine. Her weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4Fire damage when she is  Raging or when her Hit Points drop below 25%.

infernal_legion.name: Infernal Legion
infernal_legion.description: You are one, you are legion, without personality or individuality - born only to fight. When within 20m / 67ft of another creature wearing a merregon's mask, Strength increases by 1 and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma decrease by 1 per nearby mask.

infernal_stun.name: Infernal Stun
infernal_stun.description: This creature cannot move or act, and Raphael can  Soul Drain it at will.

infested.name: Infested
infested.description: Crawling with tiny spiders that deal 1d4 Piercing damage and 1d4 Poison damage each turn. When hit with a melee attack, the infestation spreads to the attacker. Upon death, the infestation spreads to all nearby creatures. Removed by Fire or Acid damage. Doesn't harm ettercaps or spiders. At the start of your turn, you can make a new Saving Throw to try and remove the infection.

ingested_poisoned_beer.name: Ingested Poisoned Beer
ingested_poisoned_beer.description: Beer mixed with a deadly toxin courses through the character's veins, slowly killing it. Affected entity takes 1d6+6Poison damage per turn, for 10 turns.

inoculated_basic_poison.name: Inoculated: Basic Poison
inoculated_basic_poison.description: You succeeded on a  Saving throw against  Basic Poison and can't be affected by it.

inoculated_crawler_mucus.name: Inoculated: Crawler Mucus
inoculated_crawler_mucus.description: You succeeded on a  Saving throw against  Crawler Mucus and can't be affected by it.

inoculated_drow_poison.name: Inoculated: Drow Poison
inoculated_drow_poison.description: You succeeded on a  Saving throw against  Drow Poison and can't be affected by it.

inoculated_malice.name: Inoculated: Malice
inoculated_malice.description: You succeeded on a  Saving throw against Malice and can't be affected by it.

inquisitor_s_might.name: Inquisitor's Might
inquisitor_s_might.description: Affected character's weapon attacks deal an additional + Charisma Ability Score Modifier Radiant damage. Affected character's weapon attacks can  Daze enemies for 1 turn.

insanity_s_kiss.name: Insanity's Kiss
insanity_s_kiss.description: Hostile to all other creatures for the condition's duration.

insect_plague.name: Insect Plague
insect_plague.description: Movement speed halved.  Disadvantage on Perception Checks. Affected entity takes 4d10Piercing damage per turn. Affected entity can make a  Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC to take half damage instead.

insect_plague_aura.name: Insect Plague (Aura)
insect_plague_aura.description: Swarming, biting locusts fill the air. They deal 4d10Piercing per turn, make the area  Difficult Terrain, and impose  Disadvantage on Perception Checks.

inspiring_resolve.name: Inspiring Resolve
inspiring_resolve.description: Affected entity has been fortified by courageous words, granting it  temporary hit points.

instinctive_charm_unaffected.name: Instinctive Charm: Unaffected
instinctive_charm_unaffected.description: Cannot be affected by  Instinctive Charm until after a Long Rest.

instrument_of_loss_bonesaw.name: Instrument of Loss: Bonesaw
instrument_of_loss_bonesaw.description: The Surgeon can use its implement to  Bonesaw a patient.

instrument_of_loss_leech.name: Instrument of Loss: Leech
instrument_of_loss_leech.description: The Surgeon can use its implement to  Leech a patient.

instrument_of_loss_syringe.name: Instrument of Loss: Syringe
instrument_of_loss_syringe.description: The Surgeon can use its implement to  Inject a patient.

instrument_of_loss_trepan.name: Instrument of Loss: Trepan
instrument_of_loss_trepan.description: The Surgeon can use its implement to  Trepan a patient.

invigorated_thrall.name: Invigorated Thrall
invigorated_thrall.description: Creatures created by Invigorating Flame will gain additional hit points based on summoner's wizard level and additional damage based on summoner's profiency bonus.

invigorating_fanaticism.name: Invigorating Fanaticism
invigorating_fanaticism.description: An unshakeable belief in its divine grants this creature Resistance to all physical damage and attacks that possibly  Bleed targets.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.description: Has  Advantage on Attack rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, interacts with an object, takes an action or bonus action, or is damaged.

invisible_weapon.name: Invisible Weapon
invisible_weapon.description: Affected entity can't be disarmed. It has  Advantage on Attack rolls. It scores a critical hit when rolling a 19.

invulnerable.name: Invulnerable
invulnerable.immunity: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
invulnerable.description: Immune to all damage Can still be afflicted with status effects

ironwood_harmony.name: Ironwood Harmony
ironwood_harmony.description: Deals an additional 1d4Bludgeoning while imbued with the druidic magic of  Shillelagh.

jealous_heart.name: Jealous Heart
jealous_heart.description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its Jealous Heart by  Helping an ally.

jolted.name: Jolted
jolted.description: Takes 1d4Lightning damage each turn and can't take  Reactions. Removed upon leaving the Lightning Aura.

just_look_at_those_cheekbones.name: Just Look At Those Cheekbones!
just_look_at_those_cheekbones.description: Gazing upon this depiction of themselves will  bless the owner of this statue once per Long Rest.

knocked_out_temporary.name: Knocked Out (Temporary)
knocked_out_temporary.description: The affected entity which was  Temporarily Hostile before cannot move or take actions, bonus actions or reactions. The affected entity regains consciousness after a Long Rest.

knocked_out.name: Knocked Out
knocked_out.description: The affected entity which was permanently hostile before cannot move or take actions, bonus actions or reactions. The affected entity disappears permanently after a Long Rest.

knowledge_of_the_ages_charisma.name: Knowledge of the Ages: Charisma
knowledge_of_the_ages_charisma.description: Has Proficiency in  Deception,  Intimidation,  Performance,  Persuasion.

knowledge_of_the_ages_dexterity.name: Knowledge of the Ages: Dexterity
knowledge_of_the_ages_dexterity.description: Has Proficiency in  Acrobatics,  Sleight of Hand, and  Stealth.

knowledge_of_the_ages_intelligence.name: Knowledge of the Ages: Intelligence
knowledge_of_the_ages_intelligence.description: Has Proficiency in  Arcana,  History,  Investigation,  Nature, and  Religion.

knowledge_of_the_ages_wisdom.name: Knowledge of the Ages: Wisdom
knowledge_of_the_ages_wisdom.skill_proficiency: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
knowledge_of_the_ages_wisdom.description: Has Proficiency in  Animal Handling,  Insight,  Medicine,  Perception, and  Survival.

lair_magic.name: Lair Magic
lair_magic.description: When in their lair, the hag and her doubles have  Magic Resistance

lathander_s_light.name: Lathander's Light
lathander_s_light.description: Sheds holy light in a  6 m / 20 ft radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are  Blinded, unless they succeed a  Constitution saving throw.

leadership.name: Leadership
leadership.description: Bolstered with supernatural resolve. Attacks deal an additional 1d4Force.

leadership_aura.name: Leadership Aura
leadership_aura.description: Allied creatures within  6 m / 20 ft deal an additional 1d4Force on their attacks. Non-branded creatures within  6 m / 20 ft are marked as the  Absolute's Enemies.T These effects will end if Dror Ragzlin is incapacitated.

legendary_action_adamantine_reverberatio.name: Legendary Action: Adamantine Reverberation
legendary_action_adamantine_reverberatio.description: When struck, Grym's adamantine form  Reverberates, doubling its movement and granting it 10 temporary hit points. Losing these temporary hit points triggers a shockwave that knocks targets back 4m and deals 4~32 Thunder damage.

legendary_action_beguiling_rebuke.name: Legendary Action: Beguiling Rebuke
legendary_action_beguiling_rebuke.description: Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately  Beguile a hostile creature and its allies after being attacked.

legendary_action_bhaal_s_edict.name: Legendary Action: Bhaal's Edict
legendary_action_bhaal_s_edict.description: If Orin does not use a Legendary Action this turn, the Dread Lord places a creature under Bhaal's Edict.

legendary_action_blinding_ambush.name: Legendary Action: Blinding Ambush
legendary_action_blinding_ambush.description: Once per round, Yurgir can strike a  Hunted creature when it attempts to attack or cast a spell, dealing 5d10 Radiant damage and possibly  Blinding the target.

legendary_action_call_consort.name: Legendary Action: Call Consort
legendary_action_call_consort.description: When attacked, the Owlbear can summon her mate to defend her.

legendary_action_devoted_galvanism.name: Legendary Action: Devoted Galvanism
legendary_action_devoted_galvanism.description: Once per round when an enemy targets their ally with an ability, Dror Ragzlin can use a Legendary Action to  Galvanise Absolutists within  5 m / 17 ft, granting them  Action Surge.

legendary_action_draconic_fury.name: Legendary Action: Draconic Fury
legendary_action_draconic_fury.description: This great drake will use its  Fire Breath on the next creature that attacks it.

legendary_action_draconic_wrath.name: Legendary Action: Draconic Wrath
legendary_action_draconic_wrath.description: This great drake will use its  Lightning Breath on the next creature that attacks it.

legendary_action_fanatic_retaliation.name: Legendary Action: Fanatic Retaliation
legendary_action_fanatic_retaliation.description: When an enemy kills a  Spindleweb Fanatic, Kar'niss will immediately  Retaliate against the attacker.

legendary_action_gaze_of_the_dead.name: Legendary Action: Gaze of the Dead
legendary_action_gaze_of_the_dead.description: Myrkul's Apostle will use  Gaze of the Dead on the first creature that strikes it each round in combat.

legendary_action_gossamer_tomb.name: Legendary Action: Gossamer Tomb
legendary_action_gossamer_tomb.description: Once per round if her offspring is attacked, this creature will try to encase the attacker in a Gossamer Tomb.

legendary_action_grasping_appendage.name: Legendary Action: Grasping Appendage
legendary_action_grasping_appendage.description: Once per round, Malus Thorm can spend a Legendary Action to use  Grasping Appendage.

legendary_action_heartwrench.name: Legendary Action: Heartwrench
legendary_action_heartwrench.description: Viconia can rend a target with a psychic barrage dealing 10d12Psychic after she or an ally is struck by a  Heartform Mapped creature.

legendary_action_hordestrike.name: Legendary Action: Hordestrike
legendary_action_hordestrike.description: Ketheric can  Hordestrike a foe when it is attacked by a minion under  Deadly Orders

legendary_action_leaping_static.name: Legendary Action: Leaping Static
legendary_action_leaping_static.description: Bernard can fire Leaping Static at the first foe that attacks it each round.

legendary_action_murderous_retort.name: Legendary Action: Murderous Retort
legendary_action_murderous_retort.description: Orin can immediately strike back at her attacker. If  Deathbringer's Legacy is active, she uses  Deathbringer's Assault (Orin) instead. Sarevok can immediately strike back at his attacker. If Deathbringer's Legacy is active, he uses  Deathbringer's Assault instead.

legendary_action_ocular_nightmare.name: Legendary Action: Ocular Nightmare
legendary_action_ocular_nightmare.description: After accumulating five  Paranoid Dreams, the Spectator will spend a Legendary Action to cast  Ocular Nightmare when it is next struck.

legendary_action_overflowing_brew.name: Legendary Action: Overflowing Brew
legendary_action_overflowing_brew.description: When Thisobald Thorm's brew changes, it can overflow, dealing 3d6 of the corresponding damage type and empowering his allies.

legendary_action_psionic_visage.name: Legendary Action: Psionic Visage
legendary_action_psionic_visage.description: Nere can immediately cast  Psionic Visage on himself when attacked.

legendary_action_ptarian_dogma.name: Legendary Action: Ptarian Dogma
legendary_action_ptarian_dogma.description: Once per round, after being hit, Ptaris can spend a Legendary Action to surround his attacker in  Ptarian Pacifism.

legendary_action_sanctuary_of_loss.name: Legendary Action: Sanctuary of Loss
legendary_action_sanctuary_of_loss.description: After an ally is struck, Viconia can apply  Sanctuary of Loss to them, shielding them from further attacks. This protection will wane when the protected creature attacks.

legendary_action_sanguine_lash.name: Legendary Action: Sanguine Lash
legendary_action_sanguine_lash.description: Orin can use  Sanguine Lash after being attacked. If Orin does not use her Legendary Action in a round,  Bhaal's Edict is placed on a creature.

legendary_action_shredding_scales.name: Legendary Action: Shredding Scales
legendary_action_shredding_scales.description: While it has  Diamond Scales, the Bulette can use  Shredding Scales immediately after being hit for the first time in a round.

legendary_action_soul_ascension.name: Legendary Action: Soul Ascension
legendary_action_soul_ascension.description: Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately cast  Soul Ascension when he or his allies are attacked.

legendary_action_soul_sacrifice.name: Legendary Action: Soul Sacrifice
legendary_action_soul_sacrifice.description: When a humanoid dies, the Ch'r'ai can  Sacrifice its soul to Vlaakith in return for great power. Once 3 souls have been sacrificed, the Ch'r'ai takes on  Vlaakith's Undying Aspect.

legendary_action_spectral_aspect.name: Legendary Action: Spectral Aspect
legendary_action_spectral_aspect.description: Balthazar can adopt his  Spectral Aspect after being struck.

legendary_action_sublimation.name: Legendary Action: Sublimation
legendary_action_sublimation.description: When she loses a piece of armour, Gerringothe Thorm can try to  Sublimate her foes - turning them into  gold.

legendary_action_the_dead_wastes.name: Legendary Action: The Dead Wastes
legendary_action_the_dead_wastes.description: When a creature dies, Balthazar can create a necrotic miasma where it fell that heals Undead 4~24 hit points and deals 4~24 Necrotic damage to living creatures at the start of their turns.

legendary_action_torrential_undeath.name: Legendary Action: Torrential Undeath
legendary_action_torrential_undeath.description: Once per turn upon being hit, Mystic Carrion can use  Torrential Undeath.

legendary_action_tu_narath_s_embrace.name: Legendary Action: Tu'narath's Embrace
legendary_action_tu_narath_s_embrace.description: Paladin Har'rak can use a Legendary Action to cast  Tu'narath's Embrace on an ally to prevent an Incapacitating Condition.

legendary_action_tyrannical_branding.name: Legendary Action: Tyrannical Branding
legendary_action_tyrannical_branding.description: Immediately after being struck, Gortash can  Brand his attacker.

legendary_action_vampiric_swarm.name: Legendary Action: Vampiric Swarm
legendary_action_vampiric_swarm.description: Cazador can call forth a  Swarm of Vampire Bats to attack an enemy who steps within  6 m / 20 ft of him.

legendary_action_vengeful_playmate.name: Legendary Action: Vengeful Playmate
legendary_action_vengeful_playmate.description: Once per round when one of Oliver's summoned shadows is destroyed, he can immediately envelop the nearby area in  The Wasting Quiet.

legendary_action_wail_of_loss.name: Legendary Action: Wail of Loss
legendary_action_wail_of_loss.description: After being attacked, once per round, Malus Thorm can make every assistant cast  Wail of Loss simultaneously.

legendary_action_weird_magic_surge.name: Legendary Action: Weird Magic Surge
legendary_action_weird_magic_surge.description: Auntie Ethel can use her Weird Magic Surge immediately after a spell is cast. A higher level spell will produce more illusory duplicates.

legendary_action_wretched_growth.name: Legendary Action: Wretched Growth
legendary_action_wretched_growth.description: If a creature ends its turn within  5 m / 17 ft of the Shambling Mound, it will take 3d10Necrotic and Shadow-Cursed Vines will grow at its feet, possibly  Entangling it.

legendary_actions_available.name: Legendary Actions Available
legendary_actions_available.description: Raphael has 1-4 use(s) of his Legendary Action remaining this round.

legendary_resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
legendary_resistance.description: Affected entity has a +10 bonus to its next  Saving throw. This can be used 3 times.

legendary_resistance_crowd_control.name: Legendary Resistance: Crowd Control
legendary_resistance_crowd_control.description: You have a +10 bonus to your next  Saving throw affecting multiple targets.

legendary_resistance_incapacitation.name: Legendary Resistance: Incapacitation
legendary_resistance_incapacitation.description: You have a +10 bonus to your next Saving Throw against an incapacitating condition. You can use this 3 times.

legions_of_bone_aura.name: Legions of Bone (Aura)
legions_of_bone_aura.description: If a character dies within  12 m / 40 ft of Ketheric in combat, a Skeletal Involucre will rise where they fell.

legions_of_bone.name: Legions of Bone
legions_of_bone.description: A Skeletal Involucre will rise near this creature if it dies within  12 m / 40 ft of Ketheric.

lethargic.name: Lethargic
lethargic.description: Consumed by exhaustion in the aftermath of  Haste. Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions.

levitating.name: Levitating
levitating.description: The affected entity is suspended in the air.

liberated_spellcasting.name: Liberated Spellcasting
liberated_spellcasting.description: You can cast a level 1 spell without spending a spell slot.

lieges_of_the_underdark_blessing.name: Lieges of the Underdark Blessing
lieges_of_the_underdark_blessing.description: Gains a  +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and  Saving throws.

life_drain.name: Life Drain
life_drain.description: Hit point maximum reduced by 2d8. Creature will die if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

life_essence.name: Life Essence
life_essence.description: Affected entity has absorbed a creature's essence. It can use that essence to cast any Necromancy spell without consuming a spell slot.

life_essence_active.name: Life Essence Active
life_essence_active.description: Affected entity next Necromancy spell can be cast without consuming a spell slot.

life_of_the_party.name: Life of the Party
life_of_the_party.description: Gain +Wisdom modifier bonus to Attack rolls against  Drunk targets.

light.name: Light
light.description: This object has an aura of light with a radius of  7.5 m / 25 ft.

lightly_obscured.name: Lightly Obscured
lightly_obscured.description: Hiding in a Lightly Obscured area. Has to make a Stealth check when caught.

lightning_blast.name: Lightning Blast
lightning_blast.description: Your next Lightning spell or cantrip deals additional Lightning damage equal to your remaining Lightning Charges. On hit, all of your LIghtning Charges are consumed.

lightning_charges.name: Lightning Charges
lightning_charges.description: Lightning courses through you. You have +1 to Attack Rolls and deal an additional 1Lightning damage. If you gain 5 charges, they are consumed the next time you deal damage, and you deal an additional 1d8Lightning damage. You lose 1 charge per turn.

lightning_infusion.name: Lightning Infusion
lightning_infusion.description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d4Lightning the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

lightning_resistance.name: Lightning Resistance
lightning_resistance.description: Resistant to Lightning damage. Can no longer be  Shocked,  Electrocuted,  Jolted, or otherwise affected by lightning.

lightning_resistance_aura.name: Lightning Resistance Aura
lightning_resistance_aura.description: The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to Lightning damage.

living_shadow.name: Living Shadow
living_shadow.description: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this character has Resistance to all damage except Force, Psychic, or Radiant.

lobotomised.name: Lobotomised
lobotomised.description: Us is still suffering from the crippling injury you inflicted all that time ago...

locked_in_single_combat.name: Locked in Single Combat
locked_in_single_combat.description: This fight will end when one party is obviously victorious.

longstrider.name: Longstrider
longstrider.description: Increase a creature's Movement Speed by  3 m / 10 ft.

loviatar_s_love.name: Loviatar's Love
loviatar_s_love.description: Pain is the path to clarity. When you have 30% Hit Points or less, you gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls and Wisdom Saving Throws.

lunar_legionary.name: Lunar Legionary
lunar_legionary.description: Entity grants  Brand of the Silverlight to all allies and  Lunar Radiance to all foes within  18 m / 60 ft.

lunar_protection.name: Lunar Protection
lunar_protection.description: You have Advantage on  Saving throws against spells - even when Wild-Shaped.

lunar_radiance.name: Lunar Radiance
lunar_radiance.description: Affected entity has -2 to Attack Rolls. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it.

lunar_vitality.name: Lunar Vitality
lunar_vitality.description: You have  22 temporary hit points. While having the temporary hit points, all incoming damage is reduced by 1.

lured.name: Lured
lured.description: The affected entity is attracted to a harpy's luring melody and uses its turn to move closer to the harpy, possibly provoking opportunity attacks from the other harpies. The affected entity must pass a DC 13  Wisdom saving throw at the start of their turn or remain lured. Taking damage or being Shoved removes the condition.

luring_song.name: Luring Song
luring_song.description: The affected entity must succeed a Wisdom  Saving throw every turn or is  Lured by the Harpy's song. Success grants the  Resisted the Song condition for 2 turns.

madness.name: Madness
madness.description: Hostile to everyone in the vicinity.

mage_animated.name: Mage-Animated
mage_animated.description: Lorroakan has taken a special interest in this animated armour. As a result, this entity has an additional +5 to its Ability Scores and +20 total Hit Points.

magic_allergy.name: Magic Allergy
magic_allergy.description: Allergic to magic. If a spell or cantrip is cast close to the gremishka, it might react to the magic and trigger a random effect.

magic_allergy_panther_polymorph.name: Magic Allergy: Panther Polymorph
magic_allergy_panther_polymorph.description: This gremishka has been polymorphed into a panther.

magic_awareness.name: Magic Awareness
magic_awareness.description: The barbarian and all creatures within 3 m / 10 ft add a  1d4 bonus to  Saving throws.

magic_awareness_aura.name: Magic Awareness Aura
magic_awareness_aura.description: A nearby barbarian is visualising the Weave. Adds a  1d4 bonus to  Saving throws, as long as they stay within 3 m / 10 ft of the barbarian.

magic_weapon.name: Magic Weapon
magic_weapon.description: Weapon has become magical, receiving a +1 bonus to Attack rolls and Damage Rolls.

magical_ambush.name: Magical Ambush
magical_ambush.description: Affected entity is hidden. Creatures have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws against its spells.

magmatic_disturbance.name: Magmatic Disturbance
magmatic_disturbance.description: The presence of this creature disturbs nearby  Lava, making it bubble and explode. The bubbles deal 2d6Fire damage when they explode. A DC 12  Dexterity saving throw reduces this damage to half.

magmatic_regeneration.name: Magmatic Regeneration
magmatic_regeneration.description: Regain 20d6hit points when starting a turn in  Lava.

maimed.name: Maimed
maimed.description: The affected creature's Movement Speed is reduced to 0. The affected creature has  Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws. The condition is removed by healing.

malefic_possession.name: Malefic Possession
malefic_possession.description: The affected entity acts according to the  Possessing ghost's will and takes 4d8Necrotic damage each turn until it dies or is  Turned.

malfunctioning_shell_of_resistance.name: Malfunctioning Shell of Resistance
malfunctioning_shell_of_resistance.description: The Micromodron Force Curtain malfunctioned, making this character vulnerable to elemental damage for one turn.

mammon_s_hold.name: Mammon's Hold
mammon_s_hold.description: Affected entity has been temporarily transformed into gold. It can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions.

mantle_of_inspiration.name: Mantle of Inspiration
mantle_of_inspiration.description: Imbued with bardic vigour and granted  5 temporary hit points. If hit with a melee attack, the attacker becomes  Charmed.

mantle_of_majesty.name: Mantle of Majesty
mantle_of_majesty.description: Concentrating on Mantle of Majesty. Can still cast any of the spell's variants on any target each turn.

mark_of_putrefaction.name: Mark of Putrefaction
mark_of_putrefaction.description: Marked by the dead. Affected entity is Vulnerable to Necrotic damage, or loses its Necrotic Resistance.

mark_of_the_shifter.name: Mark of the Shifter
mark_of_the_shifter.description: While shapeshifting or disguising itself, the affected entity gains a +1d4 bonus to all  Ability checks.

marked_for_negation.name: Marked for Negation
marked_for_negation.description: The affected entity is within range of the Netherbrain's Orb of Negation. The orb will explode on its turn, dealing 20~200Force damage.

marshal_undead.name: Marshal Undead
marshal_undead.description: An undying magnitude grants the Death Knight and nearby undead  Advantage against being  Turned.

marshalled_undead.name: Marshalled Undead
marshalled_undead.description: The affected entity has  Advantage against being  Turned while within  18 m / 60 ft of the spellcaster.

martial_arts_unarmed_strike.name: Martial Arts: Unarmed Strike
martial_arts_unarmed_strike.description: You can make an unarmed attack as a  Bonus Action this turn.

martial_exertion.name: Martial Exertion
martial_exertion.description: Affected entity has pushed past its physical limits, taking 6d6Piercing damage per turn to perform an additional attack per turn and to double its movement speed.

martialling_cry.name: Martialling Cry
martialling_cry.description: You deal maximum damage on all your attacks.

mating_frenzy.name: Mating Frenzy
mating_frenzy.resistance: Cold, Lightning, Fire, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Force, Necrotic, Poison, Radiant, Thunder
mating_frenzy.description: The alioramus has detected mating pheromones and is understandably a bit feral. It deals 5Piercing damage additional damage, gains Resistance to all damage except Psychic, and can't be  Charmed or  Frightened.

medium_toughness.name: Medium Toughness
medium_toughness.description: This material is unusually strong. Only a hit that deals at least 22 damage can damage it.

meenlock_fear.name: Meenlock Fear
meenlock_fear.description: The affected creature's proximity to a Meenlock fills it with fear. It is  Frightened unless it succeeds a  Wisdom saving throw.

melancholy_heart.name: Melancholy Heart
melancholy_heart.description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its Melancholy Heart by Performing, hearing a performance, or witnessing another act that brings them joy.

melf_s_acid_arrow.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
melf_s_acid_arrow.description: Affected entity takes 2d4Acid damage at the end of their turn.

melt_the_earth.name: Melt the Earth
melt_the_earth.description: Lava pools in this creature's footsteps.

menaced.name: Menaced
menaced.description: The next attack against this creature will be a Critical Hit.

mental_fatigue.name: Mental Fatigue
mental_fatigue.description: Affected entity has a -1 penalty to Wisdom, Intelligence and Charisma saving throws for every turn remaining. When it fails a Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma saving throw while having 5 or more turns of this condition remaining, the entity takes 1d4Psychic damage and is no longer mentally fatigued. Mental Fatigue has a maximum  Duration: 7 turns.

mental_instruction.name: Mental Instruction
mental_instruction.description: Received instruction from Sa'varsh Kethk. Affected entity has 20 temporary hit points and deals an additional 2d6Psychic damage until it loses its temporary hit points.

miasmic_mists.name: Miasmic Mists
miasmic_mists.description: Possibly  Blind targets within  4 m / 13 ft and deal 3~18Necrotic at the start of Cazador's turns.

miasmic_mists_aura.name: Miasmic Mists Aura
miasmic_mists_aura.description: At the start of Cazador's turns, this creature may become  Blinded and take 3~18Necrotic while within  4 m / 13 ft of the vampire.

mind_flayer_form.name: Mind Flayer Form
mind_flayer_form.description: Affected entity has embraced ceremorphosis and become a mind flayer.

mind_mastery.name: Mind Mastery
mind_mastery.description: Forced to make a weapon attack against one of its allies by a duergar mind master. Ends after the attack, or when hit.

mind_sanctuary_depleted.name: Mind Sanctuary: Depleted
mind_sanctuary_depleted.description: You cannot benefit more from Mind Sanctuary this turn.

mind_claws_available.name: Mind-Claws Available
mind_claws_available.description: Inquisitor W'wargaz can use a Legendary Action to summon a  Mind-Claw of Tu'narath twice in a round of combat after he or his allies are struck.

mindbroken.name: Mindbroken
mindbroken.description: Affected entity is  Slowed by the Netherbrain's psyche-shattering might.

mindreader.name: Mindreader
mindreader.description: Ranged attacks have  Disadvantage against this creature.

mindsteal_link_source.name: Mindsteal Link (Source)
mindsteal_link_source.description: Leeching the psychic energy of those around him. Deals an additional 1d4Psychic per creature he's connected to.

mindsteal_link_target.name: Mindsteal Link (Target)
mindsteal_link_target.description: Being drained by Ch'r'ai W'wargaz. Vulnerable to Psychic damage. Condition ends when the affected entity damages Ch'r'ai W'wargaz.

mindstruck.name: Mindstruck
mindstruck.description: Has  Disadvantage on Wisdom  Saving throws.

mirror_image.name: Mirror Image
mirror_image.description: The mirror image distracts attackers, increasing the spellcaster's  Armour Class by 3 per duplicate image. When the caster successfully evades an attack, one of the images disappears.

mirrored.name: Mirrored
mirrored.description: Defeat your Reflection to complete Shar's trial. Attacking another player's Reflection will incur Shar's Wrath!

mirth_wracked.name: Mirth-Wracked
mirth_wracked.description: Stunned by a wild joke. Can't move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions until damaged.

missing_pets.name: Missing Pets
missing_pets.description: Cannot move. Affected entities have  Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack rolls.

mist_form.name: Mist Form
mist_form.description: Transformed into a cloud of mist, now immune to all non-magical damage. This status is removed by sunlight.

mobile_flourish.name: Mobile Flourish
mobile_flourish.description: Can teleport to the target hit with  Mobile Flourish.

mobile_flourish_target.name: Mobile Flourish Target
mobile_flourish_target.description: Targeted by a bard's fluid attack. The bard can teleport next to the creature.

moderately_inebriated.name: Moderately Inebriated
moderately_inebriated.skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Persuasion, Performance, Intimidation, Deception
moderately_inebriated.description: Each sip of his special brew makes Thisobald more intoxicated. He has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity Checks, and has started hallucinating imps.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.description: Spurred on by a sense of urgency. Movement Speed increased by  1.5 m / 5 ft per remaining duration of this effect. Removed when  Restrained, Incapacitated, Prone, or slowed down. Momentum has a maximum  Duration: 5 turns.

moonbeam.name: Moonbeam
moonbeam.description: Creature is engulfed by ghostly flames that dead 2~20Radiant damage per turn. On a successful save, the creature still takes half damage.

moonbeam_aura.name: Moonbeam (Aura)
moonbeam_aura.description: Ghostly flames engulf any creature that enters this silvery light or starts its turn inside the light. They deal 2d10Radiant. On a successful save, targets still take half damage.

moonfire.name: Moonfire
moonfire.description: The blessing of Dame Aylin's divine mother deals 2d10Radiant to foes that come within  3 m / 10 ft of her or start their turn there.

moonlight_butterflies.name: Moonlight Butterflies
moonlight_butterflies.description: Surrounded in moon-pale butterflies, creatures have  Advantage on attacks against the affected entity. When the illusion is fled from or disappears, the entity takes 1d6Psychic.

moonmother_s_embrace.name: Moonmother's Embrace
moonmother_s_embrace.description: The Lady of Silver grants her daughter 100hit points;  Advantage on Attack rolls, +4 to her Strength and Charisma ability scores, and Resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Fire damage.

moonshield.name: Moonshield
moonshield.description: Protected by the light of a Moonlantern or Shadow Lantern. The  Shadow Curse does not affect this entity.

morninglord_s_bulwark.name: Morninglord's Bulwark
morninglord_s_bulwark.description: Lathander's warding light protects this door from any harm dealing less than 50 damage.

morninglord_s_radiance.name: Morninglord's Radiance
morninglord_s_radiance.description: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4Radiant damage.  Duration: Until Long rest

mother_s_loathing.name: Mother's Loathing
