mother_s_loathing.description: Gains Bite until next Long Rest.

mud_drenched.name: Mud-Drenched
mud_drenched.description: Movement Speed is halved Dexterity  Saving throws are reduced by 2 Cannot take Reactions Cannot make  Extra Attacks or  Improved Extra Attacks

muddy.name: Muddy
muddy.description: Affect entity is covered in hardened mud and its Movement Speed is halved. Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage. Removes Burning and the entity becomes Resistant to Fire damage.

multiattack_defence.name: Multiattack Defence
multiattack_defence.description: Affected entity has a -4 penalty to Attack rolls against the ranger it just attacked.

mummy_rot.name: Mummy Rot
mummy_rot.description: Your maximum hit points are reduced by 8. You cannot be healed.

murderous_strikes.name: Murderous Strikes
murderous_strikes.description: After performing four attacks, Sarevok will have embodied Bhaal enough to use  Deathbringer Assault. After performing five attacks, Orin will have embodied Bhaal enough to use  Deathbringer Assault (Orin)

myrkul_s_call.name: Myrkul's Call
myrkul_s_call.description: Hearing Myrkul's call, this creature will sacrifice itself to the Bone Lord.

myrkul_s_gift.name: Myrkul's Gift
myrkul_s_gift.description: Gained  10 temporary hit points. Until it loses these temporary hit points, this creature deals an additional 1d4Necrotic with weapon attacks and has Resistance to Cold and Necrotic damage.

myrkul_s_presence.name: Myrkul's Presence
myrkul_s_presence.description: The apostle exudes the god of death's unholy will and  Bone Chills all nearby creatures.

mysterious_sharran_wound.name: Mysterious Sharran Wound
mysterious_sharran_wound.description: Your old wound is wracking your body with an intense, mysterious pain.

mystic_carrion_s_blinding_curse.name: Mystic Carrion's Blinding Curse
mystic_carrion_s_blinding_curse.description: Affected entity has been cursed by Mystic Carrion. It is  Poisoned and  Blinded. It must succeed a Constitution  Saving throw at the end of its turn or become afflicted with  Mystic Carrion's Restraining Curse and receive 4d10Necrotic damage.

mystic_carrion_s_poisoned_curse.name: Mystic Carrion's Poisoned Curse
mystic_carrion_s_poisoned_curse.description: Affected entity has been cursed by Mystic Carrion. It is  Poisoned. It must succeed a Constitution  Saving throw at the end of its turn or become afflicted by  Mystic Carrion's Blinding Curse and receive 2d10Necrotic damage.

mystic_carrion_s_restraining_curse.name: Mystic Carrion's Restraining Curse
mystic_carrion_s_restraining_curse.description: Affected entity has been cursed by Mystic Carrion. It is  Poisoned,  Blinded,  Restrained, and receives Necrotic damage. Receives 6d10Necrotic damage on a failed Spell save DC  Constitution saving throw each turn.

mystra_s_benevolence.name: Mystra's Benevolence
mystra_s_benevolence.description: Gale has Advantage on Concentration checks.

mystra_s_blessing.name: Mystra's Blessing
mystra_s_blessing.description: Gale is Immune to Fire, Acid, Cold, Force, and Thunder damage unless the damage dealt exceeds 10 points.

mystra_s_blessing_staff_of_arcane_blessi.name: Mystra's Blessing (Staff of Arcane Blessing)
mystra_s_blessing_staff_of_arcane_blessi.description: +1d4 to Attack rolls made with spells

narcoleptic_toxins.name: Narcoleptic Toxins
narcoleptic_toxins.description: Will explode upon death, releasing toxins that put nearby creatures to  Sleep.

nature_s_step.name: Nature's Step
nature_s_step.description: Nearby allies have Resistance against Poison damage and can move freely in the nearby area.

nature_s_wrath.name: Nature's Wrath
nature_s_wrath.description: Cannot move. Attack Rolls against the affected creature have  Advantage. The creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.

nauseated.name: Nauseated
nauseated.description: Vulnerable to Psychic and Acid damage until next Long Rest.

necrosis.name: Necrosis
necrosis.description: Gale exudes Necrotic energy. Creature takes 1~4Necrotic damage every turn.

necrotic_absorption.name: Necrotic Absorption
necrotic_absorption.description: The cage is draining this creature. Deals 10d4Necrotic damage per turn this condition is active.

necrotic_aura.name: Necrotic Aura
necrotic_aura.description: Gale exudes Necrotic energy. Nearby creatures take 1d4Necrotic every turn.

necrotic_veil.name: Necrotic Veil
necrotic_veil.resistance: Necrotic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Poison, Psychic, Thunder
necrotic_veil.description: A deathly miasma grants the affected entity 20 Temporary Hit Points. While the affected entity has temporary hit points, it is Resistant to all damage except Radiant and cannot be  Turned.

newborn.name: Newborn
newborn.description: Disadvantage on Attack Rolls. hit points lowered by 10. Cannot take  Reactions. Armour Class lowered by 5.

newborn_zombie.name: Newborn Zombie
newborn_zombie.description: Zombies born from the Crawling Gnaw cannot last. They take 1Necrotic each turn and only follow the zombie that infected them.

nightbringer_s_beloved.name: Nightbringer's Beloved
nightbringer_s_beloved.description: Shar's ardent favour lets her chosen disciple regain 7d8hit points every time they use their Channel Divinity Charges.

nightsinger_s_favour.name: Nightsinger's Favour
nightsinger_s_favour.description: Affected entity is Resistant to Necrotic damage until your next Long Rest.

non_lethal_damage.name: Non-Lethal Damage
non_lethal_damage.description: Non-lethal damage does not kill creatures if it reduces their hit points to 0, it just leaves them unconscious.

noxious_fumes.name: Noxious Fumes
noxious_fumes.description: Hostile creatures in a radius of  3 m / 10 ft take 1d4Acid damage.

noxious_fumes_bibberbang.name: Noxious Fumes (Bibberbang)
noxious_fumes_bibberbang.description: Affected entity takes 1d4Poison each turn. It must succeed a DC 15  Constitution saving throw or take an additional 2d4Poison, taking half damage in a success.

numb.name: Numb
numb.description: Your puny attacks can't break through the numbness Thisobald feels. He is Immune to Slashing, Piercing, Bludgeoning and Thunder damage.

numbed.name: Numbed
numbed.description: Movement Speed halved. The spellcaster has  Advantage on Attack Rolls against the affected entity. Removed by Help, or when hit by the spellcaster.

oath_broken.name: Oath Broken
oath_broken.description: You have broken your sacred Oath and betrayed your beliefs. You can no longer use Channel Oath Charges. You should go to camp and contemplate what happened and what comes next.

off_balance.name: Off Balance
off_balance.skills: Athletics, Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth
off_balance.description: The affected entity has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Ability checks, and Attack rolls against the entity have  Advantage. Removed by taking damage or when  Helped.

off_balance_gargantuan_cleave.name: Off Balance (Gargantuan Cleave)
off_balance_gargantuan_cleave.description: When hit, must succeed a DC 8  Strength saving throw or fall  Prone.

oil_of_accuracy.name: Oil of Accuracy
oil_of_accuracy.description: Has a +2 bonus to Attack rolls with the oiled weapon

oil_of_combustion.name: Oil of Combustion
oil_of_combustion.description: If the affected entity takes Fire damage, it deals 3d6Fire in  AoE: 3 m / 10 ft (Radius) area.

oily_sup.name: Oily Sup
oily_sup.description: Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks.

omen_of_acid.name: Omen of Acid
omen_of_acid.description: If the affected entity is dealt 1Acid damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1  Sorcery Point.

omen_of_cold.name: Omen of Cold
omen_of_cold.description: If the affected entity is dealt 1Cold damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1  Sorcery Point.

omen_of_fire.name: Omen of Fire
omen_of_fire.description: If the affected entity is dealt 1Fire damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1  Sorcery Point.

omen_of_lightning.name: Omen of Lightning
omen_of_lightning.description: If the affected entity is dealt 1Lightning damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1  Sorcery Point.

omen_of_poison.name: Omen of Poison
omen_of_poison.description: If the affected entity is dealt 1Poison damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1  Sorcery Point.

omen_of_thunder.name: Omen of Thunder
omen_of_thunder.description: If the affected entity is dealt 1Thunder damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1  Sorcery Point.

one_with_the_shadows.name: One with the Shadows
one_with_the_shadows.description: Affected entity is invisible. It has  Advantage on Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity moves, attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

onus_of_battle.name: Onus of Battle
onus_of_battle.description: Affected entity can immediately use a  Reaction to make a weapon attack.

open_hand_technique_staggered.name: Open Hand Technique: Staggered
open_hand_technique_staggered.description: Took a powerful blow. Can't take  Reactions.

open_warrens.name: Open Warrens
open_warrens.description: Kobolds cannot emerge from this tunnel while it is obstructed.

open_wound.name: Open Wound
open_wound.description: Creature has recently cut itself. Will lead into the  Rotting condition if a DC 15  Constitution saving throw fails. Removed by healing.

orphic_favour.name: Orphic Favour
orphic_favour.description: While within  18 m / 60 ft of Prince Orpheus, the affected entity has resistance to Psychic and a +3 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

orphic_favour_aura.name: Orphic Favour Aura
orphic_favour_aura.description: The Prince of the Comet protects his champions. He and nearby allies gain resistance to Psychic and a +3 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

otherworldly_miasma.name: Otherworldly Miasma
otherworldly_miasma.description: Weakened by alien fumes. Vulnerable to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

otherworldly_miasma_githyanki.name: Otherworldly Miasma (Githyanki)
otherworldly_miasma_githyanki.description: Alien fumes have hardened this githyanki's skin. It is resistant to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

otiluke_s_resilient_sphere.name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
otiluke_s_resilient_sphere.description: The affected creature is enclosed in an arcane sphere and can neither be damaged by attacks or effects from outside the sphere, nor can it damage anything outside the sphere. The affected creature's Movement Speed is halved.

otto_s_irresistible_dance.name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
otto_s_irresistible_dance.description: Unable to take Actions or Move Attackers have  Advantage on Attack rolls Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws

overgrown_foliage.name: Overgrown Foliage
overgrown_foliage.description: Creatures move at quarter speed in the overgrown foliage.

overheating.name: Overheating
overheating.description: This overheating device will explode the next time it's used, dealing 8d8Fire to all nearby creatures. Find a way to cool it or stay away!

overloaded_optical_circuit.name: Overloaded Optical Circuit
overloaded_optical_circuit.description: The Steel Watcher's scanner has been overloaded with light, and cannot scan citizens anymore.

overloaded_with_synaptic_power.name: Overloaded With Synaptic Power
overloaded_with_synaptic_power.description: Affected entity deals an additional 1d4Psychic damage with its attacks, but also receives 1d4Psychic damage per turn.

owl_s_wisdom.name: Owl's Wisdom
owl_s_wisdom.skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival

owlbear_s_rage.name: Owlbear's Rage
owlbear_s_rage.description: The owlbear is enraged! Strength and Constitution increased by 2, and gained  12 temporary hit points. The owlbear has resistance to all Physical damage

owlbear_s_rage_wildshape.name: Owlbear's Rage Wildshape
owlbear_s_rage_wildshape.description: The owlbear is enraged! Strength and Constitution are increased by 2. The owlbear gains  12 temporary hit points.

pacified.name: Pacified
pacified.description: Incapacitated. Can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions.

pacified_ptaris.name: Pacified (Ptaris)
pacified_ptaris.description: While near another creature affected by  Ptarian Pacifism, this creature cannot harm Ptaris.

pack_tactics.name: Pack Tactics
pack_tactics.description: Has  Advantage on Attack rolls if one of its allies is within  0.5 m / 2 ft of its target and isn't Incapacitated.

pact_weapon.name: Pact Weapon
pact_weapon.description: The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it. The weapon's damage is magical. The weapon uses the caster's Charisma modifier for Attack rolls and damage rolls. Prevents the weapon from being dropped or otherwise disarmed.

paid_the_price.name: Paid the Price
paid_the_price.description: You have a +1 bonus to Intimidation checks, but  Disadvantage on Perception checks. Additionally, you have  Disadvantage when attacking Hags.

panache_disadvantage.name: Panache: Disadvantage
panache_disadvantage.description: You have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against all enemies except the caster of  Panache. You are also unable to make Opportunity Attacks against enemies other than the caster.

panicked_sentinel.name: Panicked Sentinel
panicked_sentinel.description: This paranoiac Spectator will immediately fire a random Eye Ray at any creature it can see that moves within  6 m / 20 ft of it.

paralysed.name: Paralysed
paralysed.description: The affected creature cannot move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions. The affected creature automatically fails all  Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against the affected creature automatically succeed. Any Attack roll made against The affected creature by an attacker within  3 m / 10 ft is an automatic Critical Hit.

paralysed_karabasan_s_gift.name: Paralysed (Karabasan's Gift)
paralysed_karabasan_s_gift.description: Creature is Incapacitated Vulnerable to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage. Automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity  Saving throws Any Attack Roll made against this creature by an attacker within  3 m / 10 ft automatically hits and is an automatic Critical Hit

paranoid_dreams.name: Paranoid Dreams
paranoid_dreams.description: When this Spectator is struck, it dreams in fear. After 5 Paranoid Dreams, it will spend a Legendary Action to cast  Ocular Nightmare. If the Spectator uses one of its Eye Rays, it loses one Paranoid Dream.

parried.name: Parried
parried.description: Already  Parried this turn and has to recover before Parrying again.

pass_without_trace.name: Pass Without Trace
pass_without_trace.description: Veiled by an ally. +10 bonus to Stealth Checks.

pass_without_trace_aura.name: Pass Without Trace Aura
pass_without_trace_aura.description: This entity and nearby allies have a +10 bonus to  Stealth checks.

patient_defence.name: Patient Defence
patient_defence.description: Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Disadvantage. The entity has  Advantage on  Dexterity saving throws.

performing_bard_dance.name: Performing 'Bard Dance'
performing_bard_dance.description: Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.

performing_of_divinity_and_sin.name: Performing 'Of Divinity and Sin'
performing_of_divinity_and_sin.description: Playing a mysterious tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.

performing_old_time_battles.name: Performing 'Old Time Battles'
performing_old_time_battles.description: Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.

performing_sing_for_me.name: Performing 'Sing for Me'
performing_sing_for_me.description: Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.

performing_the_power.name: Performing 'The Power'
performing_the_power.description: Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.

performing_the_queen_s_high_seas.name: Performing 'The Queen's High Seas'
performing_the_queen_s_high_seas.description: Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.

perilous_stakes.name: Perilous Stakes
perilous_stakes.vulnerability: Cold, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
perilous_stakes.description: Affected entity is Vulnerable to all damage, but when it attacks it heals 2d8hit points.

permanent_mind_sanctuary.name: Permanent Mind Sanctuary
permanent_mind_sanctuary.description: While in combat, Mind Flayers can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.

petrified.name: Petrified
petrified.description: Turned to stone. Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions.

phantasmal_force.name: Phantasmal Force
phantasmal_force.description: Haunted by an echo of the last thing that attacked them. Takes 1d6Psychic damage each turn. When the target takes damage from another source, Phantasmal Force changes to that damage type. At the end of each turn, the target makes an  Intelligence saving throw. On a success, the condition ends.

phantasmal_killer.name: Phantasmal Killer
phantasmal_killer.description: Affected entity is haunted by its worst nightmares. It takes 4d10Psychic damage per turn, cannot move, and has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.

phase_optimizer_active.name: Phase Optimizer Active
phase_optimizer_active.description: The affected entity gains an additional action.

pierce_the_weak.name: Pierce the Weak
pierce_the_weak.description: Affected entity is Vulnerable to Piercing damage for 3 turns, or until it takes damage.

pinched.name: Pinched
pinched.description: Take 1d4Piercing damage at the beginning of each turn and Movement Speed is reduced by 3 m / 10 ft.

pinned_down.name: Pinned Down
pinned_down.description: Movement Speed is reduced by  3 m / 10 ft.

pixie_blessing.name: Pixie Blessing
pixie_blessing.description: The Shadow Curse cannot affect this creature thanks to a pixie's protective magic.

plant_growth.name: Plant Growth
plant_growth.description: The ground is covered with plants and weeds. Movement Speed is quartered.

poison_resistance.name: Poison Resistance
poison_resistance.description: Resistant to Poison damage. Can no longer be  Poisoned.

poison_resistance_aura.name: Poison Resistance Aura
poison_resistance_aura.description: The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to Poison damage.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.description: Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks.

poisoned_suspicious_poison.name: Poisoned (Suspicious Poison)
poisoned_suspicious_poison.description: Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks. Inflicts 3d6Poison every turn until a successful DC 13  Constitution saving throw.

poisoned_spider_meat.name: Poisoned (Spider Meat)
poisoned_spider_meat.description: Deals 3d6Poison per turn Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks. At the beginning of the turn, makes a DC 13  Constitution saving throw to end the condition on success.

poisonous_fumes.name: Poisonous Fumes
poisonous_fumes.description: Takes 1d4Poison damage per turn. Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.

polma_s_wrath.name: Polma's Wrath
polma_s_wrath.description: Polma is enraged! Strength increased by 4, Armour Class reduced by 2.

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.description: You are now a particularly ripe wheel of cheese, unpleasant to the nostril.

polymorph_self.name: Polymorph Self
polymorph_self.description: Transformed into a blue jay, able to  Fly for 5 rounds.

polymorphed.name: Polymorphed
polymorphed.description: Creature is turned into a harmless sheep with 3 Hit Points for 5 turns. If the sheep's Hit Points are reduced to 0, the creature reverts to its original form with its original Hit Points.

poor_performance.name: Poor Performance
poor_performance.description: Maybe you'd better stop, before anyone starts throwing rocks.

possessing.name: Possessing
possessing.description: The affected entity cannot be targeted by spells or attacks until the creature it has  Possessed dies or is  Turned.

potent_mist_form.name: Potent Mist Form
potent_mist_form.description: Transformed into a cloud of mist, now immune to all non-magical damage and resistant to magical damage. Possibly  Blind foes within  4 m / 13 ft and inflict 3d6Necrotic at the start of their turn. This condition is removed by sunlight.

potion_of_angelic_relief.name: Potion of Angelic Relief
potion_of_angelic_relief.description: Affected entity falls asleep for 2 rounds. When it wakes up, it receives the effects of a Short Rest and all 1st and 2nd level spell slots are restored. If interrupted before the duration expires, the effects will not apply.

potion_of_angelic_slumber.name: Potion of Angelic Slumber
potion_of_angelic_slumber.description: Affected entity falls asleep for 2 rounds. When it wakes up, it receives the effects of a Long Rest. If interrupted before the duration expires, the effects do not apply.

precision_attack.name: Precision Attack
precision_attack.description: Affected entity has a bonus to its next weapon Attack Roll equal to its Superiority Die

predator_essence.name: Predator Essence
predator_essence.description: Each Predator Essence heals the Houndmaster for 4d10hit points. Moreover, he deals an additional 4d10necrotic when he casts  Grave Shot.

prepared.name: Prepared
prepared.description: Deals an additional [Strength modifier]SlashingDRS damage with melee attacks.

prime_target.name: Prime Target
prime_target.description: You have drawn Grym's ire. Grym will attempt to attack this creature if possible.

produce_flame.name: Produce Flame
produce_flame.description: A flickering flame sheds light in a  9 m / 30 ft radius around the creature.

profane_womb_bound.name: Profane Womb-Bound
profane_womb_bound.description: Silenced and held in place by a Profane Womb.

profoundly_intoxicated.name: Profoundly Intoxicated
profoundly_intoxicated.skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Persuasion, Performance, Intimidation, Deception
profoundly_intoxicated.description: Thisobald is on the verge of passing out from his heavy drinking. He has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity Checks, and his hallucinations continue.

projected_image.name: Projected Image
projected_image.description: This magical projection cannot be targeted or attacked.

promise_of_wealth.name: Promise of Wealth
promise_of_wealth.description: Affected entity has been marked as wealthy by a follower of Mammon. Creatures with Infectious Greed have Advantage on Attack Rolls against it.

prone.name: Prone
prone.description: The affected creature cannot move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on  Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if made within  3 m / 10 ft of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up.A character with the Athlete feat spends only  1.5 m / 5 ft of Movement Speed to stand up.

prophecy_a_blunt_tool.name: Prophecy: A Blunt Tool
prophecy_a_blunt_tool.description: Deal at least 1Bludgeoning to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_a_little_help.name: Prophecy: A Little Help
prophecy_a_little_help.description: Casting an Conjuration spell will result in a new Portent Die.

prophecy_a_little_prick.name: Prophecy: A Little Prick
prophecy_a_little_prick.description: Deal at least 1Piercing to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_burn_after_reading.name: Prophecy: Burn After Reading
prophecy_burn_after_reading.description: Deal at least 1Fire to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_changes.name: Prophecy: Changes
prophecy_changes.description: Casting an Transmutation spell will result in a new Portent Die.

prophecy_cutting_edge.name: Prophecy: Cutting Edge
prophecy_cutting_edge.description: Deal at least 1Slashing to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_dead_right.name: Prophecy: Dead Right
prophecy_dead_right.description: Casting an Necromancy spell will result in a new Portent Die.

prophecy_delivering_alms.name: Prophecy: Delivering Alms
prophecy_delivering_alms.description: When you  Help an ally, you will gain a new Portent Die.

prophecy_evocative.name: Prophecy: Evocative
prophecy_evocative.description: Casting an Evocation spell will result in a new Portent Die.

prophecy_feign_surprise.name: Prophecy: Feign Surprise
prophecy_feign_surprise.description: Casting an Illusion spell will result in a new Portent Die.

prophecy_forceful_insistence.name: Prophecy: Forceful Insistence
prophecy_forceful_insistence.description: Deal at least 1Force to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_frosty_reception.name: Prophecy: Frosty Reception
prophecy_frosty_reception.description: Deal at least 1Cold to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_grave_fate.name: Prophecy: Grave Fate
prophecy_grave_fate.description: Deal at least 1Necrotic to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_guarded.name: Prophecy: Guarded
prophecy_guarded.description: Casting an Abjuration spell will result in a new Portent Die.

prophecy_headache.name: Prophecy: Headache
prophecy_headache.description: Deal at least 1Psychic to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_holy_epiphany.name: Prophecy: Holy Epiphany
prophecy_holy_epiphany.description: Deal at least 1Radiant to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_melting_pot.name: Prophecy: Melting Pot
prophecy_melting_pot.description: Deal at least 1Acid to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_predictable.name: Prophecy: Predictable
prophecy_predictable.description: Casting an Divination spell will result in a new Portent Die.

prophecy_reap_rewards.name: Prophecy: Reap Rewards
prophecy_reap_rewards.description: Dealing the killing blow to an enemy will result in a new a Portent Die after taking a short rest.

prophecy_shocking_revelation.name: Prophecy: Shocking Revelation
prophecy_shocking_revelation.description: Deal at least 1Lightning to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_spellbinding.name: Prophecy: Spellbinding
prophecy_spellbinding.description: Casting an Enchantment spell will result in a new Portent Die.

prophecy_thunderous_applause.name: Prophecy: Thunderous Applause
prophecy_thunderous_applause.description: Deal at least 1Thunder to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_venomous_words.name: Prophecy: Venomous Words
prophecy_venomous_words.description: Deal at least 1Poison to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.

prophecy_well_read.name: Prophecy: Well-Read
prophecy_well_read.description: Learning from or using a Spell Scroll will result in a new Portent Die.

protection_from_evil_and_good.name: Protection from Evil and Good
protection_from_evil_and_good.description: The target is protected against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead. These creatures have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against the target, and the target can't be Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by them.

protection_from_poison.name: Protection from Poison
protection_from_poison.description: All previous Poisonous effects afflicting the target are neutralized Target gains  Advantage on  Saving throws against being Poisoned Target gains Resistance to Poison damage

prowling.name: Prowling
prowling.description: Stalking its prey. While  Invisible, the affected entity's next attack deals additional 1d8 damage.

prying_heart.name: Prying Heart
prying_heart.description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its Prying Heart by  Poisoning itself.

psionic_drain.name: Psionic Drain
psionic_drain.description: Your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores are reduced by 2 while Ptaris drains your mind to form a Mental Image. If any ability score reaches 0, you die. Destroying the Mental Image releases the psionic energy and ends this effect.

psionic_enrichment.name: Psionic Enrichment
psionic_enrichment.description: After using a tadpole power, affected entity gains  Advantage on all attacks for 3 rounds.

psionic_visages.name: Psionic Visages
psionic_visages.description: Affected entity is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage while a Psionic Visage stands. When the caster is struck, a visage will shatter, striking the attacker directly with 2d6Psychic damage.

psionic_ward.name: Psionic Ward
psionic_ward.description: Affected entity has a +5 bonus to  Saving throws and can't be  Frightened while within  3 m / 10 ft of the spellcaster.

psionic_ward_aura.name: Psionic Ward Aura
psionic_ward_aura.description: The gish and allies within  3 m / 10 ft have a +5 bonus to Saving Throws and can't be  Frightened.

psionic_weakening.name: Psionic Weakening
psionic_weakening.description: Affected entity has  Disadvantage on Constitution, Wisdom and Intelligence  Saving throws. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

psychic_rend.name: Psychic Rend
psychic_rend.skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
psychic_rend.description: Mentally in shambles. Has Disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and Saving Throws.

psychically_dominated.name: Psychically Dominated
psychically_dominated.description: This dragon is being controlled by the deep, twisting grasp of the Netherbrain's psychic might.

ptarian_pacifism.name: Ptarian Pacifism
ptarian_pacifism.description: Affected entity's Strength, Dexterity and Constitution scores have been reduced by 4. It and nearby allies are  Pacified. Unless the  50 temporary hit points granted by this effect are removed, when the effect ends, one of Ptaris' Mental Image will appear.

punish_divinity.name: Punish Divinity
punish_divinity.description: When hit with Radiant damage, Raphael can use a reaction to stun the attacker, leaving the impudent creature  Soul Wrenched

purple_worm_toxin.name: Purple Worm Toxin
purple_worm_toxin.description: Affected entity takes 1d10Poison damage at the end of its next turn.

pursuit_protocol.name: Pursuit Protocol
pursuit_protocol.description: You attacked a Steel Watcher. The Steel Watch are searching for you across the city.

qua_nith_alert_active.name: Qua'nith: Alert Active
qua_nith_alert_active.description: Voss's psionic detector has warned you of an imminent githyanki attack. You gain a +5 bonus to your initiative check and have Advantage on your next Attack Roll.

quickening_incantation.name: Quickening Incantation
quickening_incantation.description: You can cast Illusion and Enchantment Spells as a bonus action.

quickly_ticking_mine.name: Quickly Ticking Mine
quickly_ticking_mine.description: This grenade will explode on the end of its turn!

quickspell_flinger.name: Quickspell Flinger
quickspell_flinger.description: Cantrips that cost an  Action cost a  Bonus Action instead.

radiant_retort.name: Radiant Retort
radiant_retort.description: Whenever you take Radiant damage, reflect it back at your attacker twofold as Force damage.

radiating_orb.name: Radiating Orb
radiating_orb.description: Affected entity has -1 to Attack Rolls per remaining turn. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it. Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity makes an attack.

rage.name: Rage
rage.description: Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, unarmed strikes, and while throwing objects. Has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on Spells.

rage_boar.name: Rage (Boar)
rage_boar.description: Deals an additional 2 + 1d4Slashing[See Notes] damage with melee attacks. Is  Enlarged[See Notes]. Has Resistance to physical damage, and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws. Can use  Frenzied Strike (Boar). Rage ends early if the boar didn't attack an enemy or take damage since its last turn.

rage_impeded.name: Rage Impeded
rage_impeded.description: Weighed down by Heavy Armour. Until the armour is removed, Raging won't grant extra damage, resistance to physical damage, or  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws.

rage_bear_heart.name: Rage: Bear Heart
rage_bear_heart.resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Radiant, Thunder
rage_bear_heart.description: Deals an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has resistance to all damage except Psychic damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells. Rage ends early if the barbarian didn't attack an enemy or take damage since their last turn.

rage_eagle_heart.name: Rage: Eagle Heart
rage_eagle_heart.description: Can use  Dash as a  Bonus Action, and foes have  Disadvantage on  Opportunity Attacks. Deals an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.

rage_elk_heart.name: Rage: Elk Heart
rage_elk_heart.description: Movement speed increased by  4.5 m / 15 ft and can use  Primal Stampede. Deals an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.

rage_tiger_heart.name: Rage: Tiger Heart
rage_tiger_heart.description: Jump distance increased by  4.5 m / 15 ft and can use  Tiger's Bloodlust. Deals an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.

rage_wolf_heart.name: Rage: Wolf Heart
rage_wolf_heart.description: Can use  Inciting Howl and allies have  Advantage on melee Attack rolls against enemies within  2 m / 7 ft. Deals an additional 2 damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects. Also has resistance to Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving throws. Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.

rage_wolf_heart_s_prey.name: Rage: Wolf Heart's Prey
rage_wolf_heart_s_prey.description: Standing near a Raging Wolf Heart barbarian. The barbarian's allies have  Advantage on melee Attack rolls against this creature.

raging_vortex.name: Raging Vortex
raging_vortex.description: Affected entity is  Silenced and is being dealt 2d8Bludgeoning damage per turn while remaining in the vortex.

rallied.name: Rallied
rallied.description: Granted  8 temporary hit points by a friendly combatant's rallying cry.

rallied_endgame.name: Rallied (Endgame)
rallied_endgame.description: The galvanising word and will of Duke Ravengard runs hot through your veins - granting you 30 temporary hit points.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.description: When a gnoll Downs a creature with a melee attack on its turn, it regains 1 bonus action and half of its movement speed.

rampart_aura.name: Rampart Aura
rampart_aura.description: All entities with or in this aura have their movement speed halved.

rapport_spores.name: Rapport Spores
rapport_spores.description: Affected creatures can communicate telepathically with one another. Does not have a mechanical effect.

rapture.name: Rapture
rapture.description: Has a +1d6 bonus to Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, and Saving Throws. Until next long rest.

ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray_of_frost.description: Movement Speed is reduced by  3 m / 10 ft.

reactive_restoration.name: Reactive Restoration
reactive_restoration.description: When  Blinded,  Paralysed, or  Poisoned, the affected entity is automatically  Restored.

ready_to_parry.name: Ready to Parry
ready_to_parry.description: The Githyanki stands ready to parry the next weapon attack, reducing its incoming damage by 10. The Githyanki can parry an attack as long as they have a  Reaction, they wield a greatsword, and they aren't  Blinded,  Incapacitated or  Restrained.

ready_to_parry_supreme.name: Ready to Parry (Supreme)
ready_to_parry_supreme.description: The Githyanki stands ready to parry the next weapon attack, reducing its incoming damage by 20. The Githyanki can parry an attack as long as they have a  Reaction, they wield a greatsword, and they aren't  Blinded,  Incapacitated or  Restrained.

reaper_s_reward.name: Reaper's Reward
reaper_s_reward.description: Consumed a necromite's soul and gained the ability to cast  Finger of Death

reapply_hex.name: Reapply Hex
reapply_hex.description: Can cast Hex without expending a new spell slot.

recast_speak_with_dead.name: Recast Speak with Dead
recast_speak_with_dead.description: Can recast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.

recharging.name: Recharging
recharging.description: This device cannot fire this turn.

reckless_attack.name: Reckless Attack
reckless_attack.description: You have  Advantage on Attack Rolls, but enemies also have Advantage on Attack Rolls against you.

reckless_roar.name: Reckless Roar
reckless_roar.description: Creature has  Advantage on Attack Rolls, but its attackers also have Advantage on Attack Rolls against the creature

reconfigured_undead.name: Reconfigured: Undead
reconfigured_undead.description: The foulest stench is in the air...

recovering.name: Recovering
recovering.description: Thisobald has had enough of his own concoctions - for now. Soon the numbness will set in once more, and the cycle will start all over again.

reduced.name: Reduced
reduced.description: Size is reduced. Weapon attacks deal  1d4 less damage. Has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws. Carrying Capacity is reduced by 25%

reduced_duergar.name: Reduced (Duergar)
reduced_duergar.description: Size is reduced. Has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks and  Saving throws. Attacks deal  1d4 less damage.

reeling.name: Reeling
reeling.description: Recovering from receiving a terrible blow or hitting a strong metal. Has a -1 penalty to Attack Rolls for every turn remaining. Reeling has a maximum  Duration: 10 turns.

reflective_mucus.name: Reflective Mucus
reflective_mucus.description: Reflects the first projectile flying towards it back at the attacker, after which the mucus is removed.

reflective_shell.name: Reflective Shell
reflective_shell.description: Projectiles targeted at this creature are reflected back to their point of origin.

reflectoguard_active.name: Reflectoguard Active
reflectoguard_active.description: Any projectile fired at this character is sent back to where it came from.

refreshed.name: Refreshed
refreshed.description: Hit Point maximum increased by 10 until the next Long Rest. Turns into  Nauseated after a Long Rest.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: The Wood Woad regains 10hit points if it walks through a vine surface, unless it recently took Fire damage.

rejuvenating_miasma.name: Rejuvenating Miasma
rejuvenating_miasma.description: Animate Dead doesn't require a corpse in this area due to a lingering necrotic stench.

relentless_avenger.name: Relentless Avenger
relentless_avenger.description: You have a  4.5 m / 15 ft bonus to your Movement Speed

rended_flesh.name: Rended Flesh
rended_flesh.description: Affected entity can't be healed and can't gain Temporary Hit Points.

repair_matrix.name: Repair Matrix
repair_matrix.description: At the start of its turn, restorative servos heal this Steel Watcher for 3d8hit points.

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.description: Gains a  +1d4 bonus to  Saving throws.

resistant_to_acid_damage.name: Resistant to Acid Damage
resistant_to_acid_damage.description: Acid damage against this entity is halved.

resistant_to_cold_damage.name: Resistant to Cold Damage
resistant_to_cold_damage.description: Cold damage against this entity is halved.

resistant_to_fire_damage.name: Resistant to Fire Damage
resistant_to_fire_damage.description: Fire damage against this entity is halved.

resistant_to_lightning_damage.name: Resistant to Lightning Damage
resistant_to_lightning_damage.description: Lightning damage against this entity is halved.

resistant_to_necrotic_damage.name: Resistant to Necrotic Damage
resistant_to_necrotic_damage.description: Necrotic damage against this entity is halved.

resistant_to_poison_damage.name: Resistant to Poison Damage
resistant_to_poison_damage.description: Poison damage against this entity is halved.

resistant_to_radiant_damage.name: Resistant to Radiant Damage
resistant_to_radiant_damage.description: Radiant damage against this entity is halved.

resisted_the_song.name: Resisted the Song
resisted_the_song.description: The affected entity succeeded a  Saving throw against the harpy's  Luring Song and is immune to the effects for 2 turns.

resonating_ki.name: Resonating Ki
resonating_ki.description: The ki within the affected entity is resonating with a monk's. The monk can use  Ki Resonation: Blast to make it explode.

restrained.name: Restrained
restrained.description: Cannot move. Attack rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack rolls and  Dexterity saving throws have  Disadvantage

retributive_justice.name: Retributive Justice
retributive_justice.description: This Echo of Bhaal is drawing on new, terrible powers to avenge Sarevok's death.

revealed.name: Revealed
revealed.description: Affected entity lost its  Invisibility due to the effects of  See Invisibility.

reverberation.name: Reverberation
reverberation.description: Affected entity has a -1 penalty to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution  Saving throws per remaining turn. When the entity has 5 or more turns of Reverberation, it takes 1d4Thunder damage and must succeed a DC 10  Constitution saving throw or fall  Prone. The condition is removed afterward. Creatures Immune to Thunder damage can't receive Reverberation.

revitalising_gore.name: Revitalising Gore
revitalising_gore.description: Affected entity is drenched in its enemies' blood. It regains 2d6hit points per turn. At level 10, the healing is increased to 4d6hit points per turn.

righteous_clarity.name: Righteous Clarity
righteous_clarity.description: Has a +proficiency bonus to Attack rolls.

ritual_chant_bhaal_s_power_word_kill.name: Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill
ritual_chant_bhaal_s_power_word_kill.description: As part of the challenge to enter the temple, the Farslayer has begun chanting. It can cast  Bhaal's Power Word Kill once its profane ritual ends. Exiting the Farslayer's chanting range of 55 m / 183 ft makes its enemies invulnerable to the effect. Slaying the Farslayer stops the ritual and wins the conflict.

ritual_component.name: Ritual Component
ritual_component.description: Astarion is Incapacitated as part of a profane ritual until Helped.

ritual_drain_astarion.name: Ritual Drain: Astarion
ritual_drain_astarion.description: Has an additional bonus action after draining Astarion's life force. This effect can only apply once per round.

ritual_drain_violet.name: Ritual Drain: Violet
ritual_drain_violet.description: The creature has an additional +5 to its Armour Class after absorbing Violet's strength.

ritual_drain_yousen.name: Ritual Drain: Yousen
ritual_drain_yousen.description: The creature gains 3d8hit points every turn while drawing on Yousen's vitality.

ritual_sources.name: Ritual Sources
ritual_sources.description: For each ritual source, your movement increases by  1 m / 3 ft, you receive  10 temporary hit pointss and your attacks and spells deal an additional 1d10Necrotic damage, after draining a vampire spawn's life force.

roiling_hellfire.name: Roiling Hellfire
roiling_hellfire.description: 6d6 (6~36) Fire Flames from the heart of Avernus engulf this entity, inflicting 6d6Fire damage per turn.

rotten_reflux.name: Rotten Reflux
rotten_reflux.description: Necrotic damage has spoiled Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Rotting Regurgitation.

rotting.name: Rotting
rotting.description: Open wound is starting to rot.  Disadvantage on  Ability checks and  Saving throws using Charisma. DC 15  Constitution saving throw to remove condition when the condition expires from duration. Failure will lead to you gaining  Flesh Rot.

rumbling_with_kereska_s_thunder.name: Rumbling with Kereska's Thunder
rumbling_with_kereska_s_thunder.description: Affected entity has resistance to Thunder damage. Its thunder spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus. When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of  Reverberation upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's thunder, it can cast  Shatter and  Destructive Wave at 5th level once per short rest.

ruptured.name: Ruptured
ruptured.description: Take 1d4Piercing for each  1 m / 3 ft movement. Each time the damage is triggered, reduce the condition duration by 1.

sacred_defiance.name: Sacred Defiance
sacred_defiance.description: Affected entity has  Advantage against the effects of  Turn Undead while near the spellcaster.

sacred_defiance_aura.name: Sacred Defiance Aura
sacred_defiance_aura.description: Affected entity and nearby undead have  Advantage against the effect of Turn Undead.

sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred_flame.description: The affected entity sheds light in 1.5m radius. It cannot become  Invisible. Enemies are more likely to target this character during the trial.

sacred_munitions.name: Sacred Munitions
sacred_munitions.description: Affected entity's ranged weapon attacks possibly inflict  Turn Undead on a target.

sacred_weapon.name: Sacred Weapon
sacred_weapon.description: Wielder's Charisma Modifier is added to Attack Rolls made with this weapon. The weapon has become magical and emits light.

sacrificed_soul.name: Sacrificed Soul
sacrificed_soul.description: The affected entity has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, and attacks against it have  Advantage while the creature that sacrificed its soul is alive.

sacrificial_lamb.name: Sacrificial Lamb
sacrificial_lamb.resistance: Thunder, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant
sacrificial_lamb.description: Entity can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions while enveloped in vampiric magic. If Cazador draws power from all the spawns bound this way three times, he will ascend. Grants resistance to all damage types.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.description: Affected entity can't be targeted by enemy attacks or spells. However, it can still take damage from spells that influence a larger area. Condition ends if the affected entity attacks or harms another creature, and will receive  Sanctuary Blocked for 1 turn.

sanctuary_of_loss.name: Sanctuary of Loss
sanctuary_of_loss.description: The Nightbringer's dark arcana stops this entity being directly targeted by spells or attacks until it takes a harmful action. Areas of effect can still harm this entity. Viconia can still use  Heartwrench and keep this protection.

sapping_curse.name: Sapping Curse
sapping_curse.description: This cursed energy drains vitality of anyone who dares get closer. Any creature within range of the affected entity gains the condition  Vitality Drain, and takes 4d6+4Necrotic per turn. Take half damage on succeeding DC 8  Wisdom saving throw. Target is cursed.

savage_howl.name: Savage Howl
savage_howl.description: Movement Speed increased by  5 m / 17 ft. Gains  20 temporary hit points

scarlet_remittance_1.name: Scarlet Remittance +1
scarlet_remittance_1.description: Affected entity has +1 bonus to Attack rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC.

scarlet_remittance_2.name: Scarlet Remittance +2
scarlet_remittance_2.description: Affected entity has +2 bonus to Attack rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC.

scarlet_remittance_3.name: Scarlet Remittance +3
scarlet_remittance_3.description: Affected entity has +3 bonus to Attack rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC.

scarlet_saturation.name: Scarlet Saturation
scarlet_saturation.description: Your next attack is guaranteed to Critically Hit.

scarlet_stupor.name: Scarlet Stupor
scarlet_stupor.description: The next creature to roll a  Saving throw against one of your spells has  Disadvantage.

scorching_siphon.name: Scorching Siphon
scorching_siphon.description: A nearby fire myrmidon grants the affected entity Immunity to Fire damage and an additional 3d8Fire damage to  Elemental Retort. The affected entity also gains temporary access to  Fireball and an additional  Reaction per turn.

scratch_s_sniff.name: Scratch's Sniff
scratch_s_sniff.description: Scratch has discovered something of note nearby.

sea_plague.name: Sea Plague
sea_plague.description: Beaded and adrip with thick oily sweat, the affected entity has  Disadvantage on  Ability checks,  Saving throws, and Attack rolls using  Strength.

searing_smite.name: Searing Smite
searing_smite.description: Takes 1d6Fire damage per turn. The condition ends if target succeeds a Constitution  Saving throw.

see_invisibility.name: See Invisibility
see_invisibility.description: Can see Invisible creatures within  9 m / 30 ft. Creatures must succeed a Dexterity  Saving throw or lose their Invisibility.

seething_fury.name: Seething Fury
seething_fury.description: Rage brews within the gnoll. Once it gives in to its fury, it'll be able to attack multiple times per turn. This will evolve into  Festering Frenzy and then  Frenzied Fury, which will allow the gnoll to attack three times per turn.

seized_by_planar_binding.name: Seized by Planar Binding
seized_by_planar_binding.description: Affected entity follows and fights for the one who has bound it. Every time it takes damage, it may break the caster's control over it with a successful  Wisdom saving throw.

self_same_trial.name: Self-Same Trial
self_same_trial.description: Shar has created this reflection as a test. If a creature attacks a reflection that is not their own, it incurs  Cheater's Folly.

selune_s_blessing_lunar_brand.name: Selune's Blessing: Lunar Brand
selune_s_blessing_lunar_brand.description: Your attacks deal an additional 1d4Radiant damage.

sel_ne_s_ire.name: Selûne's Ire
sel_ne_s_ire.description: As a reaction, the Sliver can deal 12d12Radiant damage to an attacker. It can use  Selûne's Ire again after its next turn.

sel_ne_s_seal.name: Selûne's Seal
sel_ne_s_seal.description: A protective shield surrounds the chest, dealing 4d6Radiant damage to any heretics that touch it.

sentinel_foe.name: Sentinel Foe
sentinel_foe.description: Can't move. Restrained by an Opportunity Attack from a Sentinel.

septic.name: Septic
septic.description: Affected entity has its Constitution reduced by 1, and has  Disadvantage on Constitution  Saving throws

serpent_fang_toxin.name: Serpent Fang Toxin
serpent_fang_toxin.description: Affected entity takes 1d6Poison damage at the end of its next turn.

severe_arcane_hunger.name: Severe Arcane Hunger
severe_arcane_hunger.description: The Netherese Orb in Gale's body is severely weakening him. He has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and all  Saving throws. His movement speed is halved.

severed_soul.name: Severed Soul
severed_soul.description: With no soul to motivate it, the affected entity has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and all  Ability checks until  Restore Soul is cast on a Soul Pillar or Raphael.

shackled.name: Shackled
shackled.description: Chained to the ground with iron shackles

shadespell.name: Shadespell
shadespell.description: As long as it remains obscured, the affected entity has +1 to spell save DC.

shadow_curse.name: Shadow Curse
shadow_curse.description: Without a light source, you will take 2d4Necrotic damage every turn. This damage doubles each turn the party members are affected by the Shadow Curse.

shadow_infusion_hound_of_ill_omen.name: Shadow Infusion (Hound of Ill Omen)
shadow_infusion_hound_of_ill_omen.description: Close to another creature of the shadows. The Hound of Ill Omen has gained the Right Behind You reaction.

shadow_infusion_accursed_spectre.name: Shadow Infusion (Accursed Spectre)
shadow_infusion_accursed_spectre.description: Close to another creature of the shadows. The Accursed Spectre has gained the Splinter Shadow reaction.

shadow_possession.name: Shadow Possession
shadow_possession.description: Affected entity is possessed by frenzied shadows and will attack the nearest creature. Its weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4Necrotic damage.

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
shadow_step.description: Affected entity has  Advantage on their next melee Attack roll

shadow_veil.name: Shadow Veil
shadow_veil.description: Because it is Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this entity is Resistant to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

shadow_visage.name: Shadow Visage
shadow_visage.description: This visage is floating in shadowy limbo. It cannot be damaged until drawn into combat.

shadow_animated.name: Shadow-Animated
shadow_animated.description: This armour is animated by shadow, increasing its Ability Scores and Hit Points.

shadow_cursed_undead.name: Shadow-Cursed Undead
shadow_cursed_undead.description: Those who die in the shadows are cursed to remain there forever. These undead have reduced Hit Points and Strength, are Resistant to Necrotic damage and cannot use Spells or Weapon Actions.

shadow_cursed_vines.name: Shadow-Cursed Vines
shadow_cursed_vines.description: Affected entity can't move and takes 1-4NecroticDRS damage per turn. Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while its Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving throws have  Disadvantage.

shapechanged.name: Shapechanged
shapechanged.description: This creature has shapechanged into a male human.

shar_s_blessing_barrier_of_darkness.name: Shar's Blessing: Barrier of Darkness
shar_s_blessing_barrier_of_darkness.description: You have an  Advantage on  Saving throws while in darkness or dim light.

shar_s_embrace.name: Shar's Embrace
shar_s_embrace.description: You cannot move or escape while locked in the  Dark Lady's clutches.

shar_stricken.name: Shar-Stricken
shar_stricken.description: The Lady of Loss  Hexes you, causing a temporary lapse in your agility.

sharran_retribution.name: Sharran Retribution
sharran_retribution.description: Shield of Faith reduces all damage by 2 and deals 1d4Necrotic damage back at the attacker.

shattered.name: Shattered
shattered.description: Imbued with the gnawing exhaustion of endless labour. Receives an additional 1d4Piercing when struck by the war pick Deep Delver.

shattered_psyche_full_illithid.name: Shattered Psyche (Full-illithid)
shattered_psyche_full_illithid.description: Your Armour Class Armour Class is reduced by 6, you have a -5 penalty to all  Saving throws, and  Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws.

shell_of_resistance.name: Shell of Resistance
shell_of_resistance.resistance: Lightning, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Cold, Acid, Force, Necrotic, Radiant, Psychic, Poison
shell_of_resistance.description: Gortash has Immunity to Thunder damage, Resistance to physical and elemental damage for one turn, an extra bonus action and  3 m / 10 ft extra Movement Speed. Tactician only Gortash has Immunity to Fire as well.

shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield_of_faith.description: Receives +2 bonus to Armour Class Armour Class.

shield_of_screams.name: Shield of Screams
shield_of_screams.description: Protected by the screams of his enemies. Attackers take 2d6Psychic damage when they hit Nere with a melee attack.

shielded.name: Shielded
shielded.description: Shielded from the Voice of the Absolute.

shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
shillelagh.description: Creature's weapon is magical and deals  1d8Bludgeoning damage. Attack rolls use the wielder's Spellcasting modifier.

shillelagh_strengthened.name: Shillelagh (Strengthened)
shillelagh_strengthened.description: Creature's weapon is magical and deals 4d8Bludgeoning damage. Attack rolls use the wielder's Spellcasting Ability Modifier. This condition is only available to the summoned Dryad

shocked.name: Shocked
shocked.description: Cannot take reactions and has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Saving Throws using Dexterity.

shocking_brew.name: Shocking Brew
shocking_brew.description: Affected entity deals an additional 2d6Lightning damage while infused with Thisobald's current brew.

shrouded.name: Shrouded
shrouded.description: This painting is obscured while within  6 m / 20 ft of the Judge.

shrouded_sentence.name: Shrouded Sentence
shrouded_sentence.description: The Judge is obscuring paintings within  6 m / 20 ft, preventing judgement being passed on an accused soul.

sickened.name: Sickened
sickened.vulnerability: Cold, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Thunder
sickened.description: Overpowering, indescribable sickness. Vulnerable to most types of damage. Vulnerable to all damage types except Radiant

silence_aura.name: Silence Aura
silence_aura.description: While it remains in the aura, affected entity is  Silenced.

silenced.name: Silenced
silenced.description: Creature can't speak or cast spells with a verbal component, and is immune to Thunder damage.

silkroot_euphoria.name: Silkroot Euphoria
silkroot_euphoria.skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
silkroot_euphoria.description: The creature suffers  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.

silvanus_blessing.name: Silvanus' Blessing
silvanus_blessing.description: Has Proficiency in Nature and Animal Handling

silvered_bulwark.name: Silvered Bulwark
silvered_bulwark.immunity: Thunder, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Radiant, Psychic, Poison, Necrotic, Lightning
silvered_bulwark.description: Affected entity is Immune to all damage. This protection is shared by every creature and object within the barrier.

simple_toxin.name: Simple Toxin
simple_toxin.description: Affected entity takes 1d4Poison damage at the end of its next turn.

singing.name: Singing
singing.description: The harpy  Lures nearby creatures with a magical melody. The song ends if she is incapacitated or loses concentration.

singing_sword_shriek.name: Singing Sword: Shriek
singing_sword_shriek.description: Affected entity has  1d4 penalty to all  Saving throws and Attack rolls. When it is damaged, it takes an additional 1d4Thunder damage.

singing_sword_shrieking.name: Singing Sword: Shrieking
singing_sword_shrieking.description: Enemies within  6 m / 20 ft of range have  1d4 penalty to all  Saving throws and Attack rolls and take an additional 1d4Thunder damage.

singing_sword_singing.name: Singing Sword: Singing
singing_sword_singing.description: All allies within  6 m / 20 ft of range have 1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and  Saving throws.

singing_sword_song.name: Singing Sword: Song
singing_sword_song.description: Wielder has 1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and  Saving throws.

sinister_lord.name: Sinister Lord
sinister_lord.description: With the ritual complete Cazador has ascended. His movement speed is permanently increased by 7 m / 23 ft, the damage of his attacks and spells increases by 7~70Necrotic, and he regains 100hit points per turn.

skilled_skullduggery.name: Skilled Skullduggery
skilled_skullduggery.description: While hidden, the number the affected entity needs to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

slash_the_weak.name: Slash the Weak
slash_the_weak.description: Affected entity is Vulnerable to Slashing damage for 3 turns, or until it takes damage.

slayer_form.name: Slayer Form
slayer_form.description: Affected entity has embraced its savage compulsions, allowing it to assume its Slayer form.

sleeping.name: Sleeping
sleeping.description: A sleeping creature cannot move or act. Moreover, the creature automatically fails  Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against it have  Advantage, and any attack that hits the creature is a critical hit if the attacker is within 1.5 m / 5 ft of the creature. Removed by taking damage, becoming  Wet, receiving  Help or being  Shoved.

slightly_drunk.name: Slightly Drunk
slightly_drunk.skills: Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion
slightly_drunk.description: Just drunk enough for everyone to notice. Strength increased by 2,  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity checks.

slowed.name: Slowed
slowed.description: Movement Speed is halved. Dexterity  Saving throws are reduced by 2. Can only take an Action or a Bonus Action, not both. Cannot take Reactions Cannot make  Extra Attacks or  Improved Extra Attacks. Spells cast might be delayed for one turn

sluggardly.name: Sluggardly
sluggardly.description: Can't make an Opportunity Attack against its most recent attacker.

sneaking.name: Sneaking
sneaking.description: Hiding in an unobscured area. Will be caught on sight.

soul_branding.name: Soul Branding
soul_branding.description: Creature's movement speed is increased by 1.5 m / 5 ft, and its next weapon attack deals an additional 2d4 + 1Fire damage. This condition ends upon landing a successful weapon attack.

soul_caged.name: Soul Caged
soul_caged.description: A Soul Cage binds the Nightsong as an engine for Ketheric's Immunity to all damage. The Nightsong can be  Helped out of the Soul Cage.

soul_charges.name: Soul Charges
soul_charges.description: Raphael has soul(s) to spend on powerful spells.

soul_echo.name: Soul Echo
soul_echo.description: While this companion's body is gone, their soul lingers on and can be used to resurrect them.

soul_oath.name: Soul Oath
soul_oath.description: This creature has sworn a Soul Oath to protect its dark master. Should that master die, this creature will also succumb to death.

soul_overcharge.name: Soul Overcharge
soul_overcharge.description: Raphael has consumed the power of a destroyed Soul Pillar. He is unable to cast spells using Souls until he transforms into the  Ascended Fiend.

soul_pillar_proximity.name: Soul Pillar Proximity
soul_pillar_proximity.description: Raphael is surrounded by Soul Pillars, granting Raphael's attacks an additional 1d12Fire (per pillar) damage and a +3 (per pillar) bonus to his Dexterity score.

soulnumbed.name: Soulnumbed
soulnumbed.description: Can't take  Bonus Actions or  Reactions.

souls_sacrificed_1.name: Souls Sacrificed: 1
souls_sacrificed_1.description: Vlaakith has increased this creature's all of its ability scores by 2. It now fires 3 beams when it casts  Eldritch Blast.

souls_sacrificed_2.name: Souls Sacrificed: 2
souls_sacrificed_2.description: Vlaakith has increased this creature's all of its ability scores by 4. It now fires 4 beams when it casts  Eldritch Blast.

sovereign_s_protection.name: Sovereign's Protection
sovereign_s_protection.description: Protected from the myconids' mushroom traps by the Sovereign's spore sac. "Mushroom traps" like Bibberbang do not notice the affected creature when nearby, enabling safe passage.

speak_with_animals.name: Speak with Animals
speak_with_animals.description: Can comprehend and communicate with beasts.

spectator_s_charm.name: Spectator's Charm
spectator_s_charm.description: A feeble enchantment prevents this creature from attacking the spectator. Any damage could break it...

spectral_aspect.name: Spectral Aspect
spectral_aspect.description: This creature has Resistance to Acid, Fire, Lightning, and Thunder damage, and is Immune to Cold and Necrotic damage. Creatures that strike it become  Bone Chilled for 2 turns. It cannot be  Frightened,  Paralysed,  Petrified,  Restrained or made  Prone. It can also  Fly while in this ghostly form.

spell_rot.name: Spell Rot
spell_rot.description: Unless you are Undead, each time you cast a spell you receive 2d6Necrotic damage per spell level.

spell_rot_necrosis.name: Spell Rot Necrosis
spell_rot_necrosis.description: You receied 2d6Necrotic for casting a level x spell while you have  Spell Rot.

spider_queen_s_wrath.name: Spider Queen's Wrath
spider_queen_s_wrath.description: Creature is enraged! Strength increased by 2. Tactician Difficulty: Creature is enraged! Gains an additional attack per turn. Strength is increased by 2 and has Resistance to physical damage.

spike_growth.name: Spike Growth
spike_growth.description: Take 2d4Piercing for every  1.5 m / 5 ft moved on the spikes.

spindleweb_fanatic.name: Spindleweb Fanatic
spindleweb_fanatic.description: Affected entity deals an additional 1d6Psychic, as long as the source of the aura isn't  Incapacitated.

spindleweb_fanaticism.name: Spindleweb Fanaticism
spindleweb_fanaticism.description: Affected entity and its allies deal an additional 1d6Psychic damage, as long as it isn't  Incapacitated. The entity's movement speed is also increased by 3 m / 10 ft.

spindleweb_sanctuary.name: Spindleweb Sanctuary
spindleweb_sanctuary.description: Affected entity can't be targeted by enemy attacks or spells. However, it can still take damage from spells that influence a larger area. If the affected entity attacks or harms another creature, the sanctuary will shatter, dealing 3~24Psychic to nearby creatures.

spindleweb_skepticism.name: Spindleweb Skepticism
spindleweb_skepticism.description: Affected entity has -6 to Armour Class, as long as the source of the aura isn't  Incapacitated.

spirit_guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
spirit_guardians.description: Spirits assail the affected entity. Takes 3d8Radiant or 3d8Necrotic damage per turn, and Movement Speed is halved. Still takes half damage on a successful Saving Throw.

spirit_guardians_aura.name: Spirit Guardians Aura
spirit_guardians_aura.description: Spirits protect the affected entity. Nearby enemies take 3d8Radiant or 3d8Necrotic damage per turn, and Movement Speed is halved. The caster can't become  Invisible while concentrating on this spell. On a successful save, targets still take half damage. WIS Save

spirit_of_the_land.name: Spirit of the Land
spirit_of_the_land.description: The reunited soul Thaniel provides a +1 to all Ability Scores and an additional 2m movement speed to all affected entities.

spiteful_suffering.name: Spiteful Suffering
spiteful_suffering.description: Affected entity takes 1d4 + Charisma ModifierNecrotic damage each turn and Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage. At the start of each turn, the affected entity makes a  Charisma saving throw to remove this effect.

spoiled_brew.name: Spoiled Brew
spoiled_brew.description: Thisobald emits a rancid, evil stench from his soured brew, dealing 1d6Necrotic to all non-undead in range.

spore_servant.name: Spore Servant
spore_servant.description: The animating spores of a myconid sovereign have taken over this dead creature's body, moving it according to the sovereign's will. Resurrected creature is classified as a plant. Creature is immune to all frightening effects, all blinding effects,  Befuddled,  Noxious Fumes,  Sleeping,  Charmed,  Crown of Madness,  Mind Mastery,  Paralysed, and  Hold Person. Creature is resistant to Poison damage. Creature is unable to cast spells or wild shape.

spreading_spores.name: Spreading Spores
spreading_spores.description: Affected entity is inhaling dry, throat-closing spores that deal 2d8Necrotic damage per turn.

sprouting_necrosis.name: Sprouting Necrosis
sprouting_necrosis.description: At the end of its turns, Shadow-Cursed Vines will sprout at the affected entity's feet.

stage_fright.name: Stage Fright
stage_fright.description: Creature has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls Takes 2d6Psychic damage each time they miss an Attack Roll Removed upon succeeding on an Attack Roll

staggering_smite.name: Staggering Smite
staggering_smite.description: Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks, and can't take reactions.

starry_form_archer.name: Starry Form: Archer
starry_form_archer.description: In Starry Form. As a Bonus Action, you can cast  Luminous Arrow.

starry_form_chalice.name: Starry Form: Chalice
starry_form_chalice.description: In Starry Form. Whenever you cast a healing spell that consumes a spell slot, you can cast  Chalice Healing.

starry_form_dragon.name: Starry Form: Dragon
starry_form_dragon.description: In Starry Form. When you make a Saving Throw to maintain Concentration on a spell, a roll result of 9 or lower is considered a 10. As a Bonus Action while in this Starry Form, you can cast  Dazzling Breath.

stasis.name: Stasis
stasis.description: A headless corpse preserved through esoteric magic.

static_discharge_aura.name: Static Discharge Aura
static_discharge_aura.description: All constructs near Bernard deal an additional 2d4Lightning to weapon attacks. All others take 2d8Lightning each turn. When the condition ends, Bernard is  Stunned for 2 turns.

static_discharge_electroshock.name: Static Discharge: Electroshock
static_discharge_electroshock.description: Standing near a statically charged Bernard. Takes 2d8Lightning each turn, can't take reactions and will take an additional 2d8Lightning if it attacks Bernard.

static_discharge_supercharge.name: Static Discharge: Supercharge
static_discharge_supercharge.description: Standing near a statically charged Bernard. Deals an additional 2d4Lightning.

stealthier.name: Stealthier
stealthier.description: As long as affected entity remains obscured, it has a +3 bonus to Stealth Checks.

steeped_in_bliss.name: Steeped in Bliss
steeped_in_bliss.skills: Athletics, Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth
steeped_in_bliss.description: Seized by great joy, affected entity is more energized and also more mentally compliant. Entity has  Advantage on physical  Ability checks and  Disadvantage on mental  Saving throws. Entity is also vulnerable to Psychic damage.

stench_of_death.name: Stench of Death
stench_of_death.description: Affected entity reeks of decaying matter, a sour greenish smell like a waft of unkept tombs.

step_of_the_wind.name: Step of the Wind
step_of_the_wind.description: Jumping no longer requires a  Bonus Action.

stolen_vigour.name: Stolen Vigour
stolen_vigour.description: Your chosen ability score is reduced by 2.

stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
stoneskin.description: Has Resistance to non-magical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

stormheart_resolve.name: Stormheart Resolve
stormheart_resolve.description: This creature began  Hoarding Energy, gained  100 temporary hit points for 1 round and lost all Incapacitating Conditions after reviving itself.

strength_drain.name: Strength Drain
strength_drain.description: A shadow has drained the affected entity's Strength by 3.

stricken_with_blinding_sickness.name: Stricken With Blinding Sickness
stricken_with_blinding_sickness.skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
stricken_with_blinding_sickness.description: Fingernails of searing pain dig into the affected entity's eyes. It has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks and  Saving throws, and is also Blinded.

stricken_with_crawler_mucus.name: Stricken with Crawler Mucus
stricken_with_crawler_mucus.description: Affected entity is  Poisoned and  Paralysed Lasts until affected entity has made a successful  Constitution saving throw.

stricken_with_drow_poison.name: Stricken with Drow Poison
stricken_with_drow_poison.description: Affected entity is  Poisoned and has fallen  Asleep. Lasts until affected entity has made a successful  Constitution saving throw or takes damage.

stricken_with_eldritch_inertia.name: Stricken with Eldritch Inertia
stricken_with_eldritch_inertia.description: Affected entity has  Disadvantage on its next  Saving throw against a spell cast by the source of the condition.

stricken_with_filth_fever.name: Stricken With Filth Fever
stricken_with_filth_fever.description: Beaded and adrip with thick oily sweat, the affected entity has  Disadvantage on Checks,  Saving throws, and Attack rolls using Strength.

stricken_with_flesh_rot.name: Stricken With Flesh Rot
stricken_with_flesh_rot.vulnerability: Cold, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Thunder, Radiant
stricken_with_flesh_rot.description: Rotting in their own vat of stinking Skin, the affected entity has  Disadvantage on Charisma Checks and Vulnerability to all damage.

stricken_with_malice.name: Stricken with Malice
stricken_with_malice.description: Affected entity is Blinded and Poisoned. Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and its range of attacks and spells is reduced to  3 m / 10 ft. Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage. Suffers  Disadvantage on Ability Checks.

stricken_with_mindfire.name: Stricken With Mindfire
stricken_with_mindfire.description: Affected entity's brain is cooking in a stew of hot blood. It has  Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks and behaves as if  Confused during combat.

stricken_with_seizures.name: Stricken With Seizures
stricken_with_seizures.description: Involuntary convulsions shiver through the affected entity, giving it  Disadvantage on Ability Checks,  Saving throws, and Attack rolls using Dexterity.

stricken_with_slimy_doom.name: Stricken With Slimy Doom
stricken_with_slimy_doom.description: Affected entity oozes waxy, globulous blood. It has  Disadvantage on Constitution Checks and  Saving throws. In addition, whenever it takes damage, it is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.description: Affected creatures cannot move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions. Affected creatures automatically fail  Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Removed by Freedom of Movement, Greater Restoration, Unshackling Strike. Attack Rolls against affected creatures have  Advantage.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.description: This material is rather strong. Only a hit that deals at least 10 damage can damage it.

sudden_rush.name: Sudden Rush
sudden_rush.description: Movement speed is increased to 18 m / 60 ft and moving doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

sumptuously_drained.name: Sumptuously Drained
sumptuously_drained.description: Affected entity's lifeforce has been drained by the incubus, reducing its maximum hit points by  30 hit points.

sunlight_hypersensitivity.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
sunlight_hypersensitivity.description: This creature takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While sunlit, it has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and  Ability checks.

superheated.name: Superheated
superheated.description: Exposure to lava has caused Grym's adamantine body to soften. Can now be affected by certain damage types and is vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage.

superior_elixir_of_arcane_cultivation.name: Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
superior_elixir_of_arcane_cultivation.description: Has an additional  level 3 Spell Slot.

supreme_defences.name: Supreme Defences
supreme_defences.description: While concentrating, you add your Spellcasting Ability Modifier to your  Saving throws.

supreme_elixir_of_arcane_cultivation.name: Supreme Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
supreme_elixir_of_arcane_cultivation.description: Has an additional Level 4 spell slot. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

surgeon_s_chosen.name: Surgeon's Chosen
surgeon_s_chosen.description: Carrying the implement requested by the Surgeon to complete its surgery.

survival_instinct.name: Survival Instinct
survival_instinct.description: If the character reaches 0 Hit Points, it regains 3d4hit points instead of falling Unconscious.

sussur_flower_antimagic_field.name: Sussur Flower Antimagic Field
sussur_flower_antimagic_field.description: A sussur tree flower is draining the character of its magical energy, preventing it from casting spells.

swarmed.name: Swarmed
swarmed.description: Affected entity is Vulnerable to Piercing damage and will take 4d8Piercing every turn. While the entity is Swarmed, Cazador will heal 4d8hit points every turn.

sweet_stone_features.name: Sweet Stone Features
sweet_stone_features.description: Affected entity is blessed by their own depiction in stone. It gains a  +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

swift_as_wind.name: Swift as Wind
swift_as_wind.description: Your next weapon attack has  Advantage. That attack deals an additional 1d8Force.

symbiotic_entity.name: Symbiotic Entity
symbiotic_entity.description: Affected entity has gained 4 Temporary Hit Points per Druid level, its melee weapon or unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d6Necrotic damage, and it deals double damage with  Halo of Spores. [See Notes] Ends early if the entity uses  Wild Shape.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.description: Once per turn, the affected entity can telekinetically throw a creature or object again without expending a Spell Slot

tempestuous_magic_flight.name: Tempestuous Magic: Flight
tempestuous_magic_flight.description: Can  Fly as a bonus action.

tempestuous_siphon.name: Tempestuous Siphon
tempestuous_siphon.description: A nearby air myrmidon grants the affected entity Immunity to Lightning damage and an additional 3d8Lightning damage to  Elemental Rebuke. The affected entity also gains temporary access to  Lightning Bolt and an additional  Reaction per turn.

temporarily_hostile.name: Temporarily Hostile
temporarily_hostile.description: If knocking out this entity or fleeing from combat it may harbour some resentment towards the party, but does not remain hostile.

temporary_hit_points_8.name: Temporary Hit Points (8)
temporary_hit_points_8.description: Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  8 temporary hit points.

temporary_hit_points_10.name: Temporary Hit Points (10)
temporary_hit_points_10.description: Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  10 temporary hit points.

temporary_hit_points_15.name: Temporary Hit Points (15)
temporary_hit_points_15.description: Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  15 temporary hit points.

temporary_hit_points_3.name: Temporary Hit Points (3)
temporary_hit_points_3.description: Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  3 temporary hit points.

temporary_hit_points_4.name: Temporary Hit Points (4)
temporary_hit_points_4.description: Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  4 temporary hit points.

temporary_hit_points_bolstering_smite.name: Temporary Hit Points (Bolstering Smite)
temporary_hit_points_bolstering_smite.description: Gained  Charisma modifier temporary hit points from  Bolstering Smite.

temporary_hit_points_ever_vigilant.name: Temporary Hit Points (Ever Vigilant)
temporary_hit_points_ever_vigilant.description: Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  15 temporary hit points.

temporary_hit_points_stirring_execution.name: Temporary Hit Points (Stirring Execution)
temporary_hit_points_stirring_execution.description: Affected entity has gained  Charisma modifier temporary hit points.

temporary_hit_points_elixir_of_bloodlust.name: Temporary Hit Points (Elixir of Bloodlust)
temporary_hit_points_elixir_of_bloodlust.description: Elixir of Bloodlust granted you  5 temporary hit points. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

temporary_hit_points_well_liked_and_well.name: Temporary Hit Points (Well-Liked and Well-Fortified)
temporary_hit_points_well_liked_and_well.description: Well-Liked and Well-Fortified: instead of dying, you have gained  temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.

temporary_hit_points_drunken_cloth.name: Temporary Hit Points (Drunken Cloth)
temporary_hit_points_drunken_cloth.description: Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  Constitution modifier temporary hit points.

test_subject.name: Test Subject
test_subject.description: You have ingested Araj's potion as part of an experiment.

tharchiate_vigour.name: Tharchiate Vigour
