tharchiate_vigour.description: Granted 20 Temporary Hit Points by The Tharchiate Codex's enervating magic.

tharchiate_withering.name: Tharchiate Withering
tharchiate_withering.description: Your Constitution score is reduced by 5 while cursed by The Tharchiate Codex's warped arcana.

thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
thaumaturgy.description: Has  Advantage on Intimidation and Performance Skill Checks.

the_dead_wastes.name: The Dead Wastes
the_dead_wastes.description: This fragment of Myrkul's realm restores 4d6hit points to Undead and deals 4d6Necrotic to living creatures at the end of their turns in the area.

the_pain_maiden_s_blessing.name: The Pain Maiden's Blessing
the_pain_maiden_s_blessing.description: Gains a  +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and  Saving throws.

the_terazul_jitters.name: The Terazul Jitters
the_terazul_jitters.description: You move faster but become exhausted after moving while under the frenetic influence of Terazul. Affected entity gains an additional  Action, 9 m / 30 ft of movement, and  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving throws. When the condition ends, the affected entity becomes  Lethargic and is completely incapacitated for 1 turn.

the_wasting_quiet_aura.name: The Wasting Quiet (Aura)
the_wasting_quiet_aura.description: Any creatures within this miasma of childlike terror are  Silenced and take 3d8Necrotic damage every time they enter or start their turn inside.

the_wasting_quiet.name: The Wasting Quiet
the_wasting_quiet.description: The creature is  Silenced and takes 3d8Necrotic damage every time they enter or start their turn inside this miasma of childlike terror.

thoroughly_stuffed.name: Thoroughly Stuffed
thoroughly_stuffed.description: The affected entity is immune to Diseases, Poisons, and being Frightened, it makes all Wisdom  Saving throws with  Advantage, and its maximum Hit Points are increased by 12

those_laid_bare.name: Those Laid Bare
those_laid_bare.description: Affected entity has a +1 bonus to save against spell DC.

thoughtless_brain.name: Thoughtless Brain
thoughtless_brain.description: Mystic Carrion's spells have a +3 bonus to their Difficulty Class and he can't be  Surprised while his brain is intact.

threat_assessment.name: Threat Assessment
threat_assessment.description: Grym has locked on to a new target.

threatened.name: Threatened
threatened.description: An enemy is close. Has  Disadvantage on ranged Attack rolls.

thunder_infusion.name: Thunder Infusion
thunder_infusion.description: The affected entity deals an additional 1d4Thunder the next time it deals damage with a weapon.

thwarted_consumption.name: Thwarted Consumption
thwarted_consumption.description: Raphael cannot consume a soul from this Pillar because it recently took Radiant damage or had its souls dispersed by other means.

tides_of_chaos.name: Tides of Chaos
tides_of_chaos.description: Increased chance of  Wild Magic surge (to 50%). Lost immediately after casting a Level 1 or higher Spell and rolling a  Wild Magic Check.

tippler_s_rage.name: Tippler's Rage
tippler_s_rage.description: While the affected entity is  Drunk, it has  Advantage on Attack rolls. It also creates a blast with each attack, dealing 1d4Thunder damage in a radius of  3 m / 10 ft.

toad_mode.name: Toad Mode
toad_mode.description: If you do not want to think, Dolly Thrice will make you shrink.

tongue_of_madness.name: Tongue of Madness
tongue_of_madness.description: Speaking aloud every thought, gaining  Disadvantage on Charisma Checks.

tortured.name: Tortured
tortured.description: Has  Disadvantage on Constitution  Saving throws.

toxic_reflux.name: Toxic Reflux
toxic_reflux.description: Poison damage has contaminated Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Venomous Regurgitation.

transmuted_to_steel.name: Transmuted To Steel
transmuted_to_steel.description: movement speed has been reduced by  6 m / 20 ft.

transmuter_s_stone_acid_resistance.name: Transmuter's Stone: Acid Resistance
transmuter_s_stone_acid_resistance.description: Affected entity has Resistance to Acid Damage, as long as it carries the transmuter's stone.

transmuter_s_stone_cold_resistance.name: Transmuter's Stone: Cold Resistance
transmuter_s_stone_cold_resistance.description: Affected entity has Resistance to Cold Damage, as long as it carries the transmuter's stone.

transmuter_s_stone_constitution.name: Transmuter's Stone: Constitution
transmuter_s_stone_constitution.description: Affected entity has Proficiency in Constitution Saving Throws, as long as it carries the transmuter's stone.

transmuter_s_stone_darkvision.name: Transmuter's Stone: Darkvision
transmuter_s_stone_darkvision.description: Affected entity can see in the dark out to a range of  Range: 18 m / 60 ft, as long as it carries the transmuter's stone.

transmuter_s_stone_depleted_magic.name: Transmuter's Stone: Depleted Magic
transmuter_s_stone_depleted_magic.description: Affected entity has recently created a Transmuter's Stone. It needs to cast a Transmutation spell of Level 1 or higher or take a Long Rest before it can create another one.

transmuter_s_stone_fire_resistance.name: Transmuter's Stone: Fire Resistance
transmuter_s_stone_fire_resistance.description: Affected entity has Resistance to Fire Damage, as long as it carries the transmuter's stone.

transmuter_s_stone_lightning_resistance.name: Transmuter's Stone: Lightning Resistance
transmuter_s_stone_lightning_resistance.description: Affected entity has Resistance to Lightning Damage, as long as it carries the transmuter's stone.

transmuter_s_stone_movement_speed.name: Transmuter's Stone: Movement Speed
transmuter_s_stone_movement_speed.description: Affected entity's movement speed is increased by  3 m / 10 ft, as long as it carries the transmuter's stone.

transmuter_s_stone_thunder_resistance.name: Transmuter's Stone: Thunder Resistance
transmuter_s_stone_thunder_resistance.description: Affected entity has Resistance to Thunder Damage, as long as it carries the transmuter's stone.

transpositional_flux.name: Transpositional Flux
transpositional_flux.description: Any creature that interacts with this stone will be teleported.

treacly_tummy.name: Treacly Tummy
treacly_tummy.skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
treacly_tummy.description: Disadvantage on Wisdom and Intelligence Checks.

treading_twilight.name: Treading Twilight
treading_twilight.description: While remaining obscured, affected entity has a +1 bonus to  Armour Class.

trembling_legs.name: Trembling Legs
trembling_legs.description: Affected entity is still wobbling on unsteady legs. Its movement speed is reduced by 2.5m / 8.3ft, and its Dexterity is reduced by 1.

true_strike.name: True Strike
true_strike.description: The spellcaster has  Advantage on Attack rolls against this creature.

tu_narath_s_embrace.name: Tu'narath's Embrace
tu_narath_s_embrace.description: This creature was blessed by a nearby Ch'r'ai, it cannot be affected by incapacitating conditions and received  50 temporary hit points.

turned.name: Turned
turned.description: A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from the creature which turned it as possible. It cannot willingly move to a space within 9 m / 30 ft of that creature. It also cannot take Reactions. For its Actions, it can use only the  Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. The condition ends upon taking damage.

turned_to_gold.name: Turned to Gold
turned_to_gold.description: The affected creature is turned into gold. It cannot move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions.

tyrannical_curse.name: Tyrannical Curse
tyrannical_curse.description: Bane's fist will fall at the end of the affected entity's next turn unless the curse is removed, dealing 20d10Force to the target area and giving nearby Banites  Tyrant's Edict.

tyrant_tongue.name: Tyrant Tongue
tyrant_tongue.description: The Sovereign's spores have infused the vocal cords, instilling fear and doubt in any who listens. Has a +2 bonus on Intimidation Checks.

tyrant_s_edict.name: Tyrant's Edict
tyrant_s_edict.description: Bane is granting this creature an additional action and  Advantage on attack rolls.

umbral_form.name: Umbral Form
umbral_form.description: On a hit, the affected entity deals an additional 1d8Necrotic. It is Immune to non-magical damage, and can make an additional melee attack each turn. It cannot cast spells while maintaining this form.

umbral_influx.name: Umbral Influx
umbral_influx.description: Tendrils of shadow engulf the corpse, until it becomes unclear where the body ends and the shadows begin.

umbral_shroud.name: Umbral Shroud
umbral_shroud.description: Has  Advantage on Attack rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

umbral_tremor.name: Umbral Tremor
umbral_tremor.description: The Umbral Tremor is about to open - unleashing the Nightsinger's fell hordes.

unbeating_heart.name: Unbeating Heart
unbeating_heart.description: Carrion's undying life force is stored outside of his body - if killed while his heart is intact, he will rise again the next day.

unbridled_wrath.name: Unbridled Wrath
unbridled_wrath.description: Releasing a decade of pent-up rage in a blaze of infernal fury. The affected entity is Immune to Fire damage.

uncanny_sight.name: Uncanny Sight
uncanny_sight.description: Can see objects hidden to the unaided eye.

unconscious.name: Unconscious
unconscious.description: Character is unconscious. The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity  Saving throws. Attack rolls within 3 m / 10 ft automatically Critical Hit

undead_fortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
undead_fortitude.description: When reduced to 0 hit points, regain 1 hit point instead (unless the damage was radiant or caused by a critical hit).

undead_ward.name: Undead Ward
undead_ward.description: Affected entity is Resistant to Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing damage.

undead_ward_aura.name: Undead Ward Aura
undead_ward_aura.description: Allied undead within  9 m / 30 ft are Resistant to Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing damage.

undying_fury.name: Undying Fury
undying_fury.description: Cazador's anger increases his Strength score by 4 and lets him attack multiple times.

unmovable.name: Unmovable
unmovable.description: While concentrating on a spell, you can't be knocked  Prone or moved against your will.

unnerved.name: Unnerved
unnerved.description: This entity cannot take actions as their courage has been stifled by a ghost.

unrelenting_storm.name: Unrelenting Storm
unrelenting_storm.description: The next time this creature would be reduced to 0 hit points, it will instead remain conscious with 1 hitpoint left. In addition, it will begin  Hoarding Energy, gain  100 temporary hit points for 1 round and lose any Incapacitating Conditions.

unstable.name: Unstable
unstable.description: The gremishka is reacting to nearby magic and has become unstable. At the start of its next turn, it will trigger a random effect.

unstable_ballistics.name: Unstable Ballistics
unstable_ballistics.description: This grenade will explode immediately when interacted with.

unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
unstoppable.description: Reduce the next damage taken by the entity to 1 and consumes one charge of Unstoppable. Unstoppable creatures cannot be moved by any external forces — mundane or magical.

untenable_secret.name: Untenable Secret
untenable_secret.description: Ravaged by a monstrous secret. Affected entity must cast  Share Untenable Secret on an ally or suffer debilitating Psychic damage.

unyielding_construct.name: Unyielding Construct
unyielding_construct.description: Only an attack dealing at least 15 damage can harm this Steel Watcher.

upset_stomach.name: Upset Stomach
upset_stomach.description: Something was off about that apple. When the duration ends, make a DC 15  Constitution saving throw. Failing will inflict the condition  Feverish.

vampire_regeneration.name: Vampire Regeneration
vampire_regeneration.description: The vampire regains  20 hit points at the start of its turn, unless it is in sunlight, or has taken radiant damage or damage from holy water.

vampiric_touch.name: Vampiric Touch
vampiric_touch.description: Each turn, using an Action, can recast Vampiric Touch without expending a Spell Slot.

veil_of_shar.name: Veil of Shar
veil_of_shar.description: Shield of Faith also grants a +2 bonus to all Saving Throws.

venomous_brew.name: Venomous Brew
venomous_brew.description: Affected entity deals an additional 2d6Poison damage while infused with Thisobald's current brew.

venomous_revenge.name: Venomous Revenge
venomous_revenge.description: Affected entity has been recently healed, and its weapon attacks deal an additional 1d6Poison.

vessel_for_kereska_s_poison.name: Vessel for Kereska's Poison
vessel_for_kereska_s_poison.description: Affected entity has resistance to Poison damage. Its poison spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus. When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of  Poisoned upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's poison, it can cast  Cloudkill and  Ray of Sickness at 5th level once per short rest.

vicious_mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
vicious_mockery.description: Disadvantage on the next Attack roll.

violent_heart.name: Violent Heart
violent_heart.description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its Violent Heart by healing an enemy.

vitality_drain.name: Vitality Drain
vitality_drain.description: The dead girl's Sapping Curse is draining your vitality. Affected entity takes takes 4d6+4Necrotic per turn. Take half damage on succeeding a DC 8  Wisdom saving throw. Doubled movement cost.

vlaakith_s_undying_aspect.name: Vlaakith's Undying Aspect
vlaakith_s_undying_aspect.description: This scion of the Lich Queen has had its  Armour Class increased by 3, all of its Ability Scores increased by 6, and fires 6 beams when casting  Eldritch Blast.

voice_of_reason.name: Voice of Reason
voice_of_reason.description: Your Oath echoes in your mind, keeping Auntie Ethel's whispers at bay - for now.

voice_of_the_circle.name: Voice of the Circle
voice_of_the_circle.description: The Soverign's spores have infused the vocal cords, making them echo with authority. Has a +2 bonus on Persuasion Checks.

void_cloud.name: Void Cloud
void_cloud.description: Becomes  blinded and suffers 2d8Cold damage at the end of the turn.

volatile_blood.name: Volatile Blood
volatile_blood.description: This creature takes 1d6Necrotic damage each turn and Detonate upon death.

volatile_shield_10.name: Volatile Shield (10)
volatile_shield_10.description: Affected entity has been granted temporary hit points by an illithid. If these are removed by incoming damage, the shield bursts, possibly  Stunning nearby foes. The shield only bursts after all temporary hit points have been removed. This also removes the condition. When the shield bursts, enemies within  9 m / 30 ft are  Stunned for 1 turn, unless they succeed a DC 15  Intelligence saving throw.

volatile_shield_25.name: Volatile Shield (25)
volatile_shield_25.description: Affected entity has been granted temporary hit points by an illithid. If these are removed by incoming damage, the shield bursts, possibly  Stunning nearby foes. The shield only bursts after all temporary hit points have been removed. This also removes the condition. When the shield bursts, enemies within  9 m / 30 ft are  Stunned for 1 turn, unless they succeed a DC 15  Intelligence saving throw.

volo_s_guide_to_monsters.name: Volo's Guide to Monsters
volo_s_guide_to_monsters.description: With steadfast application of knowledge from Volo's preeminent work, affected entitites gain +2 to Attack Rolls, Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

vow_of_enmity.name: Vow of Enmity
vow_of_enmity.description: Spellcaster has  Advantage on Attack Rolls against the affected entity.

wall_of_fire.name: Wall of Fire
wall_of_fire.description: A blazing wall of fire that deals 5d8Fire to anyone within  3 m / 10 ft.

wall_of_fire_aura.name: Wall of Fire: Aura
wall_of_fire_aura.description: Engulfed in a wall of blazings flames. The affected entity takes 5d8 + 1d8 per additional Spell LevelFire damage per turn it stays within  3 m / 10 ft of the fire.

wall_of_thorns.name: Wall of Thorns
wall_of_thorns.description: Walking through a wall of pliable, twisted thorns. While within the wall, the affected entity's movement speed is quartered, and it takes 7d8Piercing damage per turn.

warden_of_vitality_aura.name: Warden of Vitality (Aura)
warden_of_vitality_aura.description: Affected entity can use  Restore Vitality to heal itself or nearby allies.

warden_of_vitality.name: Warden of Vitality
warden_of_vitality.description: Close enough to a friendly paladin to be healed with  Restore Vitality.

warding_bond_caster.name: Warding Bond (Caster)
warding_bond_caster.description: Creature is bound to an ally. Each time the ally takes damage, the creature takes the same amount of damage.

warding_bond.name: Warding Bond
warding_bond.resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder
warding_bond.description: Affected entity has a +1 bonus to Armour Class and Saving throw Saving throws, and Resistance to all damage. Each time it takes damage, the spellcaster takes the same amount of damage.

wasting_brew.name: Wasting Brew
wasting_brew.description: Affected entity deals an additional 2d6Necrotic damage while infused with Thisobald's current brew.

wasting_mortal.name: Wasting Mortal
wasting_mortal.description: This living creature takes 4d6Necrotic at the end of every turn while it is within  The Dead Wastes. Afflicted creatures also cannot regenerate  hit points and their movement costs twice as much.

water_layer_protection.name: Water Layer Protection
water_layer_protection.description: Prevented from  Burning. Resistant to Fire damage. Saving throw +2

wayward_heart.name: Wayward Heart
wayward_heart.description: Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws. To end this effect, the creature must deny its Wayward Heart by acquiescing to Shar and aiding Viconia in combat.

wayward_undead.name: Wayward Undead
wayward_undead.description: Affected entity is controlled by Mystic Carrion until combat ends. When this affect ends, the entity is destroyed.

weak_grip.name: Weak Grip
weak_grip.description: Has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Strength  Saving throws. Removed if an ally Helps this creature.

weapon_dropped.name: Weapon Dropped!
weapon_dropped.description: An enemy has made you drop your weapon to the ground, similar to  Disarmed.

weapon_stolen.name: Weapon Stolen!
weapon_stolen.description: An enemy has taken your weapon.

weavebound_vines.name: Weavebound Vines
weavebound_vines.description: Vines crafted from the very Weave itself - a most unorthodox enchantment. Incapacitates the affected entity. Dispelled when the entity is attacked.

weavewalker.name: Weavewalker
weavewalker.description: One must remove all obstacles to follow one's destiny -  Arabella's favour grants affected creatures the benefits of  Freedom of Movement. The affected creature's Movement Speed cannot be reduced by Difficult Terrain, spells or magical effects. The affected creature cannot be  Paralysed or  Restrained.

wet.name: Wet
wet.description: Immune to  Burning and  Wild Magic: Burning. Resistant to Fire damage. Vulnerable to Lightning and Cold damage.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: Creatures in this whirlwind may become  Restrained ( Strength saving throw)

whispers_of_madness.name: Whispers of Madness
whispers_of_madness.skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
whispers_of_madness.description: Dark whispers pervade the creature's mind.  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.

wholeness_of_body.name: Wholeness of Body
wholeness_of_body.description: Affected entity has an extra  Bonus Action and recovers 1  Ki Point every turn.

wild_magic_burning.name: Wild Magic: Burning
wild_magic_burning.description: Takes 1d6Fire damage at the start of each turn.

wild_magic_cat_form.name: Wild Magic: Cat Form
wild_magic_cat_form.description: Flickering, unreliable magic has polymorphed you into a cat.

wild_magic_dark_tendrils.name: Wild Magic: Dark Tendrils
wild_magic_dark_tendrils.description: Each creature within  9 m / 30 ft of you must succeed a  Constitution saving throw or take 1d12Necrotic damage. Additionally, you gain  1d12 temporary hit points. The DC is based off your Charisma modifier

wild_magic_dog_form.name: Wild Magic: Dog Form
wild_magic_dog_form.description: Flickering, unreliable magic has polymorphed you into a dog.

wild_magic_enchant_weapons.name: Wild Magic: Enchant Weapons
wild_magic_enchant_weapons.description: The next attack with this weapon is a Critical Hit and deals an additional 1d4Force.

wild_magic_explosive_healing.name: Wild Magic: Explosive Healing
wild_magic_explosive_healing.description: Your spells of Level 1 and higher heal all creatures in a  3 m / 10 ft radius for 1d4hit points hit points per Spell Slot level.

wild_magic_intangible_spirit.name: Wild Magic: Intangible Spirit
wild_magic_intangible_spirit.description: Can summon an  Intangible Spirit each turn, until the end of their  Rage.

wild_magic_light_bolt.name: Wild Magic: Light Bolt
wild_magic_light_bolt.description: Can shoot a  Bolt of Light from their chest each turn, until the end of their  Rage.

wild_magic_magic_retribution.name: Wild Magic: Magic Retribution
wild_magic_magic_retribution.description: Until the end of the barbarian's Rage, enemies that hit them take 1d6Force damage in retaliation.

wild_magic_protective_lights_aura.name: Wild Magic: Protective Lights (Aura)
wild_magic_protective_lights_aura.description: Protected by multicoloured lights. Until the end of the barbarian's  Rage, the barbarian and any allies within  3 m / 10 ft have a +1 bonus to  Armour Class.

wild_magic_protective_lights.name: Wild Magic: Protective Lights
wild_magic_protective_lights.description: Surrounded by a barbarian's wild magic. Has a +1 bonus to  Armour Class until the end of the barbarian's  Rage.

wild_magic_sorcery_points.name: Wild Magic: Sorcery Points
wild_magic_sorcery_points.description: Each spell you cast restores Sorcery Points equal to its Spell Slot level.

wild_magic_swap.name: Wild Magic: Swap
wild_magic_swap.description: Casting a spell or cantrip makes you switch positions with a targeted creature.

wild_magic_telekinesis.name: Wild Magic: Telekinesis
wild_magic_telekinesis.description: You are able to use Telekinesis without expending a spell slot.

wild_magic_teleport.name: Wild Magic: Teleport
wild_magic_teleport.description: Can use a  Bonus Action to teleport up to  9 m / 30 ft.

wild_magic_teleport_barbarian.name: Wild Magic: Teleport (Barbarian)
wild_magic_teleport_barbarian.description: Can  Teleport each turn, until the end of their  Rage.

wild_magic_turn_magic.name: Wild Magic: Turn Magic
wild_magic_turn_magic.description: At the start of each turn, triggers a random magical effect.

wild_magic_vine_growth.name: Wild Magic: Vine Growth
wild_magic_vine_growth.description: Surrounded by flowers and vines Until the end of the barbarian's Rage, the ground within  5 m / 17 ft is  Difficult Terrain for everyone other than the barbarian, halving Movement Speed

wild_magic_weapon_infusion.name: Wild Magic: Weapon Infusion
wild_magic_weapon_infusion.description: Magic infuses this weapon. Until the end of the barbarian's Rage, it deals an additional 1d6Force damage and gains the  Light and  Thrown properties. If thrown, it immediately reappears in the barbarian's hand.

wild_shape_air_myrmidon.name: Wild Shape: Air Myrmidon
wild_shape_air_myrmidon.description: Wild shaped into an Air Myrmidon

wild_shape_cave_bear.name: Wild Shape: Cave Bear
wild_shape_cave_bear.description: Wild shaped into a Cave Bear

wild_shape_deep_roth.name: Wild Shape: Deep Rothé
wild_shape_deep_roth.description: Wild shaped into a Deep Rothé

wild_shape_dire_raven.name: Wild Shape: Dire Raven
wild_shape_dire_raven.description: Wild shaped into a Dire Raven

wild_shape_dire_wolf.name: Wild Shape: Dire Wolf
wild_shape_dire_wolf.description: Wild shaped into a Dire Wolf

wild_shape_earth_myrmidon.name: Wild Shape: Earth Myrmidon
wild_shape_earth_myrmidon.description: Wild shaped into an Earth Myrmidon

wild_shape_fire_myrmidon.name: Wild Shape: Fire Myrmidon
wild_shape_fire_myrmidon.description: Wild shaped into an Fire Myrmidon

wild_shape_giant_spider.name: Wild Shape: Giant Spider
wild_shape_giant_spider.description: Wild shaped into a Giant Spider

wild_shape_polar_bear.name: Wild Shape: Polar Bear
wild_shape_polar_bear.description: Wild shaped into a Polar Bear

wild_shape_sabre_toothed_tiger.name: Wild Shape: Sabre-Toothed Tiger
wild_shape_sabre_toothed_tiger.description: Wild shaped into a Sabre-Toothed Tiger

wild_shape_water_myrmidon.name: Wild Shape: Water Myrmidon
wild_shape_water_myrmidon.description: Wild shaped into a Water Myrmidon

wilted_dreams.name: Wilted Dreams
wilted_dreams.description: The target takes 3d6Psychic damage during next Long Rest.

witch_bolt.name: Witch Bolt
witch_bolt.description: The spellcaster can use an Action each turn to activate the arc linking it to this creature to automatically deal 1d12Lightning damage.

withering_barrier.name: Withering Barrier
withering_barrier.description: If the affected entity is hit with a melee attack while it still has temporary hit points, it deals 1d6Piercing to creatures within  3 m / 10 ft.

withering_life_force.name: Withering Life Force
withering_life_force.description: Stole a creature's life force and gained  20 temporary hit points. Reconstituted Arcanists can hand their Withering Life Force to other creatures.

within_the_mind_sanctuary.name: Within the Mind Sanctuary
within_the_mind_sanctuary.description: Affected entity can take actions and bonus actions interchangeably, as long as it stays within the mind sanctuary. After using both action and bonus action, this condition ends and you gain the  Mind Sanctuary: Depleted condition.

witness.name: Witness
witness.description: Witnessed the murder of a guard and will report to other guards as soon as possible.

wizardsbane_oil.name: Wizardsbane Oil
wizardsbane_oil.description: Affected entity has -3 penalty to Spell Attack Rolls and Spell Save DC  Disadvantage on  Concentration Saving Throws

wound_closure.name: Wound Closure
wound_closure.description: While unconscious, the affected entity stabilises at the start of its turn.

wrath.name: Wrath
wrath.description: You have a +1 bonus to damage with melee weapons for every turn this condition has remaining.

wrathful_spirits.name: Wrathful Spirits
wrathful_spirits.vulnerability: Poison, Thunder, Radiant, Psychic, Necrotic, Lightning, Force, Fire, Cold, Acid, Slashing, Piercing, Bludgeoning
wrathful_spirits.description: Spiritual energy has  Frightened this creature and is making it Vulnerable to all damage.

wretched_growth.name: Wretched Growth
wretched_growth.description: Affected entity will take 3d10Necrotic and possibly become  Entangled by Shadow-Cursed Vines if it ends its turn within  5 m / 17 ft of the Shambling Mound. On save, the affected entity still takes half damage.

writhing_souls.name: Writhing Souls
writhing_souls.description: While stood within the  Soul Ascension, this non-fiend will take 6d10Necrotic every turn as its soul is rended.

writhing_tide.name: Writhing Tide
writhing_tide.description: Your swarm is protecting you from surface effects.

wyvern_toxin.name: Wyvern Toxin
wyvern_toxin.description: Affected entity takes 1d8Poison damage at the end of its next turn.

yeenoghu_s_blessing.name: Yeenoghu's Blessing
yeenoghu_s_blessing.description: Indulged its lust for violence. Yeenoghu's Gift won't turn the affected creature  Mad.

yeenoghu_s_gift.name: Yeenoghu's Gift
yeenoghu_s_gift.description: Famished for slaughter. Affected entity can go  Mad for 2 turns if it doesn't deal damage to an enemy by the end of its turn.

yeenoghu_s_hunger.name: Yeenoghu's Hunger
yeenoghu_s_hunger.description: Bloated with the spoils of slaughter, but still hungry - a gnoll is growing in the hyena's belly.

zariel_s_protection.name: Zariel's Protection
zariel_s_protection.description: When attacked, Mizora will disappear to the Hells and return after a minute.
